translations.source: Fellow wrestlers also paid tribute to Luna.
translations.reference: Mabondia wenzake pia walimuombeleza Luna.
translations.hypothesis: Wapiganaji wengine pia walimpongeza na kumheshimu Luna.

translations.source: Tommy Dreamer said "Luna was the first Queen of Extreme. My first manager. Luna passed away on the night of two moons. Pretty unique just like her. Strong woman."
translations.reference: Tommy Dreamer alisema, “Luna alikuwa Malkia wa kwanza wa Kukithiri. Meneja wangu wa kwanza. Luna aliaga dunia mnamo usiku wa miezi miwili. Kipekee kama alivyo tu. Mwanamke hodari.”
translations.hypothesis: Tommy Dreamer alisema, "Luna alikuwa mwanamke wa kwanza kushinda taji la 'Extreme'. Alikuwa meneja wangu wa kwanza. Luna alifariki usiku uliokuwa na miezi miwili. Jambo la kipekee sana, kama yeye mwenyewe. Alikuwa mwanamke hodari."

translations.source: Dustin "Goldust" Runnels commented that "Luna was as freaky as me...maybe even more...love her and will miss her...hopefully she's in a better place."
translations.reference: Justin “Goldust” Runnels ametoa maoni kwamba “Luna alikuwa mdhaifu kama mimi … labda hata zaidi … umpende na utamkosa… kwa matumaini yupo mahali pazuri.”
translations.hypothesis: Dustin "Goldust" Runnels alisema kwamba "Luna alikuwa mtu wa ajabu kama mimi...labda hata zaidi...nilimpenda na nitamkumbuka...natumai kwamba yeye amekwenda mahali pazuri."

translations.source: Out of 1,400 people polled prior to the 2010 federal election, those who oppose Australia becoming a republic grew by 8 per cent since 2008.
translations.reference: Kwa watu 1,400 waliopiga kura ya maoni kabla ya uchaguzi wa 2010 wa shirikisho, wale wanaopinga Australia kuwa jamhuri waliongezeka kwa asilimia 8 tangu mwaka wa 2008.
translations.hypothesis: Kati ya watu 1,400 ambao walichaguliwa kushiriki katika utafiti kabla ya uchaguzi wa kitaifa wa mwaka wa 2010, idadi ya watu ambao hawakubali Australia kuwa jamhuri iliongezeka kwa asilimia 8 tangu mwaka wa 2008.

translations.source: Caretaker Prime Minister Julia Gillard claimed during the campaign of the 2010 federal election that she believed Australia should become a republic at the end of Queen Elizabeth II's reign.
translations.reference: Kaimu Waziri Mkuu Julia Gillard alidai wakati wa kampeni ya uchaguzi wa ushirika wa 2010 kwamba aliamini Australia inafaa kuwa jamhuri mwishoni mwa utawala wa Malkia Elizabeth II.
translations.hypothesis: Wakati wa kampeni ya uchaguzi wa kitaifa wa mwaka wa 2010, Waziri Mkuu wa muda Julia Gillard alisema kwamba aliamini Australia inapaswa kuwa jamhuri baada ya utawala wa Malkia Elizabeth II kumalizika.

translations.source: 34 per cent of those in the poll share this view, wanting Queen Elizabeth II to be Australia's last monarch.
translations.reference: Asilimia 34 ya walio kwenye uchunguzi wanashiriki maoni haya, kumtaka Malkia Elizabeth wa II awe malikia wa mwisho wa Australia.
translations.hypothesis: Asilimia 34 ya watu waliohojiwa katika utafiti huo wana mtazamo huu, na wanataka Malkia Elizabeth II kuwa mfalme/malkia wa mwisho wa Australia.

translations.source: At the extremes of the poll, 29 per cent of those surveyed believe Australia should become a republic as soon as possible, while 31 per cent believe Australia should never become a republic.
translations.reference: Katika wingi wa kura, asilimia 29 ya wale waliofanyiwa utafiti wanaamini Australia inapaswa kuwa jamhuri haraka iwezekanavyo, huku asilimia 31 wakiamini Australia haipaswi kamwe kuwa jamhuri.
translations.hypothesis: Katika matokeo ya uchunguzi huo, asilimia 29 ya watu waliohojiwa wanaamini kwamba Australia inapaswa kuwa jamhuri iwezekanavyo haraka, wakati asilimia 31 wanaamini kwamba Australia haipaswi kamwe kuwa jamhuri.

translations.source: The Olympic gold medalist was due to swim in the 100m and 200m freestyle and in three relays at the Commonwealth Games, but due to his complaints his fitness has been in doubt.
translations.reference: Aliyeshinda nishani ya dhahabu ya Olimpiki alikuwa amepangiwa kuogelea katika mtindo huru wa mita 100 na mita 200 na mbio tatu za kupokezana vijiti katika Michezo ya Jumuiya ya Madola, lakini kwa sababu ya malalamiko yake uzima wake umekuwa na shaka.
translations.hypothesis: Mshindi wa medali ya dhahabu katika Olimpiki alitarajiwa kushiriki katika mbio za metri 100 na 200 za aina ya "freestyle" pamoja na mbio tatu za timu katika Michezo ya Jumuiya ya Madola, lakini kutokana na malalamiko yake, uwezo wake wa kujiendesha umekuwa chini ya utafiti.

translations.source: He has been unable to take the drugs needed to overcome his pain as they are banned from the Games.
translations.reference: Hakuweza kunywa dawa zinazohitajika kutuliza maumivu yake kwani zimepigwa marufuku katika Michezo.
translations.hypothesis: Hakuweza kutumia dawa ambazo anahitaji ili kupunguza maumivu yake, kwa sababu dawa hizo zimepigwa marufuku katika michezo hiyo.

translations.source: Curtis Cooper, a mathematician and computer science professor at the University of Central Missouri, has discovered the largest known prime number to date on January 25.
translations.reference: Curtis Cooper, mtaalamu wa hisabati na profesa wa sayansi ya kompyuta katika Chuo Kikuu cha Missouri, amegundua nambari tasa kubwa zaidi kufikia sasa mnamo Januari 25.
translations.hypothesis: Curtis Cooper, mwanafalsafa na profesa wa hisabati na sayansi ya kompyuta katika Chuo Kikuu cha Central Missouri, amegundua namba kubwa zaidi ya msingi iliyojulikana hadi sasa, mnamo Januari 25.

translations.source: Several people verified the discovery using different hardware and software by the beginning of February and it was announced on Tuesday.
translations.reference: Watu kadhaa walithibitisha uvumbuzi huo kutumia maunzi na programu tofauti kufikia mwanzoni mwa Februari na ikatangazwa mnamo Jumanne.
translations.hypothesis: Watu kadhaa walithibitisha ugunduzi huo kwa kutumia vifaa na programu tofauti kabla ya mwanzoni mwa mwezi wa Februari, na tangazo hilo lilitolewa siku ya Jumanne.

translations.source: Comets may possibly have been a source of water delivery to the earth along with organic matter that can form proteins and support life.
translations.reference: Kuna uwezekano kwamba nyotamkia zilikuwa chanzo cha kusafirisha maji katika dunia, pamoja na vitu vilivyo na kaboni vinavyoweza kuunda protini na kusaidia uhai.
translations.hypothesis: Ni pengine kwamba vito vya angani (comets) yaliweza kuwa chanzo cha maji ambayo yaliwasilishwa kwenye dunia, pamoja na mada ya kikaboni ambayo inaweza kuunda protini na kusaidia maisha.

translations.source: Scientists hope to understand how planets form, especially how the Earth formed, since comets collided with the Earth long ago.
translations.reference: Wanasayansi wanatumai kuelewa jinsi sayari huundwa, hasa jinsi Dunia ilivyoundwa, kwani nyotamkia ziligongana na Dunia kitambo.
translations.hypothesis: Wanasayansi wana matumaini ya kuelewa jinsi sayari zinavyoundwa, hasa jinsi sayari yetu, Dunia, ilivyoundwa, kwani zamani sana, vito vya angani (comets) viligonga Dunia.

translations.source: Cuomo, 53, began his governorship earlier this year and signed a bill last month legalizing same-sex marriage.
translations.reference: Cuomo, mwenye umri wa miaka 53, alianza ugavana wake mapema mwaka huu na kutia saini mswada mwezi uliopita wa kuhalalisha ndoa za jinsia moja.
translations.hypothesis: Cuomo, mwenye umri wa miaka 53, alianza kazi yake kama gavana mapema mwaka huu, na mwezi uliopita alitia saini sheria ambayo inakubali ndoa za watu wa jinsia moja.

translations.source: He referred to the rumors as "political chatter and silliness".
translations.reference: Alitaja uvumi huo kama "mapayuko na upumbavu wa kisiasa".
translations.hypothesis: Alizitaja habari hizo za uwongo kama "maneno ya kisiasa yasiyo na maana na ujinga."

translations.source: He is speculated to make a run for president in 2016.
translations.reference: Alifikiria kugombea urais mnamo 2016.
translations.hypothesis: Inaaminika kwamba anaweza kuwania urais mwaka wa 2016.

translations.source: NextGen is a system the FAA claims would allow aircraft to fly shorter routes and save millions of gallons of fuel each year and cut carbon emissions.
translations.reference: NextGen ni mfumo ambao Utawala wa Shirikisho la Anga unadai ungeruhusu ndege kutumia njia fupi na kuokoa mamilioni ya galoni za mafuta kila mwaka na kukata uzalishaji wa kaboni.
translations.hypothesis: NextGen ni mfumo ambao FAA (Shirika la Anga la Marekani) inadai kwamba unaweza kuruhusu ndege kuruka kwa njia fupi zaidi, na hivyo kuokoa mamilioni ya galoni za mafuta kila mwaka, na pia kupunguza uzalishaji wa gesi za hewa zinazochangia mabadiliko ya tabianchi.

translations.source: It uses satellite-based technology as opposed to older ground-radar-based technology to allow air traffic controllers to pinpoint aircraft with greater precision and give pilots more accurate information.
translations.reference: Hutumia teknolojia yenye msingi wa setalaiti kinyume na teknolojia ya kitambo yenye msingi wa radar ya ardhini ili kuwezesha wadhibiti wa trafiki ya anga kupata vyombo vya angani kwa usahihi zaidi na kuwapatia marubani taarifa za usahihi zaidi.
translations.hypothesis: Inaendelea kutumia teknolojia ya satelaiti, tofauti na teknolojia ya zamani iliyotumia rada ya ardhini, ili kuruhusu wasimamizi wa trafiki ya anga kuweza kubaini nafasi ya ndege kwa usahihi zaidi na kuwapa piloti taarifa sahihi zaidi.

translations.source: No extra transport is being put on and overground trains will not stop at Wembley, and car parking and park-and-ride facilities are unavailable at the ground.
translations.reference: Hakuna usafiri wa ziada unaowekwa na treni za juu ya ardhi hazitasimama huko Wembley, na maegesho ya magari na vituo vya kuegesha na kusafiri havipatikani huko.
translations.hypothesis: Hakuna usafiri wa ziada utakaopatikana, na treni za kawaida hazitaacha katika kituo cha Wembley. Pia, maeneo ya kuegesha magari na huduma za "geshi la kuingia na kuegesha" hazipatikani katika eneo la uwanja huo.

translations.source: Fears of lack of transportation raised the possibility that the game would be forced to play behind closed doors without the team's supporters.
translations.reference: Hofu ya ukosefu wa usafiri kulizua uwezekano kwamba mchezo huo ungelazimika kuchezwa nyuma ya milango iliyofungwa bila wafuasi wa timu hiyo.
translations.hypothesis: Hofu ya ukosefu wa usafiri ilisababisha wasiwasi kwamba mechi hiyo inaweza kulazimika kuchezwa bila mashabiki, na hivyo timu hiyo itacheza bila uwepo wa wafuasi wake.

translations.source: A study published on Thursday in the journal Science reported on formation of a new bird species on the Ecuadorean Galápagos Islands.
translations.reference: Utafiti uliochapishwa Alhamisi katika jarida la Science uliripoti kuhusu kuundwa kwa spishi mpya ya ndege katika Visiwa vya Galapagos vya Kiekuado.
translations.hypothesis: Utafiti uliochapishwa Alhamisi katika jarida la Science umetoa taarifa kuhusu kuundwa kwa aina mpya ya ndege katika visiwa vya Galápagos nchini Ecuador.

translations.source: Researchers from Princeton University in the United States and Uppsala University in Sweden reported the new species evolved in just two generations, though this process had been believed to take much longer, due to breeding between an endemic Darwin finch, Geospiza fortes, and the immigrant cactus finch, Geospiza conirostris.
translations.reference: Watafiti kutoka Chuo Kikuu cha Princeton katika Marekani na Chuo Kikuu cha Uppsala katika Uswidi waliripoti spishi hiyo mpya iligeuka katika vizazi viwili pekee, ingawa mchakato huu ulikuwa unaaminika kuchukua muda mrefu zaidi, kwa sababu ya kuzaana kati ya wenyeji shorewanda wa Darwin, Geospiza fortes , na wahamiaji shorewanda wa dungusi kakati, Geospiza conirostris.
translations.hypothesis: Watafiti kutoka Chuo Kikuu cha Princeton nchini Marekani na Chuo Kikuu cha Uppsala nchini Sweden wameripoti kwamba aina mpya hiyo ilikua katika vizazi viwili tu, ingawa ilidhaniwa kuwa mchakato huo unachukua muda mrefu zaidi. Hii ilitokea kutokana na mwanapesa kati ya ndege aina ya Geospiza fortes, ambayo ni aina ya asilia ya kisiwa hicho, na ndege aina ya Geospiza conirostris, ambayo ilihamia kisiwa hicho.

translations.source: Gold may be worked into all sorts of shapes. It can be rolled into tiny shapes.
translations.reference: Dhahabu inaweza kutengenezwa ikawa maumbo tofauti tofauti. Inaweza kuvingirishwa ikawa maumbo madogo.
translations.hypothesis: Dhahabu inaweza kuchapishwa katika aina mbalimbali za maumbo. Inaweza kufunguliwa na kukunjwa ili kupata maumbo madogo sana.

translations.source: It can be pulled into thin wire, which can be twisted and plaited. It can be hammered or rolled into sheets.
translations.reference: Inaweza kuvutwa na kuwa waya nyembamba, ambayo inaweza kusokotwa na kusukwa. Inaweza kubabatwa au kufiringishwa kufanya bamba.
translations.hypothesis: Inaweza kuchanganywa na kufanywa kuwa waya nyembamba, ambayo yanaweza kuviringishwa na kuunganishwa pamoja. Pia, inaweza kupigwa au kuvunjwa ili kufanywa kuwa karatasi.

translations.source: It can be made very thin, and stuck onto other metal. It can be made so thin that it was sometimes used to decorate the hand-painted pictures in books called "illuminated manuscripts".
translations.reference: Inaweza kutengenezwa nyembamba zaidi, na kukwamishwa kwenye metali nyingine. Inaweza kutengenezwa nyembamba zaidi hadi wakati mwingine ilitumika kupamba picha zilizochorwa kwa mkono zinazoitwa “miswada iliyoangazwa”.
translations.hypothesis: Inaweza kutengenezwa kuwa nyembamba sana, na kuambatishwa kwenye metali nyingine. Inaweza kutengenezwa nyembamba kiasi kwamba wakati mwingine ilitumika kupamba picha zilizochorwa kwa mkono kwenye vitabu vilivyojulikana kama "manuskrifti zilizopambwa."

translations.source: This is called a chemical's pH. You can make an indicator using red cabbage juice.
translations.reference: Hii inaitwa pH ya kemikali. Unaweza kutengeneza kiashiria kutumia juisi ya kabichi nyekundu.
translations.hypothesis: Hili huitwa "pH" ya kemikali. Unaweza kutengeneza kichocheo (indicator) kwa kutumia juisi ya kabichi nyekundu.

translations.source: The cabbage juice changes color depending on how acidic or basic (alkaline) the chemical is.
translations.reference: Sharubati ya kabichi hubadilisha rangi kulingana na uasidi au ubesi (ualkali) wa kemikali.
translations.hypothesis: Juisi ya kabichi hubadilika rangi kulingana na kiwango cha asidi au alkalinitaji (msingi) cha kemikali hiyo.

translations.source: The pH level is indicated by the amount of Hydrogen (the H in pH) ions in the tested chemical.
translations.reference: Kiwango cha pH huashiriwa na kiasi cha ioni za Hidrojeni (H katika pH) kwenye kemikali iliyofanyiwa jaribio.
translations.hypothesis: Kiasi cha ioni za hidrojeni (ambazo ni "H" katika pH) zilizopo katika kemikali inayojaribiwa huonyesha kiwango cha pH.

translations.source: Hydrogen ions are protons that had their electrons stripped off them (since Hydrogen atoms consist of one proton and one electron).
translations.reference: Ioni za Hidrojeni ni protoni ambazo zilibambuliwa elektroni zazo (kwani atomu za Hidrojeni huwa na protoni moja na elektroni moja).
translations.hypothesis: Ionasi za hidrojeni ni protoni ambazo elektroni zake zimeondolewa (kwani atomi za hidrojeni zina protoni moja na elektroni moja).

translations.source: Swirl the two dry powders together and then, with clean wet hands, squeeze them into a ball.
translations.reference: Funganya poda mbili kavu kisha, kwa mikono safi yenye unyevu, ziingize kwenye mpira.
translations.hypothesis: Changanya poda hizo mbili kavu pamoja, kisha, kwa kutumia mikono safi iliyo na maji, zibongeze ili kuzifanya kuwa mpira.

translations.source: The moisture on your hands will react with the outer layers, which will feel funny and form a sort of shell.
translations.reference: Unyevu kwenye mikono yako utaguswa na tabaka za nje, ambayo utahisi ikiwa tofauti na kuunda ganda aina fulani.
translations.hypothesis: Unyevu kwenye mikono yako utaathirika na safu za nje, na hivyo kusababisha hisia zisizo za kawaida na kuunda aina ya ganda.

translations.source: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a flush toilet in almost every house, attached to a sophisticated sewage system.
translations.reference: Miji ya Harappa na Mohenjo-daro ilikuwa na choo cha kisasa katika karibu kila nyumba, kilichounganishwa kwenye mfumo tata wa maji taka.
translations.hypothesis: Miji ya Harappa na Mohenjo-daro ilikuwa na choo cha kisasa katika karibu kila nyumba, ambacho kilikuwa na mfumo wa usafishaji maji ulioendelezwa.

translations.source: Remains of sewage systems have been found in the houses of the Minoan cities of Crete and Santorini in Greece.
translations.reference: Mabaki ya mfumo wa maji taka yamepatikana kwenye nyumba za miji ya Kiminoa ya Crete na Santorini katika Ugiriki.
translations.hypothesis: Baadhi ya mabaki ya mifumo ya usafishaji maji yamepatikana katika nyumba za miji ya Minoan iliyokuwa katika visiwa vya Crete na Santorini nchini Ugiriki.

translations.source: There were also toilets in ancient Egypt, Persia and China. In Roman civilization, toilets were sometimes part of public bath houses where men and women were together in mixed company.
translations.reference: Pia kulikuwa na choo katika Misri, Uajemi na China ya kale. Katika ustaarabu wa Kirumi, wakati mwingine choo zilikuwa sehemu ya nyumba za bafu za umma ambapo waume na wake walichanganyika pamoja.
translations.hypothesis: Kulikuwa pia na vyoo katika Misri ya kale, Uajemi, na Uchina. Katika utamaduni wa Kiroma, vyoo wakati mwingine vilikuwa sehemu ya mabafu ya umma ambapo wanaume na wanawake walikuwa pamoja.

translations.source: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.
translations.reference: Unapompigia simu mtu aliye mbali maelfu ya maili, unatumia satelaiti.
translations.hypothesis: Unapotumia simu kuwasiliana na mtu ambaye yuko umbali wa maelfu ya kilomita, unatumia mfumo wa satelaiti.

translations.source: The satellite in space gets the call and then reflects it back down, almost instantly.
translations.reference: Setilaiti iliyo angani hupata simu kisha inaiakisi tena chini, karibu papo hapo.
translations.hypothesis: Sateliti iliyopo angani inapokea mawasiliano hayo, kisha inaurejesha ardhini, karibu mara moja.

translations.source: The satellite was sent into space by a rocket. Scientists use telescopes in space because the Earth’s atmosphere distorts some of our light and view.
translations.reference: Setalaiti ilitumwa angani kwa kutumia roketi. Wanasayansi hutumia darubini angani kwa sababu anga ya dunia huvuruga sehemu ya nuru na mtazamo wetu.
translations.hypothesis: Sateliti hiyo ilitumiwa angani kwa kutumia roketi. Wanasayansi hutumia darubini za angani kwa sababu anga la Dunia hufanya mwanga na maoni yetu yabadilike.

translations.source: It takes a giant rocket over a 100 feet high to put a satellite or telescope in space.
translations.reference: Huhitaji roketi kubwa yenye urefu wa zaidi ya futi 100 kuweka setalaiti au darubini angani.
translations.hypothesis: Inahitajika roketi kubwa sana, yenye urefu wa zaidi ya futi 100, ili kupeleka satelaiti au darubini katika nafasi.

translations.source: The wheel has changed the world in incredible ways. The biggest thing that the wheel has done for us is given us much easier and faster transportation.
translations.reference: Gurudumu limebadilisha dunia kwa njia za ajabu. Jambo kubwa zaidi ambalo gurudumu limetufanyia ni kutupatia uchukuzi rahisi na wa haraka.
translations.hypothesis: Gari imebadilisha ulimwengu kwa njia ambazo hazilinganishwi. Jambo muhimu zaidi ambalo gari imetufaa ni kwamba imetuwezesha kusafiri kwa urahisi na kwa kasi zaidi.

translations.source: It has brought us the train, the car, and many other transportation devices.
translations.reference: Imetuletea treni, gari, na vifaa vingine vingi vya uchukuzi.
translations.hypothesis: Imetuletea treni, magari, na vifaa vingine vingi vya usafiri.

translations.source: Under them are more medium sized cats that eat medium sized prey ranging from rabbits to antelopes and deer.
translations.reference: Chini yake kunao paka zaidi zenye mwili wa wastani ambao hula mawindo yenye mwili wa wastani kuanzia sungura hadi swara na kulungu.
translations.hypothesis: Chini yao kuna aina nyingine za mbwa mwitu, zenye ukubwa wa kati, ambazo hula wanyama wadogo hadi wa ukubwa wa kati, kuanzia sungura hadi nyumbu na swala.

translations.source: Finally, there are many small cats (including loose pet cats) that eat the far more numerous small prey like insects, rodents, lizards, and birds.
translations.reference: Mwishowe, kuna paka wengi wadogo (wakiwemo paka huru vipenzi) ambao hula mawindo madogomadogo ambayo ni mengi, kama wadudu, panya, mijusi, na ndege.
translations.hypothesis: Hatimaye, kuna pia paka wadogo wengi (pamoja na paka waliotulia ambao huishi huru) ambao hula mawindo madogo sana, kama vile wadudu, wanyama wadogo kama panya, nyoka wadogo, na ndege.

translations.source: The secret to their success is the concept of the niche, a special job each cat holds that keeps it from competing with others.
translations.reference: Siri ya mafanikio yao ni dhana ya niche, kazi maalum ambayo kila paka anashikilia na inayomzuia kushindana na wengine.
translations.hypothesis: Siri ya mafanikio yao ni dhana ya "nafasi maalum," ambapo kila paka huchukua jukumu fulani ambalo linazuia kushindana na paka wengine.

translations.source: Lions are the most social cats, living in large groups called prides.
translations.reference: Simba ni baadhi ya wanyama wa jamii ya paka wanaopenda ujamii zaidi, na wanaishi katika vikundi vikubwa vinavyoitwa prides.
translations.hypothesis: Simba ni aina ya paka ambayo huishi kwa makundi makubwa, ambayo huitwa "vikundi." Simba hivi ni jamii sana.

translations.source: Prides are made up of one to three related adult males, along with as many as thirty females and cubs.
translations.reference: Makundi ya simba yanatengenezwa na waume kati ya mmoja na watatu wazima wanaohusiana, pamoja na wengi wa kike kama thelathini na mashibli.
translations.hypothesis: Vikundi vya simba vinaweza kuwa na simba wanaume kutoka moja hadi tatu ambao ni ndugu, pamoja na simba kike hadi thelathini na pia simba wachanga.

translations.source: The females are usually closely related to each other, being a large family of sisters and daughters.
translations.reference: Wanawake kawaida ndio uhusiana sana wao kwa wao, kwa kuwa familia kubwa ya madada na mabinti.
translations.hypothesis: Kawaida, femi hizi huwa ni ndugu zilizokua pamoja, na huunda familia kubwa iliyojaa dada na binti.

translations.source: Lion prides act much like packs of wolves or dogs, animals surprisingly similar to lions (but not other big cats) in behavior, and also very deadly to their prey.
translations.reference: Makundi ya simba hutenda kama makundi ya mbwa mwitu au mbwa, wanyama ambao kwa kushangaza ni sawa na simba (lakini si paka wengine wakubwa) kitabia, na pia ni hatari kwa mawindo yao.
translations.hypothesis: Vikundi vya simba huishi na kufanya kazi kama makundi ya mbwa mwitu au mbwa, ambavyo ni wanyama wanaofanana sana na simba (lakini sio wanyama wengine wakubwa kama paka) katika tabia zao, na pia ni hatari sana kwa mawindo yao.

translations.source: A well rounded athlete, the tiger can climb (though not well), swim, leap great distances and pull with five times the force of a strong human.
translations.reference: Mwanariadha wa mambo anuwai, simbamarara anaweza kupanda (ingawa si vizuri), kuogelea, kuruka mbali sana na kuvuta kwa nguvu mara tano ya zile za mwanamume mwenye nguvu.
translations.hypothesis: Mnyama huyo, anayejulikana kama "tiger," ni mwanariadha hodari sana. Anaweza kupanda (ingawa si kwa ustadi mkubwa), kuogelea, kuruka umbali mrefu, na kuvuta vitu kwa nguvu iliyokuwa mara tano ya nguvu ya binadamu mwenye nguvu.

translations.source: The tiger is in the same group (Genus Panthera) as lions, leopards, and jaguars. These four cats are the only ones who can roar.
translations.reference: Chui yuko kwenye kundi moja (jenasi panther) na simba, lengau na chui wa America ya kusini na kati. Hawa paka wanne pekee ndio wanaoweza kunguruma.
translations.hypothesis: Simba wa aina ya chui wanapatikana katika kundi moja (jenasi ya Panthera) pamoja na simba, pundamilia, na jaguari. Wanyama hawa manne pekee ndio wanaweza kutamba kwa sauti kubwa.

translations.source: The tiger's roar is not like the full-voiced roar of a lion, but more like a sentence of snarly, shouted words.
translations.reference: Mgurumo wa simbamarara si kama mgurumo mkubwa wa simba, bali ni zaidi kama sentensi ya kemeo yenye maneno yanayotolewa kwa kelele.
translations.hypothesis: Mnyama wa aina ya simba (tiger) hutoka sauti ambayo si kama sauti kubwa na nguvu ya simba, bali ni kama mkumbo wa maneno makali na yenye kelele.

translations.source: Ocelots like to eat small animals. They will catch monkeys, snakes, rodents and birds if they can. Almost all of the animals that the ocelot hunts are far smaller than it is.
translations.reference: Paka mwitu hupenda kula wanyama wadogo. Hushika tumbili, nyoka, panya na ndege kama wanaweza. Karibu wanyama wote ambao paka mwitu huwinda ni wadogo kumliko.
translations.hypothesis: Nyoka aina ya ocelot wanapenda kula wanyama wadogo. Wanaweza kunasa simba wa majani, nyoka, wanyama wadogo wa aina ya panya, na ndege ikiwa ni lazima. Karibu wanyama wote ambao nyoka hawa wanawinda ni wadogo sana kuliko wao wenyewe.

translations.source: Scientists think that ocelots follow and find animals to eat (prey) by smell, sniffing for where they've been on the ground.
translations.reference: Wanasayansi wanafikiria kwamba paka mwitu hufuata na kutafuta wanyama wa kula (windo) kwa harufu, kunusa ili kutafuta walikokuwa ardhini.
translations.hypothesis: Wanasayansi wanaamini kwamba nyati hizi (ocelots) huwafuatilia na kuwagundua wanyama wanaowawinda (wanyama wanaokula) kwa kutumia harufu, kwa kupuka ardhini ili kugundua alama za wanyama hao.

translations.source: They can see very well in the dark with night vision, and move very stealthily, too. Ocelots hunt their prey by blending in with their surroundings then pouncing on their prey.
translations.reference: Wanaweza kuona vizuri sana kwa giza na maono ya usiku pia wanasonga kwa kimya sana. Ocelots huwinda mawindo yao kwa kujichanganya na mazingira yao kasha kurukia mawindo yao.
translations.hypothesis: Wanyama hawa wana uwezo wa kuona vizuri sana katika giza kwa kutumia uwezo wao wa kuona usiku, na pia wana uwezo wa kusonga kwa utulivu sana. Wanyama aina ya ocelot wanawinda mawindo yao kwa kujificha katika mazingira yao, kisha kusimama juu yao ghafla.

translations.source: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before.
translations.reference: Wakati kundi dogo la vitu vilivyo hai (idadi ndogo) linatenganishwa na idadi kubwa walimotoka (kama wakipita juu ya milima au mto, au wakihamia kwenye kisiwa kigeni hivi kwamba hawawezi kurudi nyuma kwa urahisi) mara nyingi watajipata katika mazingira tofauti na walimokuwa awali.
translations.hypothesis: Wakati kundi dogo la viumbe hai (idadi ndogo ya viumbe) linapotengwa kutoka kwa kundi kubwa ambalo lilitoka (kama vile wanapohama kupitia milima au mto, au wanapohama kwenda kisiwa kipya ambapo hawawezi kurudi kwa urahisi), mara nyingi wanakuta wenyewe katika mazingira tofauti kuliko yale ambayo walikuwa humo awali.

translations.source: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor than what they had needed before.
translations.reference: Mazingira haya mapya yana rasilimali tofauti na washindani tofauti, kwa hivyo idadi mpya ya watu itahitaji vipengele au mazoea tofauti ili kuwa washindani imara kuliko walichohitaji awali.
translations.hypothesis: Mazingira mapya haya yana rasilimali tofauti na washindani tofauti, kwa hivyo idadi ya watu wapya itahitaji sifa au tabia tofauti ili kuwa washindani imara kuliko ilivyohitaji hapo awali.

translations.source: The original population hasn't changed at all, they still need the same adaptations as before.
translations.reference: Idadi asili haijabadilika kamwe, bado wanahitaji mbinu zile zile za za awali.
translations.hypothesis: Idadi ya watu wa awali haijabadilika kabisa; bado wanahitaji msaada na huduma sawa na wale waliohitajika hapo awali.

translations.source: Over time, as the new population begins to adapt to their new environment, they start to look less and less like the other population.
translations.reference: Kwa muda, jinsi idadi mpya inavyoanza kuzoea mazingira yao mapya, wanaanza kuonekana zaidi na zaidi tofauti na idadi ile nyingine.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa muda, kadri idadi ya watu wapya wanavyozoea mazingira yao mapya, wanakianza kuonekana tofauti zaidi na zaidi kuliko idadi ya watu wengine.

translations.source: Eventually, after thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will look so different that they can't be called the same species.
translations.reference: Mwishowe, baada ya maelfu au hata mamilioni ya miaka, wakazi hao wawili wataonekana tofauti sana kwamba hawawezi kuitwa spishi moja.
translations.hypothesis: Hatimaye, baada ya maelfu au hata mamilioni ya miaka, makundi hayo mawili yataonekana tofauti sana kiasi kwamba hayawezi tena kuita kama spishi moja.

translations.source: We call this process speciation, which just means the formation of new species. Speciation is an unavoidable consequence and a very important part of evolution.
translations.reference: Tunauita mchakato huu speciation, ambalo linamanisha uundaji wa spishi mpya. Speciation ni matokeo yasiyoweza kuepukika na sehemu muhimu sana ya mageuzi.
translations.hypothesis: Tunaita mchakato huu "utengenezaji wa spishi," ambayo kwa msingi inamaanisha kuundwa kwa spishi mpya. Utengenezaji wa spishi ni matokeo ambayo haywezi kuepukika na sehemu muhimu sana ya mchakato wa mageuzi.

translations.source: Plants make oxygen which humans breathe, and they take in carbon-dioxide which humans exhale (that is, breathe out).
translations.reference: Mimea hutengeneza oksijeni ambayo binadamu hupumua, na huingiza kabonidioksidi ambayo binadamu hutoa nje (yaani, kupumua nje).
translations.hypothesis: Mimea huzalisha oksijeni ambayo binadamu hupumua, na pia huchukua kaboni dioksidi ambayo binadamu hutoa (yaani, hupuliza nje).

translations.source: Plants make their food from the sun by photosynthesis. They also provide shade.
translations.reference: Mimea hupata chakula chao kutoka kwa jua kupitia usanisinuru. Pia hupatia kuvuli
translations.hypothesis: Mimea hutengeneza chakula chake kutoka kwenye jua kupitia mchakato unaojulikana kama fotosintézi. Pia, mimea hutoa kivuli.

translations.source: We make our houses from plants and make clothes from plants. Most foods that we eat are plants. Without plants, animals could not survive.
translations.reference: Sisi hutengeneza nyumba zetu kwa mimea na kutengeneza nguo zetu kwa mimea. Chakula kingi ambacho sisi hula ni mimea. Bila mimea, wanyama hawawezi kuishi.
translations.hypothesis: Tunajenga nyumba zetu kwa kutumia mimea, na tunatengeneza nguo zetu pia kwa kutumia mimea. Chakula cha msingi ambacho tunakula kimetokana na mimea. Bila mimea, wanyama hawawezi kuishi.

translations.source: Mosasaurus was the apex predator of its time, so it feared nothing, except other mosasaurs.
translations.reference: Mosasaurus ilikuwa mwindaji mkubwa wa wakati huo, kwa hivyo haikuogopa chochote isipokuwa Mosasaurus wengine.
translations.hypothesis: Mosasaurus ilikuwa mnyama mkubwa na hatari zaidi katika enzi yake, hivyo haikuwahi kuogopa chochote, isipokuwa mosasaurs wengine.

translations.source: Its long jaws were studded with more than 70 razor-sharp teeth, along with an extra set in the roof of its mouth, meaning that there was no escape for anything that crossed its path.
translations.reference: Taya zake kubwa zilikuwa na zaidi ya meno 70 kali kama wembe, pamoja na seti ya ziada kwenye paa la mdomo wake, kumaanisha kwamba chochote kilichokutana naye hakingehepa.
translations.hypothesis: Kinywa chake kirefu kilikuwa na meno zaidi ya 70 ambayo yalikuwa makali kama vile kisu, pamoja na seti nyingine ya meno iliyokuwa kwenye ubavu wa mdomo wake, hivyo hakuna kiumbe chochote ambacho kilipita njia yake ambaye angeweza kuepuka hatari.

translations.source: We don't know for sure, but it may have had a forked tongue. Its diet included turtles, large fish, other mosasaurs, and it may even have been a cannibal.
translations.reference: Hatujui kwa kweli, lakini inaweza kuwa alikuwa na ulimi uliogawanyika. Lishe yake ni pamoja na kasa, samaki wakubwa, mosasau wengine, na labda anaweza kuwa kiumbe alaye wenziwe.
translations.hypothesis: Hatujui kwa uhakika, lakini inawezekana ilikuwa na mdomo uliofunikwa na sehemu mbili. Chakula chake kilikuwa na kobe, samaki wakubwa, wanyama wengine wa aina ya mosasaurus, na inawezekana hata ilikuwa inakula wanyama wa aina yake.

translations.source: It also attacked anything that entered the water; even a giant dinosaur such as T. rex would be no match for it.
translations.reference: Pia alishambulia chochote kilichoingia majini; hata dinosau mkubwa kama vile T. rex hangejimudu dhidi yake.
translations.hypothesis: Pia, ilishambulia chochote ambacho kingeingia ndani ya maji; hata dinosauru kubwa kama vile T. rex haingeweza kuipinga.

translations.source: While most of their food would be familiar to us, Romans did have their share of strange or unusual feast items, including wild boar, peacock, snails, and a type of rodent called a dormouse
translations.reference: Wakati nyingi ya vyakula vyao tunavifahamu, Warumi walikuwa na sehemu yao ya vitu vya karamu vya kushangaza au visivyo vya kawaida, pamoja na nguruwe mwitu, tausi, konokono, na aina ya panya inayoitwa dormouse
translations.hypothesis: Ingawa chakula cha Wairoma kilitambulika kwa watu wengi, walikuwa na pia vyakula vingine vya ajabu au visivyotarajiwa, kama vile nyama ya nguruwe wa porini, ndege wa aina ya "peacock," vitamba, na aina ya wanyama wadogo wanaoitwa "dormouse."

translations.source: Another difference was that while the poor people and the woman ate their food while sitting in chairs, the rich men liked to have banquets together where they would lounge on their sides while they ate their meals.
translations.reference: Tofauti nyingine ilikuwa kwamba huku watu masikini na mwanamke wakila chakula chao huku wameketi kwenye viti, watu tajiri walipenda kuwa na karamu pamoja ambapo wangepumzika kwa upande huku wakila vyakula vyao.
translations.hypothesis: Tofauti nyingine ilikuwa kwamba, wakati watu masikini na mwanamke walikuwa wakila chakula yao wakiwa wamekaa kwenye viti, watu matajiri walipenda kufanya karamu pamoja ambapo walikuwa wamegeuza miili yao upande wakati walipokuwa wakila.

translations.source: Ancient Roman meals couldn't have included foods that came to Europe from America or from Asia in later centuries.
translations.reference: Milo ya kale ya Kiroma haingejumuisha vyakula vilivyoingia Uropa kutoka Marekani au kutoka Asia katika karne za baadaye.
translations.hypothesis: Miliko ya zamani ya Wairoma haikuweza kujumuisha vyakula ambavyo vilikuja Ulaya kutoka Amerika au Asia katika karne za baadaye.

translations.source: For instance, they didn't have corn, nor tomatoes, nor potatoes, nor cocoa, and no ancient Roman ever tasted a turkey.
translations.reference: Kwa mfano, hawakuwa na mahindi, wala nyanya, wala viazi, wala kakao, na hakuna Mrumi wa zamani aliyewahi kuonja batamzinga.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa mfano, hawakuwa na mahindi, wala nyanya, wala viazi, wala kakao, na hakuna Mroma wa kale aliyewahi kuonja nyama ya tai.

translations.source: The Babylonians built each of their gods a primary temple that was considered the home of the god.
translations.reference: Wababeli waliwajengea kila mmoja wa miungu yao hekalu la msingi ambalo lilizingatiwa kuwa nyumba ya mungu huyo.
translations.hypothesis: Wazawa wa Babeli walijenga hekalu kuu kwa kila mmoja wa miungu yao, ambalo lilionekana kama makazi ya mungu huyo.

translations.source: People would bring sacrifices to the gods and the priests would try to attend to the needs of the gods through ceremonies and festivals.
translations.reference: Watu wangeleta dhabihu kwa miungu na makuhani wangejaribu kushughulikia mahitaji ya miungu kupitia sherehe na tamasha.
translations.hypothesis: Watu walileta matoleo kwa miungu, na makuhudumu walijaribu kutimiza mahitaji ya miungu kupitia sherehe na tamaduni mbalimbali.

translations.source: Each temple had an open temple courtyard and then an inner sanctuary that only the priests could enter.
translations.reference: Kila kasri lilikuwa na uwanja wazi wa kasri na kisha mahali pa ndani patakatifu ambamo ni makasisi tu wangeweza kuingia.
translations.hypothesis: Kila hekalu lina ukumbi wa nje ulio wazi, na kisha eneo la ndani ambalo tu makuhani ndio walikuwa wanaweza kuingia.

translations.source: Sometimes special pyramid shaped towers, called ziggurats, were built to be a part of the temples.
translations.reference: Wakati mwingine piramidi maalum zenye umbo la mnara, zinazoitwa ziggurat, zilijengwa ili ziwe sehemu ya hekalu.
translations.hypothesis: Mara nyingi, minara maalum yenye umbo la piramidi, ambayo huitwa "ziggurati," ilijengwa ili kuwa sehemu ya mahekalu.

translations.source: The top of the tower was special sanctuary for the god.
translations.reference: Sehemu ya juu ilikuwa makao matakatifu ya mungu.
translations.hypothesis: Kilele cha mnara ulikuwa mahali pa pekee ambapo mungu alikuwa akiabudiwa.

translations.source: In the warm climate of the Middle East, the house was not so important.
translations.reference: Katika hali joto ya hewa ya Mashariki ya Kati, nyumba haikuwa muhimu sana.
translations.hypothesis: Katika hali ya hewa ya joto ya Mashariki ya Kati, nyumba haikuwa muhimu sana.

translations.source: Most of the life of the Hebrew family happened in the open air.
translations.reference: Sehemu kubwa ya maisha ya familia ya Kiebrania ilifanyikia nje.
translations.hypothesis: Maisha ya familia ya Wayahudi yalifanyika hasa katika maeneo ya wazi.

translations.source: Women did the cooking in the yard; stores were just open counters looking into the street. Stone was used for building houses.
translations.reference: Wanawake walifanya mapishi kwenye yadi; stoo zilikuwa kaunta wazi tu zilizoelekea barabarani. Mawe yalitumika kujengea barabara.
translations.hypothesis: Wanawake ndio walikuwa wakipika katika eneo la nje; maduka yalikuwa tu mabanda madogo yenye counters ambazo zilikuwa zikiangalia barabara. Jiwe lilitumika kwa ajili ya kujenga nyumba.

translations.source: There were no large forests in the land of Canaan, so wood was extremely expensive.
translations.reference: Hakukua na misitu mikubwa kwenye ardhi ya Canaan, kwa hivyo mbao ziliuzwa kwa bei ghali mno.
translations.hypothesis: Hakukuwa na misitu mikubwa katika nchi ya Kanaan, kwa hivyo kuni ilikuwa ya bei ghali sana.

translations.source: Greenland was settled sparsely. In the Norse sagas they say that Erik the Red was exiled from Iceland for murder, and when travelling further west, found Greenland and named it Greenland.
translations.reference: Greenland ilikuwa na watu chache. Katika Norse sagas wanasema kwamba Erik aliye Mwekundu alifukuzwa kutoka Iceland kwa mauaji, na wakati wa kusafiri Magharibi zaidi, aliipata Greenland na kuiita Greenland.
translations.hypothesis: Greenland ilikuwa na idadi ndogo ya watu. Katika hadithi za Waiskandi, inasemekana kwamba Erik Mwekaji alifukuzwa kutoka Iceland kwa sababu ya mauaji, na alipokuwa akisafiri zaidi upande wa magharibi, aligundua Greenland na kuipa jina hilo.

translations.source: But regardless of his discovery, Eskimo tribes were already living there at the time.
translations.reference: Lakina licha ya ugunduzi wake, makabila ya Eskimo yalikuwa tayari yanaishi huko wakati huo.
translations.hypothesis: Hata hivyo, bila kujali ugunduzi wake, makabila ya Eskimo tayari yalikuwa wakiishi katika eneo hilo wakati huo.

translations.source: Though each country was 'Scandinavian', there were many differences between the people, kings, customs and history of Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Iceland.
translations.reference: Ingawa kila nchi ilikuwa ya 'Kiskandinavia', kulikuwa na tofauti nyingi kati ya watu, wafalme, mila na historia za Denmaki, Uswidi, Norway na Aislandi.
translations.hypothesis: Ingawa kila nchi ilikuwa "ya Scandinavia," kulikuwa na tofauti nyingi kati ya watu, wafalme, desturi na historia za Denmark, Uswidi, Norwe na Iceland.

translations.source: If you have watched the movie National Treasure, you may think a treasure map was written on the back of the Declaration of Independence.
translations.reference: Iwapo umetazama sinema ya Hazina ya Kitaifa, huenda ukafikiri ramani ya hazina iliandikwa nyuma ya Tangazo la Uhuru.
translations.hypothesis: Ikiwa umewahi kutazama filamu iitwayo "National Treasure," pengine unafikiri kwamba ramani ya hazina ilikuwa imeandikwa upande wa nyuma wa Azimio la Uhuru.

translations.source: However, that is not true. Although there is something written on the back of the document, it is not a treasure map.
translations.reference: Hata hivyo, hilo si kweli. Ingawa kuna kitu kilichoandikwa nyuma ya hati, si ramani ya hazina.
translations.hypothesis: Hata hivyo, hilo si kweli. Ingawa kuna kitu kilichoandikwa nyuma ya karatasi hiyo, si ramani ya hazina.

translations.source: Written on the back of the Declaration of Independence were the words "Original Declaration of Independence dated 4th July 1776". The text appears on the bottom of the document, upside down.
translations.reference: Nyuma ya Tangazo la Uhuru kuliandikwa maneno “Tangazo halisi la Uhuru la tarehe 4 Julai 1776”. Maandishi hayo yako katika sehemu ya chini ya hati, juu chini.
translations.hypothesis: Nyuma ya Azimio la Uhuru, kulikuwa na maneno "Azimio la Asili la Uhuru, lililoandikwa mnamo Julai 4, 1776." Nakala hiyo inaonekana chini ya hati, na imeandikwa kinyume.

translations.source: While no one knows for certain who wrote it, it is known that early in its life, the large parchment document (it measures 29¾ inches by 24½ inches) was rolled up for storage.
translations.reference: Wakati hakuna anayejua kwa hakika ni nani aliyeiandika, inajulikana kwamba hati hiyo kubwa ya ngozi (ina vipimo vya inchi 29¾ kwa inchi 24½) ilikunjwa kwa uhifadhi.
translations.hypothesis: Ingawa hakuna mtu anayejua kwa uhakika ni nani aliyeliandika hati hiyo, inajulikana kwamba katika kipindi cha awali cha maisha yake, hati hiyo kubwa iliyoandikwa kwenye karatasi (ambayo ina ukubwa wa inchi 29.75 kwa inchi 24.5) ilifungwa kwa umbo la bomba ili kuhifadhiwa.

translations.source: So, it is likely that the notation was added simply as a label.
translations.reference: Kwa hivyo, kuna uwezekano kuwa nukuu liliongezwa liwe kama ishara.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa hivyo, inawezekana kwamba alama hiyo iliongezwa tu kama lebo.

translations.source: The D-Day landings and the following battles had freed the north of France, but the south still wasn't free.
translations.reference: Utuaji siku ya shambulio na mapigano yaliyofuata yalikuwa yameweka huru kaskazini mwa Ufaransa, lakini kusini bado haikuwa huru.
translations.hypothesis: Urambazaji wa D-Day na mapigano yaliyofuata yaliwezesha uhuru wa kaskazini mwa Ufaransa, lakini kusini mwa nchi hiyo bado haikuwa huru.

translations.source: It was ruled by the "Vichy" French. These were French people who had made peace with the Germans in 1940 and worked with the invaders instead of fighting them.
translations.reference: Ilitawaliwa na Wafaransa wa “Vichy”. Hawa walikuwa watu wa Ufaransa ambao walikuwa wamefanya amani na Wajerumani mnamo 1940 na kufanya kazi na washambulizi badala ya kupigana nao.
translations.hypothesis: Wilaya hiyo ilitawaliwa na serikali ya "Vichy," ambayo ilikuwa serikali ya Wafaransa. Hawa ni Wafaransa ambao walifanya amani na Wajerumani mwaka wa 1940, na badala ya kupigana nao, walishirikiana na waingiliaji hao.

translations.source: On 15 August 1940, the Allies invaded southern France, the invasion was called "Operation Dragoon".
translations.reference: Mnamo Agosti 15 1940, Majeshi ya Kirafiki yalishambulia Ufaransa kusini, shambulio liliitwa "Operesheni Dragoon".
translations.hypothesis: Mnamo tarehe 15 Agosti, 1940, wanajeshi wa nchi za washirika walivamia sehemu ya kusini mwa Ufaransa. Operesheni hiyo ilijulikana kama "Operesheni Dragoon."

translations.source: In just two weeks the Americans and Free French forces had liberated southern France and were turning towards Germany.
translations.reference: Kwa kipindi cha majuma mawili tu vikosi vya Marekani na Ufaransa Huru vilikuwa vimekomboa Ufaransa kusini na vilikuwa vikielekea Ujerumani.
translations.hypothesis: Katika muda wa wiki mbili tu, vikosi vya Wamarekani na Wafaransa wa Kujitawala viliweza kuweka huru eneo la kusini mwa Ufaransa na kuanza kusonga kuelekea Ujerumani.

translations.source: A civilization is a singular culture shared by a significant large group of people who live and work co-operatively, a society.
translations.reference: Ustaarabu ni utamaduni wa umoja unaoshirikiwa na kundi kubwa la watu wanaoishi na kufanya kazi kwa kushirikiana, jamii.
translations.hypothesis: Tamaduni ni mfumo wa maisha na utamaduni fulani ambao hushirikiwa na kundi kubwa la watu wanaishi na kufanya kazi pamoja, yaani, jamii.

translations.source: The word civilization comes from the Latin civilis, meaning civil, related to the Latin civis, meaning citizen, and civitas, meaning city or city-state, and that also somehow defines the size of the society.
translations.reference: Neno ustaarabu hutoka katika civilis la Kilatini, ambalo linamaanisha ya kiraia, linalohusiana na civis la Kilatini, linalomaanisha raia, na civitas, linalomaanisha mji au jimbo la mji, na ambalo kwa namna fulani linaelezea ukubwa wa jamii.
translations.hypothesis: Neno "tamaduni" linatokana na neno la Kilatini "civilis," ambalo linamaanisha "waadili" au "husiana na jamii," na linatokana na maneno ya Kilatini "civis," ambayo yanamaanisha "mwananchi," na "civitas," ambayo yanamaanisha "mji" au "jimbo la mji," na hivyo pia linaeleza saizi ya jamii.

translations.source: City-states are the precursors of nations. A civilizational culture implies the passing on of knowledge across several generations, a lingering cultural footprint and fair dissemination.
translations.reference: Majimbo ya miji hutanguliza mataifa. Utamaduni wa kistaarabu huashiria kupitishwa kwa maarifa katika vizazi kadhaa, wayo wa kitamaduni unaoendelea kukaa kwa muda na usambazaji wenye haki.
translations.hypothesis: Jimbo-jimbo lililokuwa na serikali yake yenyewe ndilo msingi wa mataifa. Utamaduni wa jamii una maana ya kupitisha ujuzi kutoka kizazi kimoja hadi kingine, kuacha alama ya utamaduni, na kusambaza ujuzi huo kwa njia ya haki.

translations.source: Minor cultures often vanish without leaving relevant historic evidence and fail to be recognized as proper civilizations.
translations.reference: Tamaduni ndogo mara nyingi hutoweka bila kuacha ushahidi muhimu wa kihistoria na kukosa kutambuliwa kama ustaarabu barabara.
translations.hypothesis: Tamaduni ndogo mara nyingi hupotea bila kuacha ushahidi muhimu wa kihistoria, na hivyo kushindwa kutambuliwa kama tamaduni kamili na zenye utamaduni.

translations.source: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen states first formed a weak central government—with the Congress being its only component—under the Articles of Confederation.
translations.reference: Wakati wa Vita vya Mapinduzi, majimbo kumi na matatu kwanza yaliunda serikali dhaifu ya kati – huku Bunge la Marekani likiwa ndiyo sehemu yake pekee – chini ya Vifungu vya Shirikisho.
translations.hypothesis: Wakati wa Vita vya Mapinduzi, majimbo kumi na tatu yaliunda kwanza serikali ya kitaifa dhaifu—ambayo ilikuwa na Baraza pekee—kwa mujibu wa Mkataba wa Shirikisho.

translations.source: Congress lacked any power to impose taxes, and, because there was no national executive or judiciary, it relied on state authorities, who were often uncooperative, to enforce all its acts.
translations.reference: Kongamano lilikosa uwezo wowote wa kuweka ushuru, na, kwa sababu hakukuwa na mtendaji wa kitaifa au mahakama, lilitegemea mamlaka ya taifa, ambao mara nyingi hawakuwa na ushirikiano, kutekeleza sheria zake.
translations.hypothesis: Bunge lilikuwa halina mamlaka yoyote ya kuweka kodi, na, kwa sababu hakukuwa na serikali ya kitaifa au mahakama, lilitegemea mamlaka za majimbo, ambazo mara nyingi hazikutaka kushirikiana, ili kutekeleza sheria zake zote.

translations.source: It also had no authority to override tax laws and tariffs between states.
translations.reference: Pia haikuwa na mamlaka ya kupuuza sheria na orodha za ushuru kati ya majimbo.
translations.hypothesis: Pia, ilikuwa hana mamlaka yoyote ya kufuta sheria za kodi na ada za biashara kati ya majimbo.

translations.source: The Articles required unanimous consent from all the states before they could be amended and states took the central government so lightly that their representatives were often absent.
translations.reference: Vifungu vilihitaji ridhaa ya pamoja kutoka kwa majimbo yote kabla ya kurekebishwa na majimbo yalichukulia serikali kuu kwa mzaha sana kiasi kwamba mara nyingi wawakilishi wao hawakuwepo.
translations.hypothesis: Katika nyakati hizo, marekebisho ya Katiba yahitajika kupitishwa kwa idadi ya kura ya wananchi wote kutoka katika majimbo yote, na majimbo yaliyokuwa yakiwaona serikali kuu kama kitu kisicho muhimu kiasi kwamba wawakilishi wao mara nyingi hawakuwa wamehudhuria.

translations.source: Italy's national football, along with German national football team is the second most successful team in the world and were the FIFA World Cup champions in 2006.
translations.reference: Timu ya soka ya Italia, pamoja na timu ya soka ya Ujerumani ndiyo timu ya pili yenye mafanikio zaidi duniani na ilikuwa bingwa wa kikombe cha dunia cha FIFA mwaka wa 2006.
translations.hypothesis: Timu ya taifa ya soka ya Italia, pamoja na timu ya taifa ya soka ya Ujerumani, ni mojawapo ya timu zenye mafanikio makubwa zaidi duniani, na ilikuwa mshindi wa Kombe la Dunia la FIFA mwaka wa 2006.

translations.source: Popular sports include football, basketball, volleyball, water-polo, fencing, rugby, cycling, ice hockey, roller hockey and F1 motor racing.
translations.reference: Michezo maarufu ni pamoja na kandanda, mpira wa kikapu, mpira wa wavu, polo ya majini, mchezo wa uzio, raga, uendeshaji baiskeli, hoki ya barafu, hoki ya gogo na mashindano ya magari ya F1.
translations.hypothesis: Mchezo maarufu ni pamoja na mpira wa miguu, mpira wa kikapu, mpira wa voliboli, mpira wa maji, ruka, rugby, baiskeli, hoki ya barafu, hoki ya gurudumu na mbio za magari za F1.

translations.source: Winter sports are most popular in the Northern regions, with Italians competing in international games and Olympic events.
translations.reference: Spoti za msimu wa baridi ni maarufu sana katika maeneo ya Kaskazini, ambako Waitaliano hushindana katika michezo ya kimataifa na ya Olimpiki.
translations.hypothesis: Mchezo wa msimu wa baridi una umaarufu mkubwa katika kanda za kaskazini, ambapo Witaliano hushiriki katika mashindano ya kimataifa na hafla za Olimpiki.

translations.source: Japans holds nearly 7,000 islands (the biggest being Honshu), making Japan the 7th largest island in the world!
translations.reference: Japani humiliki visiwa karibu 7,000 (kikubwa zaidi kikiwa Honshu), hivyo kuifanya Japani kuwa kisiwa cha 7 kikubwa zaidi duniani!
translations.hypothesis: Japan ina visiwa takriban 7,000 (na kisiwa kikubwa zaidi ni Honshu), na hivyo kuifanya Japan kuwa nchi ya saba kwa ukubwa wa visiwa duniani!

translations.source: Due to the cluster/group of islands Japan has, Japan is often referred to, on a geographical stance, as an "archipelago"
translations.reference: Kwa sababu ya mafungu/vikundi vya visiwa Japani ilivyo navyo, mara nyingi Japani huitwa, kwa msimamo wa kijiografia, "funguvisiwa"
translations.hypothesis: Kwa sababu Japani ina kundi la visiwa, mara nyingi, kulingana na jiografia, Japani inarejelewa kama "visiwa vya pamoja" au "arkipelago."

translations.source: Taiwan beginning start way back in 15th century where European sailors passing by record the island’s name as Ilha Formosa, or beautiful island.
translations.reference: Taiwan ilianza nyuma kitambo katika karne ya 15 ambapo mabaharia wa Kiingereza wanaopita hurekodi jina la kisiwa hicho kama Ilha Formosa, au kisiwa kizuri.
translations.hypothesis: Historia ya Taiwan ilianza karne ya 15, wakati mabaharia wa Ulaya ambao walipita eneo hilo walirekodi jina la kisiwa hicho kama "Ilha Formosa," ambayo inamaanisha "Kisiwa Kipendeleo" au "Kisiwa kizuri."

translations.source: In 1624,Dutch East India Company establishes a base in southwestern Taiwan, initiating a transformation in aboriginal grain production practices and employing Chinese laborers to work on its rice and sugar plantations.
translations.reference: Mnamo 1624, kampuni ya Dutch East India ilianzisha msingi kusini magharibi mwa Taiwan, kuanzisha mabadiliko katika mazoea ya uzalishaji wa nafaka na kuwaajili wafanyakazi wa Kichina kufanya kazi kwenye mashamba ya mpunga na sukari.
translations.hypothesis: Mnamo mwaka wa 1624, Kampuni ya Uholanzi ya Mashariki mwa Asia ilianzisha kambi katika eneo la kusini-magharibi mwa Taiwan, na hivyo kuanzisha mabadiliko katika njia za uzalishaji wa nafaka za makabila ya asili, na pia ilitumia wafanyakazi kutoka China kufanya kazi katika mashamba yake ya mpunga na sukari.

translations.source: In 1683, Qing dynasty (1644-1912) forces take control of Taiwan’s western and northern coastal areas and declared Taiwan as a province of the Qing Empire in 1885.
translations.reference: Mnamo 1683, vikosi vya nasaba ya Qing (1644-1912) vilichukua udhibiti wa maeneo ya pwani ya magharibi na kaskazini ya Taiwan na kutangaza Taiwan kama mkoa wa Milki ya Qing mnamo 1885.
translations.hypothesis: Mnamo mwaka wa 1683, majeshi ya nasaba ya Qing (iliyotawala kuanzia mwaka wa 1644 hadi 1912) yaliingia na kukamata maeneo ya pwani ya magharibi na kaskazini ya Taiwan, na mwaka wa 1885, Taiwan ilitangazwa kama mkoa wa himaya ya Qing.

translations.source: In 1895, after defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), the Qing government signs the Treaty of Shimonoseki, by which it cedes sovereignty over Taiwan to Japan, which rules the island until 1945.
translations.reference: Mnamo 1895, baada ya kushindwa katika vita vya kwanza vya Sino-Japani (1894-1895), serikali ya Qing yatia sahihi mkataba wa Shimonoseki, ambao kwao inadhihirisha uhuru juu ya Taiwan hadi Japani, ambayo inaongoza kisiwa hadi 1945.
translations.hypothesis: Mnamo mwaka wa 1895, baada ya kushindwa katika Vita vya Kwanza vya Sino-Kijapani (1894-1895), serikali ya Qing ilisaini Mkataba wa Shimonoseki, ambapo ilitoa uongozi wa kisiwa cha Taiwan kwa Japani, ambayo ilikuwa ikitawala kisiwa hicho hadi mwaka wa 1945.

translations.source: Machu Picchu consist of three main structures, namely Intihuatana, the Temple of the Sun, and the Room of the Three Windows.
translations.reference: Machu Picchu ina mifumo kuu mitatu, kwa majina Intihuatana, Hekalu la Jua, na Chumba chenye Madirisha Matatu.
translations.hypothesis: Machu Picchu ina miundo mitatu mikuu, ambayo ni Intihuatana, Hekalu la Jua, na Chumba cha Madirisha Matatu.

translations.source: Most of the buildings on the edges of the complex have been rebuilt in order to give tourists a better idea of how they originally appeared.
translations.reference: Nyumba nyingi kwenye kingo za majengo hayo tata zilijengwa upya ili kuwapa watalii taswira bora ya jinsi zilivyokuwa mwanzoni.
translations.hypothesis: Baadhi ya majengo yaliyokuwa pembezoni ya eneo hilo yamejengwa upya ili kuwapa watalii picha bora ya jinsi yalivyokuwa awali.

translations.source: By 1976, thirty percent of Machu Picchu had been restored and restoration continues till today.
translations.reference: Kufikia mwaka wa 1976, asilimia thelathini ya Machu Picchu ilikuwa imerejeshwa na urejesho unaendelea hadi leo.
translations.hypothesis: Ifikapo mwaka wa 1976, asilimia thelathini ya eneo la Machu Picchu lilikuwa limekamilishwa ukarabati, na kazi ya ukarabati inaendelea hadi leo.

translations.source: For example, the most common still image photography format in the world is 35mm, which was the dominant film size at the close of the analog film era.
translations.reference: Kwa mfano, umbizo la upigaji picha tuli wa kawaida zaidi duniani ni milimita 35, ambayo ndiyo iliyokuwa saizi kuu ya filamu katika zama za sinema za kikale.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa mfano, muundo wa kawaida zaidi wa picha za tuli duniani kote ni wa 35mm, ambao ulikuwa ukubwa wa filamu unaotumika sana wakati wa mwisho wa enzi ya teknolojia ya filamu.

translations.source: It is still produced today, but more importantly its aspect ratio has been inherited by digital camera image sensor formats.
translations.reference: Bado inatolewa hadi wa leo, lakini kwa umuhimu zaidi uwiano wa kipengele chake umerithiwa na umbizo za kihisio cha picha za kamera za kidijitali.
translations.hypothesis: Bado hutengenezwa hadi leo, lakini muhimu zaidi, uwiano wake wa upana na urefu umekabidhiwa na mifumo ya sensorer za picha za kamera za kidijitali.

translations.source: The 35mm format is actually, somewhat confusingly, 36mm in width by 24mm in height.
translations.reference: Muundo wa 35mm kwa kweli, kwa kiasi Fulani unachanganya, 36mm kwa upana na 24mm kwa urefu.
translations.hypothesis: Format ya 35mm, ingawa jina lake linaweza kuchanganya, kwa kweli ina upana wa milimita 36 na urefu wa milimita 24.

translations.source: The aspect ratio of this format (dividing by twelve to obtain the simplest whole-number ratio) is therefore said to be 3:2.
translations.reference: Uwiano-vipimo wa muundo huu (kugawa na kumi na mbili ili kupata uwiano rahisi zaidi wa namba kamili) basi husemekana kuwa 3:2.
translations.hypothesis: Uwiano wa picha wa muundo huu (unaopatikana kwa kugawanya na kumi na mbili ili kupata uwiano rahisi wa namba nzima) kwa hivyo unaitwa 3:2.

translations.source: Many common formats (APS family of formats, for example) are equal to or closely approximate this aspect ratio.
translations.reference: Miundo mingi ya kawaida (familia ya APS ya miundoi, kwa mfano) ni sawa na au takribani sawa na uwiano huu.
translations.hypothesis: Miundo mingi ya kawaida (kama vile familia ya miundo ya APS) ina uwiano sawa au karibu sawa na uwiano huu.

translations.source: The much-abused and often-ridiculed rule of thirds is a simple guideline creating dynamism while keeping a measure of order in an image.
translations.reference: Sheria ya thuluthi inayotumiwa vibaya na kudhihakiwa mara nyingi ni mwongozo rahisi unaounda uwezo huku ukidumisha kiwango cha mpango katika picha.
translations.hypothesis: Kanuni ya "tatu," ambayo mara nyingi hutumika vibaya na hata kudhihakiwa, ni mwongozo rahisi ambao huleta uhai na msisimko katika picha, huku bado ukihifadhi utaratibu fulani.

translations.source: It states that the most effective place for the main subject is at the intersection of lines dividing the image into thirds vertically and horizontally (see example).
translations.reference: Inasema kwamba mahali palipo na athari kubwa kwa mada kuu ni katika mkutano wa mistari inayogawanya picha kwa thuluthi wima na mshazari (tazama mfano).
translations.hypothesis: Inasema kwamba sehemu bora zaidi ya kuweka mada kuu ni katika eneo ambapo mistari inayogawanya picha katika sehemu tatu kwa mwelekeo wima na usawa hukutana (angalia mfano).

translations.source: During this period of European history, the Catholic Church, which had become rich and powerful, came under scrutiny.
translations.reference: Katika kipindi hiki cha historia ya Ulaya, Kanisa Katoliki, ambalo lilikuwa tajiri na lenye nguvu, likawa chini ya uchunguzi.
translations.hypothesis: Katika kipindi hiki cha historia ya Ulaya, Kanisa Katoliki, ambacho kilikuwa kimekuwa matajiri na lenye nguvu, kilianza kukabiliwa na uchunguzi na ukosoaji.

translations.source: For over a thousand years the Christian religion had bound European states together despite differences in language and customs. I
translations.reference: kwa zaidi ya miaka elfu moja dini ya Kikristo imefunga majimbo ya Uropa pamoja licha ya kuwa na lugha na mila tofauti. I
translations.hypothesis: Kwa zaidi ya miaka elfu moja, dini ya Kikristo ilikuwa ikifunga nchi za Ulaya pamoja, licha ya tofauti katika lugha na desturi.

translations.source: Its all-pervading power affected everyone from king to commoner.
translations.reference: Nguvu zake zilizoenea kote ziliathiri wote toka mfalme hadi mtu wa kawaida.
translations.hypothesis: Nguvu yake iliyokuwa imemiminika kila mahali ilikuwa na athari kwa kila mtu, kuanzia mfalme hadi raia wa kawaida.

translations.source: One of the main Christian tenets is that wealth should be used to alleviate suffering and poverty and that the monetary funds of the church are there specifically for that reason.
translations.reference: Mojawapo ya kanuni kuu za Kikristo ni kwamba mali inafaa kutumika kupunguza mateso na umasikini na kwamba hazina za kifedha za kanisa ziko hapo hususan kwa sababu hiyo.
translations.hypothesis: Moja ya mambo muhimu ya imani ya Kikristo ni kwamba utajiri unapaswa kutumika kupunguza mateso na umaskini, na kwamba fedha za kanisa zimetengwa hasa kwa ajili ya kusudi hilo.

translations.source: The central authority of the church had been in Rome for over a thousand years and this concentration of power and money led many to question whether this tenet was being met.
translations.reference: Mamlaka kuu ya kanisa yalikuwa katika Roma kwa zaidi ya miaka elfu na uwepo huu wa mamlaka na pesa katika sehemu moja ulipelekea wengi kuuuliza kama itikadi hii ilikuwa ikitekelezwa.
translations.hypothesis: Mkuu wa kanisa, ambao kwa muda wa zaidi ya miaka elfu moja umekuwa akiishi mjini Roma, na ukusanyaji huu wa nguvu na pesa ulipelekea wengi kuuliza kama kanuni hii ilikuwa inatiwa nguvu.

translations.source: Soon after the outbreak of hostilities, Britain initiated a naval blockade of Germany.
translations.reference: Baada tu ya kuzuka kwa uhasama, Uingereza ilianzisha kizuizi cha kinevi dhidi ya Ujerumani.
translations.hypothesis: Mara tu baada ya mapigano kuanza, Uingereza ilianza kuzingirisha pwani ya Ujerumani kwa vikosi vya jeshi lake la baharini.

translations.source: The strategy proved effective, cutting off vital military and civilian supplies, although this blockade violated generally accepted international law codified by several international agreements of the past two centuries.
translations.reference: Mkakati ulikuwa na ufanisi, kukatisha vifaa muhimu vya kijeshi na kiraia, ingawa kizuizi hiki kilikiuka sheria ya kimataifa ambayo inakubaliwa kwa jumla iliyoratibiwa na mikataba kadhaa ya kimataifa katika karne mbili zilizopita.
translations.hypothesis: Mkakati huo ulionekana kuwa na matokeo, kwani ulizuia usafirishaji wa vifaa muhimu kwa jeshi na wananchi, ingawa kuzuiliwa huku kulitenda kinyume na sheria za kimataifa zilizokubalika kwa kawaida na zilizorekodiwa katika makubaliano mbalimbali ya kimataifa ya karne mbili zilizopita.

translations.source: Britain mined international waters to prevent any ships from entering entire sections of ocean, causing danger to even neutral ships.
translations.reference: Uingereza ilitega mabomu kwenye maji ya kimataifa ili kuzuia meli zozote kuingia sehemu nzima za bahari, hivyo kuweka hatari hata kwa meli zisizoegemea upande wowote.
translations.hypothesis: Uingereza ilikuwa na madini katika maji ya kimataifa ili kuzuia meli zozote kuingia katika maeneo fulani ya bahari, na hivyo kusababisha hatari hata kwa meli ambazo hazikuwa zikiunga mkono upande wowote.

translations.source: Since there was limited response to this tactic, Germany expected a similar response to its unrestricted submarine warfare.
translations.reference: Kwa kuwa kulikuwa na mwitikio mdogo kwa mbinu hii, Ujerumani ilitarajia majibu kama hayo kwa vita vyake ambavyo havijazuiliwa vya chini ya bahari.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa sababu mbinu hiyo ilipata majibu madogo, Ujerumani ilitarajia majibu kama hayo pia kwa vita yake isiyo na kikomo dhidi ya meli za baharini.

translations.source: During the 1920s, the prevailing attitudes of most citizens and nations was that of pacifism and isolation.
translations.reference: Katika miaka ya 1920, mtazamo wa raia na mataifa mengi uliotawala ulikuwa wa upatanisho na utengaji.
translations.hypothesis: Katika miaka ya 1920, mtazamo wa kawaida wa watu wengi na mataifa ilikuwa huo wa amani na kujitenga.

translations.source: After seeing the horrors and atrocities of war during World War I, nations desired to avoid such a situation again in the future.
translations.reference: Baada ya kuona mambo ya kuogofya na ukatili wa vita wakati wa Vita vya Kwanza vya Dunia, mataifa yalitamani kuepuka hali kama hiyo tena wakati ujao.
translations.hypothesis: Baada ya kushuhudia maovu na uhalifu mwingi wa vita wakati wa Vita vya Kwanza vya Dunia, mataifa yalitaka kuepuka hali kama hiyo tena katika siku zijazo.

translations.source: In 1884, Tesla moved to the United States of America to accept a job with the Edison Company in New York City.
translations.reference: Katika mwaka wa 1884, Tesla alihamia Marekani kukubali kazi katika kampuni ya Edison katika Jiji la New York.
translations.hypothesis: Mnamo mwaka wa 1884, Tesla alihamia Marekani ili kukubali kazi katika kampuni ya Edison iliyokuwa ikitumika mjini New York.

translations.source: He arrived in the US with 4 cents to his name, a book of poetry, and a letter of recommendation from Charles Batchelor (his manager in his previous job) to Thomas Edison.
translations.reference: Aliwasili Marekani na peni 4 tu, kitabu cha mashairi, na barua ya kupendekeza kutoka kwa Charles Batchelor (meneja wake katika ajira yake ya awali) kwa Thomas Edison.
translations.hypothesis: Alifika Marekani akiwa na dola 4 pekee, kitabu cha mashairi, na barua ya pendekezo kutoka kwa Charles Batchelor (aliye kuwa meneja wake katika kazi yake ya awali) iliyomwendea Thomas Edison.

translations.source: Ancient China had a unique way of showing different time periods; each stage of China or each family that was in power was a distinctive dynasty.
translations.reference: Uchina ya kale ilikuwa na njia ya kipekee ya kuonyesha vipindi tofauti vya wakati; kila hatua ya Uchina au kila familia iliyokuwa mamlakani ilikuwa nasaba maalumu.
translations.hypothesis: China ya kale ilikuwa na njia ya kipekee ya kuonyesha vipindi tofauti vya historia; kila kipindi au kila familia iliyokuwa ikiongoza nchi ilikuwa na nguvu yake ya pekee, ambayo ilijulikana kama nasaba.

translations.source: Also between each dynasty was an unstable age of divided provinces. The best-known of these periods was the Three Kingdoms epoch taking place for 60 years between the Han and the Jin Dynasty.
translations.reference: Pia kati ya kila nasaba kilikuwa kipindi kisicho na msimamo cha majimbo yaliyogawanyika. Maarufu sana kati ya vipindi hivi ilikuwa enzi za Falme Tatu za ya Han na Jin.
translations.hypothesis: Pia, kati ya kila nasaba, kulikuwa na kipindi kisicho imara cha majimbo yaliyotawaliwa kwa kujitenga. Mojawapo ya vipindi hivyo maarufu zaidi ilikuwa kipindi cha "Nchi Tatu," ambacho kilidumu kwa miaka 60 kati ya nasaba za Han na Jin.

translations.source: During these periods fierce warfare took place between many nobles fighting for the throne.
translations.reference: Wakati wa vipindi hivi vita vikali vilifanyika kati ya waangwana wakipigania kiti cha enzi.
translations.hypothesis: Katika kipindi hicho, vita kali zilitokea kati ya mabwana wengi ambao walikuwa wakipigania kiti cha enzi.

translations.source: The Three Kingdoms was one of the bloodiest eras in Ancient China’s history thousands of people died fighting to sit in the highest seat in the grand palace at Xi’an.
translations.reference: Falme Tatu ilikuwa enzi yenye umwagaji damu zaidi katika historia ya China ya Kale, maelfu ya watu walikufa wakipigania kuketi kwenye kiti cha juu zaidi katika ikulu ya Xi'an.
translations.hypothesis: "Enzi ya Falme Tatu ilikuwa mojawapo ya vipindi vya vurugu zaidi katika historia ya China ya kale, ambapo maelfu ya watu waliuawa wakipigania nafasi ya kuwa kiongozi mkuu katika ukumbi mkuu wa jengo hilo lililopo Xi'an."

translations.source: There are a lot of social and political effects such as the use of metric system, a shift from absolutism to republicanism, nationalism and the belief the country belongs to the people not to one sole ruler.
translations.reference: Kuna athari nyingi za kijamii na kisiasa kama vile utumiaji wa mfumo wa metriki, mabadiliko kutoka kwa msimamo wa udikteta hadi ujamhuri, utaifa na imani kuwa inchi ni ya watu si ya mtawala mmoja pekee.
translations.hypothesis: Kuna athari nyingi za kijamii na za kisiasa, kama vile utumiaji wa mfumo wa metri, mabadiliko kutoka kwa utawala wa kimfumo hadi utawala wa jamhuri, kitaifa, na imani kwamba nchi ni ya watu, si ya mtu mmoja pekee.

translations.source: Also after the Revolution occupations were open to all male applicants allowing the most ambitious and successful to succeed.
translations.reference: Pia baada ya Mapinduzi kazi ilikuwa wazi kwa waombaji wote wa kiume, hivyo kuruhusu waliojitakia makuu na wenye mafanikio kufaulu.
translations.hypothesis: Pia, baada ya Mapinduzi, nafasi za kazi ziliwazi kwa wanaume wote wanaohitaji, na hivyo kuruhusu wale walio na ambizioni kubwa na waliofanikiwa zaidi kupata nafasi hizo.

translations.source: Same goes for the military because instead of army rankings being based on class they were now based on cailaber.
translations.reference: Vilevile kwa wanajeshi kwa sababu badala ya madaraka ya kijeshi kutegemea darasa sasa yanategemea sifa.
translations.hypothesis: Hali hiyo hiyo ilikuwa pia katika jeshi, kwa sababu badala ya cheo cha askari kuamriwa na daraja la elimu, sasa cheo kilitegemea uwezo na ustadi wa mtu.

translations.source: The French Revolution also inspired many other repressed working class people of other country's to began their own revolutions.
translations.reference: Mapinduzi ya Kifaransa pia yalichochea wafanyakazi wengine wengi wa nchi nyingine waliokandamizwa kuanza mapinduzi yao wenyewe.
translations.hypothesis: Mapinduzi ya Ufaransa pia yaliwahamasisha watu wengi wengine wa tabaka la wafanyakazi waliofanyiwa dhuluma katika nchi nyingine kuanza mapinduzi yao wenyewe.

translations.source: Muhammad was deeply interested in matters beyond this mundane life. He used to frequent a cave that became known as “Hira‘” on the Mountain of “Noor” (light) for contemplation.
translations.reference: Muhammad alivutiwa sana na mambo zaidi ya maisha haya ya kawaida. Alikuwa akitembelea sana pango ambalo lilikuja kujulikana kama "Hira" katika mlima wa "Noor" (nuru) kwa kutafakari.
translations.hypothesis: Muhammad alikuwa na nia kubwa katika mambo ambayo yalizidi maisha ya kawaida. Alikuwa mara nyingi huenda katika pango lililojulikana kama "Hira'" lililopo kwenye Mlima "Noor" (wa nuru), ili kufanya tafakari.

translations.source: he cave itself, which survived the times, gives a very vivid image of Muhammad’s spiritual inclinations.
translations.reference: Pango lenyewe, ambalo lilinusurika nyakati, hutoa picha dhahiri ya mielekeo ya kiroho ya Muhammad.
translations.hypothesis: Pango hilo, ambalo limeendelea kuwepo hadi leo, linatoa picha wazi sana kuhusu mwelekeo wa kiroho wa Muhammad.

translations.source: Resting on the top of one of the mountains north of Mecca, the cave is completely isolated from the rest of the world.
translations.reference: Likiwa juu ya mojawapo ya milima kaskazini mwa Mecca, pango hilo limetengwa kabisa na ulimwengu.
translations.hypothesis: Kwenye kilele cha moja ya milima kaskazini mwa Mecca, kiko pango ambalo kimeachiliwa kabisa kutoka kwa sehemu nyingine yoyote ya dunia.

translations.source: In fact, it is not easy to find at all even if one knew it existed. Once inside the cave, it is a total isolation.
translations.reference: Kwa kweli, si rahisi kupata kamwe hata kama mtu alijua ipo. Ukishaingia kwenye pango, umetengwa kabisa.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa kweli, ni vigumu sana kupata mahali hapo, hata kama mtu anajua kwamba mahali hapo lipo. Mara tu unapoingia ndani ya pango, unapata hali ya kutengwa kabisa.

translations.source: Nothing can be seen other than the clear, beautiful sky above and the many surrounding mountains. Very little of this world can be seen or heard from inside the cave.
translations.reference: Hakuna kingine kinachoweza kuonekana ila anga safi na nzuri huko juu na milima mingi inayolizunguka. Ni machache sana ya dunia hii yanayoweza kuonwa au kusikiwa ndani ya pango hili.
translations.hypothesis: Hakuna chochote cha kuonekana isipokuwa anga safi na nzuri iliyo juu, na milima mingi iliyozunguka. Kwa bahati mbaya, sehemu ndogo sana ya ulimwengu huu inaweza kuonekana au kusikika kutoka ndani ya pango.

translations.source: The Great Pyramid at Giza is the only one of the seven wonders that is still standing today.
translations.reference: Piramidi kuu katika Giza ndiyo ya pekee ya maajabu saba ambayo bado inasimama leo.
translations.hypothesis: Piramidi Kubwa ya Giza ndiyo mojawapo ya maajabu saba ambayo bado imesimama hadi leo.

translations.source: Built by the Egyptians in the third century BCE, the Great Pyramid is one of many large pyramid structures built to honor dead Pharaoh.
translations.reference: Piramidi Kuu iliyojengwa na Wamisri katika karne ya tatu BCE ni mojawapo ya majengo makubwa yaliyojengwa kwa heshima ya Firauni waliofariki.
translations.hypothesis: Piramidi Kubwa, iliyojengwa na Waajabu wa Misri katika karne ya tatu kabla ya Kristo, ni mojawapo ya miundo mingi mikubwa ya piramidi iliyojengwa ili kuheshimu wafalme wa zamani (Farao) waliokufa.

translations.source: The Giza Plateau, or "Giza Necropolis" in the Egyptian Valley of the Dead contains several pyramids (of which the great pyramid is the largest), several small tombs, several temples, and the great Sphinx.
translations.reference: Kilima cha Giza, au "Giza Necropolis" katika Bonde la Wafu la Misri kina piramidi kadhaa (ambazo piramidi kuu ni kubwa zaidi), makaburi kadhaa madogo, hekalu kadhaa, na Sphinx kuu.
translations.hypothesis: Eneo la Giza, au "Makaburi ya Giza" katika Bonde la Wafu wa Misri, lina piramidi kadhaa (ambapo piramidi kubwa ndiyo kubwa zaidi), makaburi madogo kadhaa, mahekalu kadhaa, na sanamu kubwa ya Sphinx.

translations.source: The great pyramid was created to honor the Pharaoh Khufu, and many of the smaller pyramids, tombs, and temples were built to honor Khufu's wives and family members.
translations.reference: Piramidi kuu iliundwa ili kumheshimu Firauni Khufu, na piramidi, makaburi na mahekalu mengine mengi madogo yalijengwa ili kuheshimu wake na wanafamilia wa Khufu.
translations.hypothesis: Piramidi kubwa ilijengwa ili kumheshimu Farao Khufu, na piramidi nyingi ndogo, makaburi, na mahekalu yalijengwa ili kumheshimu wake na wafamilia wa Khufu.

translations.source: The "up bow" mark looks like a V and the "down bow mark" like a staple or a square missing its bottom side.
translations.reference: Alama ya "gubeti la juu" inaonekana kama V na "alama ya gubeti la chini" kama kibanio au mraba unaokosa upande wake wa chini.
translations.hypothesis: Alama "ya juu" inaonekana kama herufi "V," na alama "ya chini" inaonekana kama klipu au mraba ambapo upande wa chini umepotea.

translations.source: Up means you should start at the tip and push the bow, and down means you should start at the frog (which is where your hand is holding the bow) and pull the bow.
translations.reference: Juu inamaanisha unapaswa kuanzia nchani na kusukuma uta, na chini inamaanisha unafaa kuanzia kwenye frog (mahali ambapo mkono wako unashikilia uta) na kuvuta uta.
translations.hypothesis: "Up" inamaanisha kwamba unapaswa kuanza kutoka kwenye sehemu ya juu (ya upinde) na kusukuma upinde, na "down" inamaanisha kwamba unapaswa kuanza kutoka kwenye sehemu ya chini (ya upinde, ambapo mkono wako unashikilia upinde) na kuvuta upinde.

translations.source: An up-bow usually generates a softer sound, while a down-bow is stronger and more assertive.
translations.reference: Upinde wa juu kwa kawaida huzalisha sauti tulivu, huku upinde wa chini ukiwa na nguvu na ni imara zaidi.
translations.hypothesis: Mara nyingi, wakati wa kucheza ala kwa kuinua bow, sauti inakuwa laini zaidi, huku wakati wa kushusha bow, sauti huwa nguvu zaidi na ina uhakika zaidi.

translations.source: Feel free to pencil in your own marks, but remember the printed bowing marks are there for a musical reason, so they should usually be respected.
translations.reference: Jisikie huru kuandika kwa penseli alama zako, lakini kumbuka alama za kuinama zilizochapwa ziko kwa sababu ya kimziki, kwa hivyo yafaa ziheshimiwe.
translations.hypothesis: Hakuna shida kuandika alama zako mwenyewe kwa penseli, lakini kumbuka kuwa alama za "bowing" (alama ambazo zinaonyesha jinsi ya kutumia bow kwenye chombo cha muziki) zimeandikwa kwa sababu fulani za muziki, kwa hivyo kwa kawaida zinapaswa kuzingatiwa.

translations.source: The terrified King Louis XVI, Queen Marie Antoinette their two young children (11 year old Marie Therese and four year old Louis-Charles) and the King's sister, Madam Elizabeth, on the 6th October 1789 were forced back to Paris from Versailles by a mob of market women.
translations.reference: Mfalme Louis XVI, Malkia Marie Antoinette, watoto wao wawili wadogo (Marie Therese mwenye umri wa miaka 11 na Louis Charles mwenye umri wa miaka minne) na dada ya mfalme Bibi Elizabeth waliojawa na hofu, mnamo Oktoba 6 1789 walilazimishwa kurudi Paris kutoka Versailles na umati wa wanawake wa sokoni.
translations.hypothesis: Mfalme Louis XVI, Malkia Marie Antoinette, watoto wao wawili wadogo (Marie Therese mwenye umri wa miaka 11 na Louis-Charles mwenye umri wa miaka 4), na dada wa mfalme, Bi. Elizabeth, walilazimishwa kurudi Paris kutoka Versailles mnamo Oktoba 6, 1789, na kundi la wanawake waliohusika na biashara.

translations.source: In a carriage, they traveled back to Paris surrounded by a mob of people screaming and shouting threats against the King and Queen.
translations.reference: Katika gari la kukokotwa, walisafiri kuelekea Paris wakiwa wamezungukwa na umati wa watu waliopiga nduru na kutoa vitisho kwa Mfalme na Malkia kwa sauti kubwa.
translations.hypothesis: Wakiwa ndani ya gari, walirudi Paris wakizungukwa na kundi la watu ambao walikuwa wakipiga kelele na kutishia mfalme na malkia.

translations.source: The mob of people forced the King And Queen to have their carriage windows wide open.
translations.reference: Umati wa watu uliwalazimisha Mfalme Na Malkia kufungua madirisha ya gari lao.
translations.hypothesis: Kundi kubwa la watu walimlazimisha mfalme na malkia kufungua madirisha ya gari yao ili waonekane wazi.

translations.source: At one point a member of the mob waved the head of a royal guard killed at Versailles in front of the terrified Queen.
