translations.reference: Kwa wakati mmoja memba wa umati alipunga kichwa cha mlinzi mmoja wa kifalme aliyeuawa katika Versailles mbele ya Malkia aliyejawa na hofu.
translations.hypothesis: Katika hatua moja, mmoja wa watu waliofanya vurugu alinyanyua kichwa cha askari mmoja wa kifalme aliyeuawa huko Versailles, na kuliweka mbele ya Malkia aliyeogopa sana.

translations.source: The war expenditures of U.S. imperialism in the conquest of the Philippines were paid for by the Filipino people themselves.
translations.reference: Matumizi ya kivita kwa ubeberu wa Marekani katika ushindi dhidi ya Ufilipino yaligharimiwa na watu wa Ufilipino wenyewe.
translations.hypothesis: Matumizi ya fedha za vita ya serikali ya Marekani, iliyotumia nguvu ili kuinyakua nchi ya Pilipino, ylilipwa na watu wa Pilipino wenyewe.

translations.source: They were compelled to pay taxes to the U.S. colonial regime to defray a major part of the expenditures and the interest on bonds floated in the name of the Philippine government through the Wall Street banking houses.
translations.reference: Walilazimishwa kulipa kodi kwa serikali ya wakoloni ya Amerika ili kugharamia sehemu kubwa ya matumizi na riba juu ya dhamana zilizowekwa kwa jina la serikali ya Ufilipino kupitia nyumba za benki za Wall Street.
translations.hypothesis: Walilazimika kulipa kodi kwa serikali ya kikoloni ya Marekani ili kufidia sehemu kubwa ya matumizi na riba ya madeni ambayo yalichukuliwa kwa jina la serikali ya Philippines kupitia taasisi za benki za Wall Street.

translations.source: Of course, the superprofits derived from the protracted exploitation of the Filipino people would constitute the basic gains of U.S. imperialism.
translations.reference: Bila shaka, faida kubwa kutokana na dhuluma za muda mrefu za watu wa Ufilipino ziliunda mapato ya msingi ya ubeberu wa Marekani.
translations.hypothesis: Hakika, faida kubwa inayotokana na uonevu wa muda mrefu wa watu wa Filipino itakuwa faida kuu ya utawala wa kimfumo wa Marekani.

translations.source: To understand the Templars one must understand the context that prompted the creation of the order.
translations.reference: Ili kuelewa templar ni lazima mtu aelewe muktadha ambao ulisababisha uundaji wa agizo.
translations.hypothesis: Ili kuelewa Templari, ni muhimu kuelewa mazingira ambayo yalisababisha kuundwa kwa shirika hilo.

translations.source: The age where the events took place is commonly referred as the High Middle Ages the period of European history in the 11th, 12th, and 13th centuries (AD 1000–1300).
translations.reference: Kipindi ambacho matukio yalitokea kwa kawaida hujulikana kama Enzi za Juu za kati, kipindi katika historia ya Ulaya katika Karne za 11, 12, na 13 (1000-1300 Baada ya Kristo).
translations.hypothesis: Enzi ambazo matukio hayo yalifanyika kwa kawaida huitwa "Enzi ya Kati ya Juu," ambayo ni kipindi katika historia ya Ulaya kilichoanzia karne ya 11, kupitia karne ya 12, hadi karne ya 13 (takriban kutoka mwaka 1000 hadi 1300).

translations.source: The High Middle Ages were preceded by the Early Middle Ages and followed by the Late Middle Ages, which by convention ends around 1500.
translations.reference: Enzi za Juu za Kati zilitanguliwa na Enzi za Mapema za Kati na kufuatiwa na Enzi za Mwisho za Kati, ambazo kwa mapatano zinaishia karibu 1500.
translations.hypothesis: Zama za Kati za juu zilitanguliwa na zama za kati za mapema na zilikufuatiwa na zama za kati za mwishoni, ambazo, kwa kawaida, zinaishia takribani mwaka wa 1500.

translations.source: Technological determinism is a term that encompasses a wide range of ideas in practice, from technology-push or the technological imperative to a strict sense that human destiny is driven by an underlying logic associated with scientific laws and their manifestation in technology.
translations.reference: Uainishaji wa kiufundi ni kishazi ambacho hujumuisha maoni anuai katika mazoezi, kutoka teknolojia shinikizi, au maendeleo ya kiteknolojia katika dhana kuwa hatma ya binadamu huendeshwa na mantiki ya msingi inayohusishwa na sheria za kisayansi na udhihirisho wake katika teknolojia.
translations.hypothesis: Utabiri wa teknolojia ni neno linalojumuisha mawazo mbalimbali katika utendaji, kuanzia "msukumo wa teknolojia" au "lazima ya kiteknolojia" hadi mtazamo wa dhabiti kwamba hatima ya binadamu inadumishwa na mantiki ya msingi inayohusiana na sheria za kisayansi na jinsi sheria hizo zinavyoonekana katika teknolojia.

translations.source: Most interpretations of technological determinism share two general ideas: that the development of technology itself follows a path largely beyond cultural or political influence, and that technology in turn has "effects" on societies that are inherent, rather than socially conditioned.
translations.reference: Tafsiri nyingi za udhibitisho wa kiteknolojia zinashirikisha maoni mawili ya jumla: kwamba maendeleo ya teknolojia yenyewe hufuata njia zaidi ya ushawishi wa kitamaduni au kisiasa, na teknolojia hiyo kwa upande ina "athari" kwa jamii ambazo ni za asili, badala ya hali ya kijamii.
translations.hypothesis: Tafsiri nyingi za dhana ya "utekelezaji wa teknolojia" zina mawazo mawili makuu: kwamba maendeleo ya teknolojia yenyewe yanafuata njia ambayo kwa kiasi kikubwa haathiriki na mambo ya kitamaduni au ya kisiasa, na kwamba teknolojia, kwa upande wake, ina "athari" kwenye jamii ambazo ni za asili, badala ya kuwa zimetokana na mambo ya kijamii.

translations.source: For example, one might say that the motor car necessarily leads to the development of roads.
translations.reference: Kwa mfano, mtu anaweza kusema kwamba motokaa hupelekea ukuzaji wa barabara.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa mfano, mtu anaweza kusema kwamba magari ya kawaida huleta matokeo ya lazima ya ujenzi wa barabara.

translations.source: However, a nationwide road network is not economically viable for just a handful of cars, so new methods of production are developed to reduce the cost of car ownership.
translations.reference: Hata hivyo, mfumo wa kitaifa wa barabara hufai kiuchumi kwa magari machache tu, kwa hivyo mbinu mpya za uzalishaji zinakuzwa ili kupunguza gharama ya umiliki wa magari.
translations.hypothesis: Hata hivyo, mfumo wa barabara unaofikia kila kona ya nchi hauwezi kuwa na faida ya kiuchumi ikiwa unatumika na magari machache tu. Ndiyo maana mbinu mpya za utengenezaji zinaendelezwa ili kupunguza gharama za kumiliki gari.

translations.source: Mass car ownership also leads to a higher incidence of accidents on the roads, which leads to the invention of new techniques in healthcare for repairing damaged bodies.
translations.reference: Umiliki wa magari kwa wingi pia hupelekea matukio mengi ya ajali za barabarani, ambazo hupelekea uvumbuzi wa mbinu mpya katika matibabu za kutengeneza miili iliyovunjika.
translations.hypothesis: Ukubali mkubwa wa watu kumiliki magari pia husababisha ongezeko la ajali barabarani, jambo ambalo linapelekea uvumbuzi wa mbinu mpya katika huduma za afya ili kutibu majeraha.

translations.source: Romanticism had a large element of cultural determinism, drawn from writers such as Goethe, Fichte, and Schlegel.
translations.reference: Uroma ulikuwa na kipengele kikubwa cha maamuzi ya kitamaduni yaliyochochewa na waandishi kama vile Goethe, Fichte na Schlegel.
translations.hypothesis: Utabirishi (Romanticism) ulikuwa na sehemu kubwa ya uamuzi wa kitamaduni, iliyotokana na waandishi kama vile Goethe, Fichte, na Schlegel.

translations.source: In the context of Romanticism, the geography molded individuals, and over time customs and culture related to that geography arose, and these, being in harmony with the place of the society, were better than arbitrarily imposed laws.
translations.reference: Katika muktadha wa Uroma, jiografia ilifinyanga watu, na kwa mpito wa wakati mila na tamaduni zilizohusiana na jiografia zilizuka, na hizi, zikiwa zinapatana na hali ya jamii, zilikuwa bora kuliko sheria zilizolazimishwa kiholela.
translations.hypothesis: Katika muktadha wa mtindo wa kifasihi unaojulikana kama "Romanticism," mazingira yalikuwa na jukumu kubwa katika kuunda tabia za watu. Kwa muda, desturi na tamaduni zinazohusiana na mazingira hayo zilikua, na kwa kuwa zilikuwa zimeendana na maisha ya jamii, zilikuwa bora kuliko sheria ambazo zilitawaliwa kwa njia ya lazima bila kuzingatia mazingira.

translations.source: In the manner that Paris is known as the fashion capital of the contemporary world, Constantinople was regarded as the fashion capital of feudal Europe.
translations.reference: Jinsi Paris inavyojulikana kama mji mkuu wa mitindo wa ulimwengu wa kisasa, Konstantinople ilichukuliwa kuwa mji mkuu wa mitindo wa Uropa ya kikabaila.
translations.hypothesis: Kama vile Paris inajulikana kama kituo kikuu cha mitindo katika ulimwengu wa kisasa, hivyo Constantinople ilionekana kama kituo kikuu cha mitindo katika Ulaya ya zamani.

translations.source: Its renown for being an epicenter of luxury began in about 400 A.D. and lasted up until about 1100 A.D.
translations.reference: Inajulikana kwa kuwa kitovu cha anasa ilianza takribani 400 A.D. na ilidumu hadi karibu 1100 A.D.
translations.hypothesis: Kutokana na umaarufu wake kama kitovu cha utajiri, eneo hilo lilianza kuwa maarufu takriban mwaka wa 400 A.D. na umarufu huo uliendelea hadi takriban mwaka wa 1100 A.D.

translations.source: Its status declined during the twelfth century mainly due to the fact that Crusaders had returned bearing gifts such as silks and spices that were valued more than what Byzantine markets offered.
translations.reference: Hali yake ilizorota wakati wa karne ya kumi na mbili hasa kwa sababu ya ukweli kwamba Wapambanaji wa kidini walikuwa wamerejea na zawadi kama vile hariri na viungo vilivyokuwa na thamani ya juu kuliko vile vilivyotolewa na masoko ya Bizanti.
translations.hypothesis: Hali yake ilidhoofika katika karne ya kumi na mbili, hasa kwa sababu waasi wa Kikristo walirudi nyumbani wakiletea zawadi kama vile mahindi na viungo ambavyo vilikuwa na thamani kubwa kuliko bidhaa ambazo soko la Byzantium lilitoa.

translations.source: It was at this time that the transfer of the title of Fashion Capital from Constantinople to Paris was made.
translations.reference: Ilikuwa wakati huu ambapo uhamisho wa Jiji la Mtindo kutoka Konstantinopo hadi Parisi ulifanyika.
translations.hypothesis: Ni katika kipindi hicho ambapo uhamisho wa taji la "Mji Mkuu wa Mitindo" kutoka Constantinople hadi Paris ulifanyika.

translations.source: Gothic style peaked in the period between the 10th - 11th centuries and the 14th century.
translations.reference: Staili ya Kigothi ilifikia kilele katika kipindi kati ya karne za 10-11 na karne ya 14.
translations.hypothesis: Msanii wa usanifu wa Gothic ulifikia kilele chake katika kipindi kilichokuwa kati ya karne ya 10 na 11 na karne ya 14.

translations.source: At the beginning dress was heavily influenced by the Byzantine culture in the east.
translations.reference: Hapo mwanzoni mavazi yaliathiriwa na tamaduni za Baizantini kutoka mashariki.
translations.hypothesis: Hapo awali, mitindo ya nguo ilikuwa imeathiriwa sana na utamaduni wa Bizantine katika eneo la mashariki.

translations.source: However, due to the slow communication channels, styles in the west could lag behind by 25 to 30 year.
translations.reference: Hata hivyo, kwa sababu ya njia hafifu za mawasiliano, mitindo ya magharibi ilibakia nyuma kwa miaka 25 hadi 30.
translations.hypothesis: Hata hivyo, kutokana na mfumo wa mawasiliano ambao ni polepole, mitindo iliyoundwa katika Magharibi inaweza kuchelewa kufika katika maeneo mengine kwa takriban miaka 25 hadi 30.

translations.source: towards the end of the Middle Ages western Europe began to develop their own style. one of the biggest developments of the time as a result of the crusades people began to use buttons to fasten clothing.
translations.reference: Kuelekea mwishoni mwa Zama za Kati Uropa magharibi ilianza kuendeleza staili yao wenyewe. Mojawapo ya maendeleo makubwa zaidi ya wakati huo kama matokeo ya krusedi watu walianza kutumia vifungo kukazia nguo.
translations.hypothesis: Karibu mwisho wa Enzi za Kati, Ulaya Magharibi ilianza kuendeleza mtindo wake wa kipekee. Moja ya maendeleo makubwa ya wakati huo, kutokana na vita vya Wakatoliki, ni kwamba watu walianza kutumia vifungo ili kufunga nguo.

translations.source: Subsistence agriculture is agriculture carried out for the production of enough food to meet just the needs of the agriculturalist and his/her family.
translations.reference: Kilimo cha kujikimu ni kilimo ambacho hufanywa kwa uzalishaji wa chakula cha kutosha tu kukimu mahitaji ya mkulima na familia yake.
translations.hypothesis: Kilimo cha kujitegemea ni kilimo ambacho hufanywa ili kuzalisha kiasi cha chakula cha kutosha ili kuendana na mahitaji ya mkulima na familia yake tu.

translations.source: Subsistence agriculture is a simple, often organic, system using saved seed native to the ecoregion combined with crop rotation or other relatively simple techniques to maximize yield.
translations.reference: Kilimo cha kujikimu ni mfumo rahisi, aghalabu wa kikaboni, unaotumia mbegu zilizohifadhiwa na asilia kwa eneo husika, pamoja na mzunguko wa mimea au mbinu mbadala zilizo rahisi ili kuboresha mavuno.
translations.hypothesis: Kilimo cha kujitegemea ni mfumo rahisi, ambao mara nyingi hutumia mbinu za kilimo hai (bila kemikali), unaotumia mbegu zilizohifadhiwa ambazo ni za asili ya eneo hilo, pamoja na mbinu za mzunguko wa mazao au mbinu nyingine rahisi ili kuongeza uzalishaji.

translations.source: Historically most farmers were engaged in subsistence agriculture and this is still the case in many developing nations.
translations.reference: Kihistoria, wakulima wengi walijihusisha na kilimo cha kujikimu na hii bado ndiyo hali katika mataifa mengi yanayoendelea.
translations.hypothesis: Kihistoria, wakulima wengi walishiriki katika kilimo cha kujitegemea, na hali hiyo bado ni ya kawaida katika nchi nyingi zinazoendelea.

translations.source: Subcultures bring together like-minded individuals who feel neglected by societal standards and allow them to develop a sense of identity.
translations.reference: Utamaduni mdogo huwaleta pamoja watu walio wa mafikira sawa na ambao wanahisi kuwa wametengwa na viwango vya kijamii na kuwaruhusu kuendeleza hisia za utambulisho.
translations.hypothesis: Tamaduni ndogo huleta pamoja watu wenye fikra sawa ambao huhisi kuwa hawana umuhimu katika jamii na huwapa fursa ya kutambua na kuendeleza hisia ya utu wao.

translations.source: Subcultures can be distinctive because of the age, ethnicity, class, location, and/or gender of the members.
translations.reference: Vikundi vidogo vya tamaduni vinaweza kuwa vya kipekee kwa sababu ya umri, kabila, daraja, eneo, na/au jinsia ya washiriki.
translations.hypothesis: Tamaduni ndogo zinaweza kuwa tofauti kwa sababu ya umri, kabila, hadhi ya kijamii, eneo, na/au jinsia ya washiriki wake.

translations.source: The qualities that determine a subculture as distinct may be linguistic, aesthetic, religious, political, sexual, geographical, or a combination of factors.
translations.reference: Sifa zinazofanya utamaduni mdogo kuwa wa kipekee huenda zikawa za kilugha, kiurembo, kidini, kisiasa, kijiografia au mchanganyiko wa vipengele.
translations.hypothesis: Sifa ambazo huweza kutofautisha utamaduni mdogo kutoka kwa utamaduni mwingine zinaweza kuwa lugha, mbinu za sanaa, dini, siasa, masuala ya ngono, eneo, au mchanganyiko wa mambo haya.

translations.source: Members of a subculture often signal their membership through a distinctive and symbolic use of style, which includes fashions, mannerisms, and argot.
translations.reference: Wanachama wa utamaduni mdogo mdogo kwa mara nyingi huashiria uanachama wao kupitia mitindo ya kipekee ambayo ni pamoja na mitindo ya kimavazi, tabia na lugha.
translations.hypothesis: Wanachama wa kikundi fulani cha watu mara nyingi huonyesha kuwa wamo katika kikundi hicho kwa kutumia mtindo maalum na unaoashiria, ambao unaweza kujumuisha mitindo ya nguo, tabia, na lugha maalum.

translations.source: One of the most common methods used to illustrate the importance of socialization is to draw upon the few unfortunate cases of children who were, through neglect, misfortune, or wilful abuse, not socialized by adults while they were growing up.
translations.reference: Mojawapo ya mbinu maarufu zinatozumiwa kuonyesha umuhimu wa kushirikiana ni kutumia mifano michache sikitishi ya watoto ambao, kupitia mapuuza, mikosi, kunyanyaswa kimakusudi, hawakushirikishwa na watu wazima walipokuwa wanapokua.
translations.hypothesis: Mojawapo ya mbinu za kawaida ambazo hutumika kuonyesha umuhimu wa ushirikiano wa kijamii ni kutumia mifano michache ya watoto ambao, kutokana na ulinzi usiofaa, bahati mbaya, au unyanyasaji wa makusudi, hawajapata ushirikiano wa kijamii kutoka kwa watu wazima wakati walipokuwa wakikua.

translations.source: Such children are called "feral" or wild. Some feral children have been confined by people (usually their own parents); in some cases this child abandonment was due to the parents' rejection of a child's severe intellectual or physical impairment.
translations.reference: Watoto kama hao huitwa "katili" au jeuri. Watoto wengine katili wamefungwa na watu (kwa kawaida wazazi wao wenyewe); katika hali nyingine huu kuachwa kwa watoto kulitokana na wazazi kukataa upungufu mkubwa wa kiakili au mwili kwa mtoto.
translations.hypothesis: Watoto hao huaitwa "wasio na mazingira ya kawaida" au "wasio na utamaduni." Baadhi ya watoto hao wamefungwa na watu (kawaida wazazi wao); katika baadhi ya matukio, utakatili huu kwa mtoto ulitokana na wazazi kukataa mtoto kutokana na ulemavu mkubwa wa akili au kimwili.

translations.source: Feral children may have experienced severe child abuse or trauma before being abandoned or running away.
translations.reference: Huenda watoto wasiotagusana walipitia unyanyasaji mkuu au kiwewe utotoni mwao kabla ya kuachiliwa au kutoroka.
translations.hypothesis: Watoto ambao huishi bila uangalizi wa watu wazima huenda wamekuwa wakiteswa au wamepitia matukio mabaya kabla ya kuachwa au kuondoka nyumbani.

translations.source: Others are alleged to have been brought up by animals; some are said to have lived in the wild on their own.
translations.reference: Wengine wanadaiwa kulewa na wanyama; wengine wanasemekana kuishi porini kivyao.
translations.hypothesis: Wengine wanasemekana kuishi na wanyama; na wengine pia wanasemekana kuishi peke yao katika maeneo ya porini.

translations.source: When completely brought up by non-human animals, the feral child exhibits behaviors (within physical limits) almost entirely like those of the particular care-animal, such as its fear of or indifference to humans.
translations.reference: Anapolelewa kabisa na wanyama wasio wa kibinadamu, mtoto katili huonyesha tabia (ndani ya mipaka ya kimwili) karibu kabisa kama zile za mnyama mahsusi wa utunzaji, kama vile hofu au upurukushani wake kwa wanadamu.
translations.hypothesis: Mtoto ambaye amekulia kabisa na wanyama wasio na akili, huonyesha tabia (kwa kiasi ambacho mwili wake unaweza kuvumilia) ambazo ni karibu kabisa kama za wanyama ambao wamemlea, kama vile hofu yake au kutojali kwa watu.

translations.source: While project based learning should make learning easier and more interesting, scaffolding goes a step beyond.
translations.reference: Wakati elimu ya msingi wa mradi kunapaswa kufanya elimu kuwa rahisi na ya kupendeza zaidi, udungu huenda hatua zaidi.
translations.hypothesis: Ingawa kujifunza kupitia miradi inapaswa kurahisisha na kufanya masomo kuwa ya kuvutia zaidi, mfumo wa "scaffolding" huenda mbali zaidi.

translations.source: Scaffolding is not a method of learning but rather an aid that provides support to individuals whom are undergoing a new learning experience such as using a new computer program or beginning a new project.
translations.reference: Mbinu za mafunzo si njia ya kusoma lakini huduma ambayo hutoa usaidizi kwa watu ambao wanapitia hali mpya ya masomo kama vile kutumia programu mpya ya kompyuta au kuanza mradi mpya.
translations.hypothesis: Usaidizi wa ziada (scaffolding) siyo mbinu ya kujifunza, bali ni msaada ambao huwapa watu ambao wanaendelea na uzoefu mpya wa kujifunza, kama vile kutumia programu mpya ya kompyuta au kuanza mradi mpya.

translations.source: Scaffolds can be both virtual and real, in other words, a teacher is a form of scaffold but so is the little paperclip man in Microsoft Office.
translations.reference: Majukwaa yanaweza kuwa dhahiri na pia halisi, kwa maneno mengine, mwalimu ni aina ya jukwaa lakini pia ndivyo kilivyo kile kijitu cha karatasi katika Microsoft Office.
translations.hypothesis: Vifaa vya usaidizi vinaweza kuwa vya aina mbili: vya kweli na vya virtual. Kwa maneno mengine, mwalimu ni aina ya kifaa cha usaidizi, lakini vile vile, aikoni ndogo ya "kibindoni" (paperclip) katika programu ya Microsoft Office pia ni aina ya kifaa cha usaidizi.

translations.source: Virtual Scaffolds are internalized in the software and are meant to question, prompt, and explain procedures that may have been to challenging for the student to handle alone.
translations.reference: Majukwaa Pepe yamewekwa ndani ya programu kwa kusudi la kuhoji, kushawishi, na kuelezea taratibu ambazo huenda zilikuwa changamoto kubwa kwa mwanafunzi kushughulikia peke yake.
translations.hypothesis: Mifumo ya usaidizi wa programu (virtual scaffolds) yamejumuishwa ndani ya programu na yamekusudiwa kutoa maswali, kuhamasisha, na kueleza taratibu ambazo zinaweza kuwa ngumu sana kwa mwanafunzi kufanya peke yake.

translations.source: Children are placed in Foster Care for a wide variety of reasons that range from neglect, to abuse, and even to extortion.
translations.reference: Watoto huwekwa kwenye Huduma ya Malezi kwa sababu nyingine nyingi ambazo huanzia kutelekezwa hadi kudhulumiwa na hata unyang’anyi.
translations.hypothesis: Watoto huwekwa katika familia za kulelea kwa sababu mbalimbali, kuanzia ulinzi dhidi ya ulinzi usiofaa, unyanyasaji, na hata ulaghai.

translations.source: No child should ever have to grow up in an environment that is not nurturing, caring, and educational, but they do.
translations.reference: Hakuna mtoto anayepaswa kukua katika mazingira ambayo hayaelimishi, huyajali, hayafundishi, lakini wanafanya hivyo.
translations.hypothesis: Hakuna mtoto ambaye aangaliwe kuishi katika mazingira ambayo hayatoa malezi, upendo, na elimu, lakini, kwa bahati mbaya, kuna watoto wengi wanaopitia hivyo.

translations.source: We perceive the Foster Care System to be a safety zone for these children.
translations.reference: Tunadhania Mfumo wa Huduma ya Kulea kuwa eneo la usalama kwa watoto hawa.
translations.hypothesis: Tunaona mfumo wa utunzaji wa watoto kama eneo salama kwa watoto hawa.

translations.source: Our foster care system is supposed to provide safe homes, loving caregivers, stable education, and reliable health care.
translations.reference: Makazi ya watoto yanastahili kutoa makao salama, walezi wenye upendo, elimu imara, na mfumo wa afya unaoaminika.
translations.hypothesis: Mfumo wetu wa kulinda watoto yatima unapaswa kutoa makazi salama, walezi wenye upendo, elimu thabiti, na huduma za afya za kuaminika.

translations.source: Foster care is supposed to provide all the necessities that were lacking in the home they were previously taken from.
translations.reference: Makazi ya watoto yanastahili kutoa mahitaji haya yote ambayo yalikosekana nyumbani walikotolewa awali.
translations.hypothesis: Malezi ya muda (yaani, utunzaji wa watoto nje ya familia yao) inalenga kutoa mahitaji yote ambayo hayakupatikana katika nyumba ambapo mtoto alitoka hapo awali.

translations.source: The Internet combines elements of both mass and interpersonal communication.
translations.reference: Mtandao unachanganya vitu vya mawasiliano ya kundi la watu na ya kati ya mtu na mtu.
translations.hypothesis: Mtandao huunganisha vipengele vya mawasiliano ya umma na mawasiliano ya baina ya watu.

translations.source: The distinct characteristics of the Internet lead to additional dimensions in terms of the uses and gratifications approach.
translations.reference: Tabia za kipekee za mtandao hupelekea vipimo zaidi kuhusu matumizi na mbinu za kuridhisha.
translations.hypothesis: Sifa za kipekee za mtandao huleta vipengele vipya katika suala la matumizi na manufaa yake.

translations.source: For example, “learning” and “socialization” are suggested as important motivations for Internet use (James et al., 1995).
translations.reference: Kwa mfano, "kujifunza" na "ushirikiano" kunapendekezwa kama vichochezi muhimu kwa matumizi ya mtandao (James na wengine, 1995).
translations.hypothesis: Kwa mfano, "ujifunzaji" na "mawasiliano ya kijamii" zimetajwa kama sababu muhimu za kutumia intaneti (James na wengine, 1995).

translations.source: “Personal involvement” and “continuing relationships” were also identified as new motivation aspects by Eighmey and McCord (1998) when they investigated audience reactions to websites.
translations.reference: Kushiriki kwa kibinafsi na "mahusiano endelezi" pia yalitambuliwa na Eighmey na McCord (1998) kama vipengele vipya vya motisha walipichunguza mjibizo wa hadhira katika tovuti.
translations.hypothesis: "Ushiriki wa mtu binafsi" na "uhusiano unaoendelea" pia zilitambuliwa kama vipengele vipya vya motisha na Eighmey na McCord (1998) wakati walipofanya utafiti kuhusu majibu ya watumiaji kwa tovuti za mtandao.

translations.source: The use of video recording has led to important discoveries in the interpretation of micro-expressions, facial movements which last a few milliseconds.
translations.reference: Matumizi ya video za kurekodi imesababisha uvumbuzi muhimu katika tafsiri ya sauti ndogo, kusongeshwa kwa uso ambao hudumu sekunde ndogo kadhaa.
translations.hypothesis: Matumizi ya teknolojia ya kurekodi video yamechangia ugunduzi muhimu katika tafsiri ya alama ndogo za uso, ambazo ni harakati za uso ambazo hudumu kwa milisekundi chache tu.

translations.source: In particular, it is claimed that one can detect whether a person is lying by interpreting micro-expressions correctly.
translations.reference: Hususan, inadaiwa kuwa mtu anaweza kutambua ikiwa mtu anadanganya kwa kufasiri ishara ndogondogo kwa njia sahihi.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa hasa, inaadaiwa kwamba mtu anaweza kubaini kama mtu anadanganya kwa kutafsiri kwa usahihi alama ndogo za uso.

translations.source: Oliver Sacks, in his paper The President's Speech, indicated how people who are unable to understand speech because of brain damage are nevertheless able to assess sincerity accurately.
translations.reference: Oliver Sacks, katika gazeti lake Hotuba ya Rais, alionyesha namna watu ambao hawawezi kuelewa hotuba kutokana na uharibifu wa ubongo hata hivyo wana uwezo kwa kutathmini ukweli kwa usahihi.
translations.hypothesis: Oliver Sacks, katika makala yake "Hotuba ya Rais," alionyesha jinsi watu ambao hawana uwezo wa kuelewa hotuba kutokana na uharibifu wa ubongo, bado wanaweza kutambua kwa usahihi kama mtu anazungumza kwa ukweli au la.

translations.source: He even suggests that such abilities in interpreting human behavior may be shared by animals such as domestic dogs.
translations.reference: Hata anapendekeza kwamba uwezo kama huo wa kufasiri tabia za binadamu unaweza kushirikishwa wanyama kama vile mbwa wa kufugwa.
translations.hypothesis: Hata anadai kwamba uwezo huo wa kutafsiri tabia ya binadamu unaweza kuwa pia katika wanyama kama vile mbwa wa kiasili.

translations.source: Twentieth century research has shown that there are two pools of genetic variation: hidden and expressed.
translations.reference: Utafiti wa karne ya ishirini umeonyesha kwamba kuna makundi mawili ya utofauti wa jeni: fiche na zilizoelezewa.
translations.hypothesis: Utafiti wa karne ya ishirini umeonyesha kwamba kuna aina mbili za tofauti za kijeni: zile ambazo hazionekani (zilizofichwa) na zile ambazo zinaonekana (zilizojidhihirisha).

translations.source: Mutation adds new genetic variation, and selection removes it from the pool of expressed variation.
translations.reference: Mabadiliko huongeza tofauti za kimaumbile, na uchaguzi huyaondoa katika mkusanyiko wa tofauti zilizoonyeshwa.
translations.hypothesis: Mabadiliko ya kijeni huongeza aina mpya za maumbile, na uchaguzi huondoa baadhi ya aina hizo kutoka kwenye makundi ya maumbile yanayoweza kuonekana.

translations.source: Segregation and recombination shuffle variation back and forth between the two pools with each generation.
translations.reference: Mabadiliko ya uchangaji ya utengaji na uchanganyaji tena huku na huko kati ya vidimbwi hivyo viwili kwa kila kizazi.
translations.hypothesis: Tofautia za jenetiki huhamishiwa mbele na nyuma kati ya makundi mawili hayo kila kizazi, kutokana na mchakato wa segregasyon na recombination.

translations.source: Out on the savanna, it is hard for a primate with a digestive system like that of humans to satisfy its amino-acid requirements from available plant resources.
translations.reference: Nje kwenye savana, ni vigumu kwa wanyama wakuu waliyo na mfumo wa kuyeyusha chakula tumboni kama wa binadamu kutoshelezeza mahitaji ya tindikali-za-amino zao kutoka kwa vifaa vya mimea vilivyomo
translations.hypothesis: Katika eneo wazi la savana, ni vigumu kwa wanyama aina ya primati wenye mfumo wa kumeng'enya kama wa binadamu kukidhi mahitaji yao ya protini kwa kutumia tu vyanzo vya mimea vinavyopatikana.

translations.source: Moreover, failure to do so has serious consequences: growth depression, malnutrition, and ultimately death.
translations.reference: Waaidha, kukosa kufanya hivyo kuna matokeo mazito: udidimiaji wa ukuaji, utapiamlo, na hatimaye kifo.
translations.hypothesis: Zaidi ya hayo, kushindwa kufanya hivyo kuna matokeo mabaya: kupungua kwa ukuaji, lishe mbaya, na hatimaye, kifo.

translations.source: The most readily accessible plant resources would have been the proteins accessible in leaves and legumes, but these are hard for primates like us to digest unless they are cooked.
translations.reference: Rasilimali za mimea zinazofikiwa kwa urahisi zingekuwa protini zinazopatikana katika majani na kunde, lakini hizi ni ngumu kwa wale wa kundi la mammalia wa hali ya juu kama sisi kusaga isipokuwa kama zimepikwa.
translations.hypothesis: Rasilimali za mimea ambazo zilikuwa rahisi kupata ni pamoja na protini zilizokuwa ziko kwenye majani na mbegu za mimea, lakini ni vigumu kwa wanyama kama sisi kuchimba protini hizo isipokuwa zimetayarishwa kwa kupikwa.

translations.source: In contrast, animal foods (ants, termites, eggs) not only are easily digestible, but they provide high-quantity proteins that contain all the essential amino acids.
translations.reference: Kwa kulinganisha, vyakula vya wanyama (siafu, mchwa, mayai) si kwamba vinameng’enywa kwa urahisi tu, lakini pia hutoa protini zenye kiwango kikubwa ambazo zina asidi muhimu za amino.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa kulinganisha, vyakula vya wanyama (makundi, mende, mayai) sio tu rahisi kuchomwa, lakini pia hutoa protini nyingi ambazo zina asidi zote muhimu.

translations.source: All things considered, we should not be surprised if our own ancestors solved their "protein problem" in somewhat the same way that chimps on the savanna do today.
translations.reference: Mambo yote yakizingatiwa, hatupaswi kushangaa kama wahenga wetu walitatua “shida yao ya protini” kwa njia sawa na zile nyani wa savanna hufanya leo.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa ujumla, hatupaswi kushangazwa kama mababu zetu walipata suluhisho kwa "tatizo lao la protini" kwa njia sawa na ambavyo simpanzi wanaopatikana kwenye savana hufanya leo.

translations.source: Sleep interruption is the process of purposefully awakening during your normal sleep period and falling asleep a short time later (10–60 minutes).
translations.reference: Ukatizaji wa usingizi ni mchakato wa kuamka kimakusudi wakati wa usingizi wako wa kawaida na kupatwa na usingizi muda mfupi baadaye (dakika 10-60).
translations.hypothesis: Katika mchakato wa kusumbua usingizi, mtu hulazimishwa kuamka wakati wa kipindi cha kawaida cha usingizi, na kisha kulala tena baada ya muda mfupi (dakika 10 hadi 60).

translations.source: This can be easily done by using a relatively quiet alarm clock to bring you to consciousness without fully waking you.
translations.reference: Hili linaweza kufanywa kwa kutumia saa ya kengele isiyo na kelele kubwa sana ili kukufanya upate fahamu bila kukuamsha kabisa.
translations.hypothesis: Hii inaweza kufanyika kwa urahisi kwa kutumia saa ya kuamka ambayo hutoa sauti ndogo ili kukutia ufahamu bila kukuamsha kikamilifu.

translations.source: If you find yourself resetting the clock in your sleep, it can be placed on the other side of the room, forcing you to get out of bed to turn it off.
translations.reference: Kama utajipata ukiweka upya saa ya kengele katika usingizi wako, inaweza kuwekwa upande mwingine wa chumba, ili kukulazimu kuondoka kitandani kuizima.
translations.hypothesis: Ikiwa unapata nafasi ya kuanzisha upya saa yako ukiwa usingizi, unaweza kuiweka upande mwingine wa chumba, na hivyo kulazimika kutoka kitandani ili kuizima.

translations.source: Other biorhythm-based options involve drinking lots of fluid (particularly water or tea, a known diuretic) prior to sleep, forcing one to get up to urinate.
translations.reference: Chaguo zingine za midundobayolojia huhusisha unywaji mwingi (hususan wa maji au chai, dawa maarufu) kabla ya kulala, hali inayomlazimu mtu kuamka ili kwenda haja ndogo.
translations.hypothesis: Mbinu nyingine zinazohusiana na biorhythm zinajumuisha kunywa maji mengi (hasa maji au chai, ambayo ni diuretiki inayochochea mkojo) kabla ya kulala, jambo ambalo linaweza kulazimisha mtu kuamka ili kwenda kuchoma choo.

translations.source: The amount of inner peace a person possesses correlates oppositely to the amount of tension in one’s body and spirit.
translations.reference: Kiwango cha amani ya ndani ambayo mtu humiliki huhusiana kinyume na kiwango cha mkazo ndani ya mwili na roho yake.
translations.hypothesis: Kiasi cha amani ya ndani ambacho mtu anayo huenda kikihusiana moja kwa moja na kiwango cha msongo wa akili na mwili ambao mtu huyo anapata. Kwa maneno mengine, kadri mtu anavyopata amani ya ndani, ndivyo anavyopunguza msongo wa akili na mwili.

translations.source: The lower the tension, the more positive the life force present. Every person has the potential to find absolute peace and contentment.
translations.reference: Kadiri mvuto ulivyo chini, ndivyo nguvu za maisha zilizoko zilivyo chanya. Kila mtu ana uwezo wa kupata amani na kuridhika zaidi.
translations.hypothesis: Kadri hali ya msongo wa mawazo inavyopungua, ndivyo nguvu chanya ya maisha inavyoongezeka. Kila mtu ana uwezo wa kupata amani na furaha kamili.

translations.source: Everyone can achieve enlightenment. The only thing standing in the way of this goal is our own tension and negativity.
translations.reference: Kila mtu anaweza kupata uelewa. Kitu kimoja kinachosimama njiani mwa lengo hili ni wasiwasi na uhasi wetu wenyewe.
translations.hypothesis: Kila mtu anaweza kufikia ufahamu. Kitu pekee ambacho kinazuia lengo hili ni msongo wa mawazo na hisia hasi ambazo tunazo sisi wenyewe.

translations.source: The Tibetan Buddhism is based on the teachings of Buddha, but were extended by the mahayana path of love and by a lot of techniques from Indian Yoga.
translations.reference: Ubuddha wa Tibetani una msingi wa mafundisho ya Buddha, lakini ulipanuliwa na njia ya mahayana ya upendo na mbinu nyingi za kutoka kwa Yoga ya India.
translations.hypothesis: Ubudha wa Tibet unatokana na mafundisho ya Buddha, lakini umeendelezwa kupitia njia ya Mahayana ya upendo, pamoja na mbinu nyingi kutoka kwa yoga ya India.

translations.source: In principle the Tibetan Buddhism is very simple. It consists of Kundalini Yoga, meditation and the path of all-embracing love.
translations.reference: Katika kanuni, Ubudha wa Kitibeti ni rahisi sana. Una Yoga ya Kundalini, kutafakari na njia ya upendo unaokumbatia yote.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa msingi, ubora wa Ubudha wa Tibet ni rahisi sana. Unajumuisha yoga ya Kundalini, tafakari, na njia ya upendo usio na mipaka.

translations.source: With Kundalini Yoga the Kundalini energy (enlightenment energy) is awakened through yoga postures, breathing exercises, mantras and visualizations.
translations.reference: Kupitia Yoga ya Kundalini, nguvu za Kundalini (nguvu za mwangaza) huibushwa kupitia mkao wa yoga, mazoezi ya kupumua, urudiaji maneno au sauti na taswira.
translations.hypothesis: Katika yoga ya Kundalini, nishati ya Kundalini (nishati ya kuangazia) huamshwa kupitia nafasi za yoga, mazoezi ya kupumua, maneno matakatifu (mantra), na taswira za akili.

translations.source: The center of Tibetan meditation is the Deity Yoga. Through the visualization of various deities the energy channels are cleaned, the chakras are activated and the enlightenment consciousness is created.
translations.reference: Kitovu cha fikira za Tibet ni Yoga ya Uungu. Kupitia taswira ya miungu mbalimbali njia za nishati zinasafishwa, chakra zinaamilishwa na fahamu ya wongofu inaamshwa.
translations.hypothesis: Kitu muhimu katika meditatini ya Kitibeti ni "Deity Yoga." Kupitia kuwazia miungu mbalimbali, njia za nishati husafishwa, vituo vya nishati (chakras) huamshwa, na ufahamu wa kuangazia huundwa.

translations.source: Germany was a common enemy in World War 2, leading to cooperation between the USSR and USA. With the end of the war the clashes of system, process and culture led to the countries falling out.
translations.reference: Ujerumani ilikuwa adui wa kawaida katika Vita vya Pili vya Dunia, hivyo kupelekea ushirikiano wa USSR na Marekani. Kwa kumalizika kwa vita mgongano wa mfumo, mchakato na utamaduni vilipelekea kutengana kwa nchi.
translations.hypothesis: Ujerumani ilikuwa adui mkuu katika Vita vya Pili vya Dunia, na hivyo kusababisha ushirikiano kati ya USSR na Marekani. Hata hivyo, baada ya kumalizika kwa vita, tofauti za itikadi, mbinu na utamaduni zilisababisha uhusiano kati ya nchi hizo kuzoromoka.

translations.source: With two years of the end of the war, the former allies were now enemies and the Cold War began.
translations.reference: Na miaka mbili ya kumalizika kwa vita, washirika wa zamani waligeuka kuwa maadui na Vita Baridi vikaanza.
translations.hypothesis: Baada ya miaka miwili tangu mwisho wa vita, washirika wa zamani walikuwa maadui, na hivyo Vita Baridi ilianza.

translations.source: It was to last for the next 40 years and would be fought for real, by proxy armies, on battlefields from Africa to Asia, in Afghanistan, Cuba and many other places.
translations.reference: Ilikuwa idumu kwa miaka 40 ijayo na ingepigwa kwa kweli na vikosi vya kiwakala, katika nyanja za vita toka Afrika hadi Asia, katika Afghanistani, Kuba na sehemu nyingine nyingi
translations.hypothesis: Hii itadumu kwa miaka 40 ijayo, na itapigana kwa kweli, na vikosi vya kivita ambavyo vitatumika kama wakala, katika maeneo ya vita kuanzia Afrika hadi Asia, Afghanistan, Cuba, na maeneo mengine mengi.

translations.source: By September 17, 1939, the Polish defense was already broken, and the only hope was to retreat and reorganise along the Romanian bridgehead.
translations.reference: Kufikia Septemba 17, 1939, ulinzi wa Kipolishi ulivunjwa, na tumaini la pekee lilikuwa kurudi na kujipanga tena kwa darajakuu la Kiromania.
translations.hypothesis: Mnamo Septemba 17, 1939, ulinzi wa Poland ulikuwa tayari umeporomoka, na tumaini pekee ilikuwa kujiondoa na kujipanga upya katika eneo lililokuwa karibu na mpaka wa Romania.

translations.source: However, these plans were rendered obsolete nearly overnight, when over 800,000 soldiers from the Soviet's Union Red Army entered and created the Belarussian and Ukrainian fronts after invading the eastern regions of Poland in violation of the Riga Peace Treaty, the Soviet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, and other international treaties, both bilateral and multilateral.
translations.reference: Hata hivyo, mipango hii ilipitwa na wakati usiku mmoja, wakati zaidi ya askari 800,000 kutoka Jeshi Jekundu la Umoja wa Kisovyeti lilipoingia na kuunda mipaka ya Belarusiani na Ukreini baada ya kuvamia maeneo ya mashariki mwa Polandi kwa kukiuka Mkataba wa Amani wa Riga, Mapatano ya Kisovyeti-Polishi Yasiyo ya Uchokozi, na mikataba mingine ya kimataifa, pande mbili na pande nyingi.
translations.hypothesis: Hata hivyo, mipango hiyo yote ilipotea maana yake kwa karibu mara moja, wakati zaidi ya wanajeshi 800,000 kutoka kwa Jeshi la Kijani la Muungano wa Kisovieti liliingia na kuunda mbele za Belarusi na Ukraine, baada ya uvamizi wa sehemu za mashariki za Poland, ukiukiuka Mkataba wa Amani wa Riga, Mkataba wa Usitishaji wa Vita kati ya Muungano wa Kisovieti na Poland, na makubaliano mengineya ya kimataifa, kama vile yale ya pande mbili na mengi.

translations.source: Using ships to transport goods is by far the most efficient way to move large amounts of people and goods across oceans.
translations.reference: Kutumia meli kusafirisha bidhaa kwa kiasi kikubwa ilikuwa njia bora zaidi ya kusafirisha halaiki ya watu na bidhaa nyingi baharini.
translations.hypothesis: Kutumia meli kusafirisha bidhaa ndiyo njia bora na yenye ufanisi zaidi ya kusafirisha idadi kubwa ya watu na bidhaa kupitia bahari.

translations.source: The job of navies has traditionally been to ensure that your country maintains the ability to move your people and goods, while at the same time, interfering with your enemy's ability to move his people and goods.
translations.reference: Kazi ya Jeshi la wanamaji kwa kiasili imekuwa ni kuhakikisha kuwa nchi yako ina uwezo wa kusafirisha watu na bidhaa zako, wakati huo huo, kuzuia uwezo wa adui wako wa kuhamisha watu wake na bidhaa.
translations.hypothesis: Kazi ya majeshi ya baharini imekuwa kwa kawaida kuhakikisha kwamba nchi yako ina uwezo wa kusafirisha watu na bidhaa zake, huku wakati huo huo, ikizuia uwezo wa adui yako kusafirisha watu na bidhaa zake.

translations.source: One of the most noteworthy recent examples of this was the North Atlantic campaign of WWII. The Americans were trying to move men and materials across the Atlantic Ocean to help Britain.
translations.reference: Mojawapo ya mifano maarufu ya hivi karibuni ni kampeni ya Kaskazini mwa Atlantiki ya Vita Vikuu vya Pili vya Dunia. Wamarekani walikuwa wakijaribu kusafirisha watu na vifaa kupitia Bahari ya Atlantiki ili kuwasaidia Waingereza.
translations.hypothesis: Mojawapo ya mifano muhimu zaidi ya hivi karibuni ya jambo hili ni operesheni iliyofanyika katika Bahari ya Atlantiki ya Kaskazini wakati wa Vita vya Pili vya Dunia. Wamarekani walijaribu kusafirisha watu na vifaa kupitia Bahari ya Atlantiki ili kuwasaidia Uingereza.

translations.source: At the same time, the German navy, using mainly U-boats, was trying to stop this traffic.
translations.reference: Wakati huo huo, askari wa majeshi ya Ujerumani, kwa kutumia nyambizi, yalikuwa yakijaribu kuzuia trafiki hii.
translations.hypothesis: Hata hivyo, jeshi la baharini la Ujerumani, likitumia hasa meli za kivuko (U-boats), lilikuwa likijaribu kusimamisha shughuli hizo.

translations.source: Had the Allies failed, Germany probably would have been able to conquer Britain as it had the rest of Europe.
translations.reference: Ikiwa Muungano ungeshindwa, pengine Ujerumani ingeweza kushinda Uingereza kama vile ilivyokuwa imeshinda Uropa.
translations.hypothesis: Iwapo washirika hao (wa vita) wangefeli, basi ujerumani pengine ingeweza kuishinda Uingereza, kama ilivyofanya kwa sehemu nyingine ya Ulaya.

translations.source: Goats seem to have been first domesticated roughly 10,000 years ago in the Zagros Mountains of Iran.
translations.reference: Yaelekea mbuzi walianza kufugwa takriban miaka 10,000 iliyopita katika Milima ya Zagrosi ya Irani.
translations.hypothesis: Inaonekana kwamba mbuzi walianzishwa kwa mara ya kwanza kama wanyama wa kukuza takriban miaka 10,000 iliyopita katika Milima ya Zagros nchini Iran.

translations.source: Ancient cultures and tribes began to keep them for easy access to milk, hair, meat, and skins.
translations.reference: Tamaduni na makabila ya kale yalianza kuwafuga kwa ufikiaji rahisi wa maziwa, nywele, nyama, na ngozi.
translations.hypothesis: Tamaduni na makabila ya kale yalianza kuweka wanyama hao ili kuwawezesha kupata maziwa, manyoya, nyama, na ngozi kwa urahisi.

translations.source: Domestic goats were generally kept in herds that wandered on hills or other grazing areas, often tended by goatherds who were frequently children or adolescents, similar to the more widely known shepherd. These methods of herding are still used today.
translations.reference: Kijumla, mbuzi wa nyumbani walianza kufugwa kwa makundi yaliyotangatanga milimani au maeneo mengine ya malisho, huku yakisimamiwa na walinzi ambao mara nyingi walikuwa watoto au vijana wachanga, sawia na wachungaji wanaofahamika sana. Mbinu hizi za ufugaji bado zinatumika hata leo.
translations.hypothesis: Mbuzi wa kienyeji kwa kawaida waliwekwa katika makundi ambayo yalitembea kwenye milima au maeneo mengine ya malisho, na mara nyingi walitunzwa na wafugaji mbuzi ambao mara nyingi walikuwa watoto au vijana, kama vile wafugaji kondoo ambao ni maarufu zaidi. Mbinu hizi za ufugaji bado zinatumika hadi leo.

translations.source: Wagonways were built in England as early as the 16th Century.
translations.reference: Magari yanayosukokotwana farasi yalijengwa huko Uingereza mapema kama karne ya 16.
translations.hypothesis: Njia za usafiri ambazo zilikuwa na gurudumu zilianza kujengwa nchini Uingereza tangu karne ya 16.

translations.source: Although wagonways merely consisted of parallel planks of wood, they allowed horses pulling them to achieve greater speeds and pull larger loads than on the slightly more rough roads of the day.
translations.reference: Ingawa njia za magari zilisheheni magogo sambamba ya miti, zilihuruhusu farasi kuzivuta kwa kasi zaidi na kuvuta mizigo mikubwa kiasi kwa barabara mbaya za siku.
translations.hypothesis: Ingawa njia za usafiri zilikuwa tu bodi za mbao zilizowekwa kando ya kila mmoja, ziliruhusu farasi kuendesha kwa kasi zaidi na kubeba mizigo mizito kuliko ilivyokuwa inawezekana kwenye barabara ambazo zilikuwa si laini sana za wakati huo.

translations.source: Crossties were introduced fairly early to hold the tracks in place. Gradually, however, it was realised that tracks would be more efficient if they had a stip of iron on the top.
translations.reference: Nguzomlalo zilianzishwa mapema kiasi ili kushikilia reli mahali pake. Hata hivyo, kadiri muda ulivyoendelea iligunduliwa kwamba reli hizo zingefanya kazi bora zaidi ikiwa kipande cha chuma kingewekelewa juu.
translations.hypothesis: Mbao za kuweka kwenye njia za reli zilianzishwa mapema ili kuhakikisha kuwa njia hizo zinasimama mahali pake. Hata hivyo, hatimaye iligunduliwa kwamba njia za reli zingefanya kazi vizuri zaidi ikiwa zingekuwa na safu ya chuma juu.

translations.source: This became common practice, but the iron caused more wear on the wooden wheels of the wagons.
translations.reference: Hii ilikuja kuwa desturi, lakini chuma kilisababisha kuharibika kwa magurudumu ya mbao ya magari ya kukokotwa.
translations.hypothesis: Hii ilikuwa kawaida, lakini chuma hicho kilisababisha uharibifu zaidi kwenye magurudumu ya mbao ya magari hayo.

translations.source: Eventually, wooden wheels were replaced by iron wheels. In 1767, the first full-iron rails were introduced.
translations.reference: Hatimaye, magurudumu ya mbao yalibadilishwa na magurudumu ya vyuma. Mnamo 1767, reli za kwanza za vyuma kamili zilianzishwa.
translations.hypothesis: Hatimaye, magurudumu ya mbao yalibadilishwa na magurudumu ya chuma. Mnamo mwaka wa 1767, njia za reli zilizotengenezwa kabisa kwa chuma zilitumika kwa mara ya kwanza.

translations.source: The first known transportation was walking, humans began walking upright two million years ago with the emergence of Homo Erectus (meaning upright man).
translations.reference: Namna yak kwanza ya uchukuzi iliyofahamika ni kutembea, binadaum walianza kutembea wima miaka milioni mbili iliyopita, baada ya kuibuka kwa wanadamu wima.
translations.hypothesis: Njia ya kwanza ya usafiri ilikuwa kutembea. Binadamu walianza kutembea wakiwa wamesimama mmoja milioni na mia moja iliyopita, wakati wa enzi ya Homo Erectus (ambayo inamaanisha "mwanadamu aliye simama").

translations.source: Their predecessors, the Australopithecus did not walk upright as habitually.
translations.reference: Watangulizi wao, Australopithecus hawakutembea wima kama kawaida.
translations.hypothesis: Wale ambao walitangulia, yaani Australopithecus, hawakuwa wakitembea wima kwa kawaida kama ilivyo kwa binadamu wa kisasa.

translations.source: Bipedal specializations are found in Australopithecus fossils from 4.2-3.9 million years ago, although Sahelanthropus may have walked on two legs as early as seven million years ago.
translations.reference: Utaalamu wa bipedali unapatikana katika visukuku vya Australopithekasi kuanzia miaka milion 4.2 hadi 3.9 iliyopita, ingawa inawezekana kuwa Sahelanthropasi walitembea kwa miguu miwili takriban miaka milioni saba iliyopita.
translations.hypothesis: Mbinu za kutembea kwa miguu miwili zimegunduliwa katika mabaki ya viumbe wa aina ya Australopithecus yaliyotoka takribani milioni 4.2 hadi 3.9 iliyopita, ingawa inawezekana kwamba viumbe wa aina ya Sahelanthropus walikuwa wakiendelea kwa miguu miwili tangu milioni saba iliyopita.

translations.source: We can start living more friendly to the environment, we can join to the environmental movement, and we can even be activists in order to reduce the future suffering in some degree.
translations.reference: Tunaweza kuanza kuishi kama marafiki wazuri wa mazingira, tunaweza kujiunga na harakati za mazingira, na hata pia tunaweza kuwa wanaharakati ili kupunguza dhiki ya baadaye kwa kiwango fulani.
translations.hypothesis: Tunaweza kuanza kuishi kwa njia ambayo inalinda zaidi mazingira, tunaweza kujiunga na harakati za ulinzi wa mazingira, na tunaweza hata kuwa washiriki hai ili kupunguza mateso yanayoweza kutokea katika siku zijazo, kadri tuwezavyo.

translations.source: This is just like symptomatic treatment in many cases. However, if we do not only want a temporary solution, then we should find the root of the problems, and we should deactivate them.
translations.reference: Hii ni sawa na matibabu ya dalili katika hali nyingi. Hata hivyo, ikiwa hatutaki tu suluhisho la muda mfupi, basi tunastahili kupata shina la matatizo, nasi tupate kuizima.
translations.hypothesis: Hili ni sawa na matibabu ya dalili katika kesi nyingi. Hata hivyo, ikiwa hatutaki tu suluhisho la muda mfupi, basi tunapaswa kutambua chanzo cha matatizo hayo, na tunapaswa kuyazima.

translations.source: It is obvious enough that the world has changed much because of humankind's scientific and technological advancements, and problems have become greater because of overpopulation and mankind's extravagant lifestyle.
translations.reference: Ni wazi kabisa kuwa ulimwengu umebadilika sana kwa sababu ya maendeleo ya kibinadamu katika sayansi na teknolojia, nayo matatizo yameongezeka kwa sababu ya watu kuwa wengi kupita kiasi na mitindo ya ubadhirifu ya maisha ya wanadamu.
translations.hypothesis: Ni wazi kwamba ulimwengu umebadilika sana kutokana na maendeleo ya kisayansi na kiteknolojia ya binadamu, na matatizo yamekuwa makubwa zaidi kutokana na ongezeko la idadi ya watu na mtindo wa maisha wa kifahari wa binadamu.

translations.source: After its adoption by Congress on July 4, a handwritten draft signed by the President of Congress John Hancock and the Secretary Charles Thomson was then sent a few blocks away to the printing shop of John Dunlap.
translations.reference: Baada ya kukubaliwa na Kongresi mnamo Julai 4, rasimu iliyoandikwa kwa hati ya mkono na kutiwa sahihi na Rais wa Kongresi John Hancock na Katibu Charles Thomson ilitumwa vitalu vichache kwa duka la uchapishaji la John Dunlap.
translations.hypothesis: Baada ya Bunge kupitisha hati hiyo mnamo Julai 4, nakala iliyoandikwa kwa mkono na ilisainiwa na Rais wa Bunge, John Hancock, na Katibu, Charles Thomson, ilitumwa umbali mfupi tu, hadi kwenye kiwanda cha uchapishaji cha John Dunlap.

translations.source: Through the night between 150 and 200 copies were made, now known as "Dunlap broadsides".
translations.reference: Usiku kucha kati ya nakala 150 na 200 zilitengenezwa, ambazo sasa zinajulikana kama “Vikaratasi vya Dunlop”.
translations.hypothesis: Wakati wa usiku huo, nakala kati ya 150 na 200 zilitengenezwa, na sasa zinajulikana kama "nakala za Dunlap."

translations.source: The first public reading of the document was by John Nixon in the yard of Independence Hall on July 8.
translations.reference: Usomaji wa kwanza kwa umma wa hati hiyo ulifanywa na John Nixon katika yadi ya Ukumbi wa Uhuru mnamo Julai 8.
translations.hypothesis: Msomaji wa kwanza wa hati hiyo mbele ya umma alikuwa John Nixon, ambaye alisoma hati hiyo katika uwanja wa Jengo la Uhuru mnamo Julai 8.

translations.source: One was sent to George Washington on July 6, who had it read to his troops in New York on July 9. A copy reached London on August 10.
translations.reference: Moja ilitumwa kwa George Washington mnamo Julai 6, ambaye aliifanya isomewe vikosi vyake katika New York mnamo Julai 9. Nakala ilifika London mnamo Agosti 10.
translations.hypothesis: Moja ilitumiwa kwa George Washington mnamo Julai 6, na aliiagiza isomwe kwa askari wake huko New York mnamo Julai 9. Nakala moja ilifika London mnamo Agosti 10.

translations.source: The 25 Dunlap broadsides still known to exist are the oldest surviving copies of the document. The original handwritten copy has not survived.
translations.reference: Nakala 25 za Dunlap zenye cheche za mashambulizi zinazojulikana kuwahi kuwepo ndizo nakala kongwe zaidi za hati hiyo zinazopatikana. Nakala asili iliyoandikwa kwa mkono haipo.
translations.hypothesis: Nakala 25 za "broadside" za Dunlap ambazo bado zipo ni nakala za zamani zaidi za hati hiyo. Nakala asili iliyoandikwa kwa mkono haijakuwepo hadi sasa.

translations.source: Many paleontologists today believe that one group of dinosaurs survived and is alive today. We call them birds.
translations.reference: Wanapaleontolojia wengi leo hii wanaamini kuwa kikundi kimoja cha dinosau kiliponea na kingali hai hata sasa. Tunawaita ndege.
translations.hypothesis: Wataalamu wengi wa paleontology (kisayansi cha mabaki ya viumbe vya kale) leo wanaamini kwamba kundi moja la dinosaurs lilisalia na bado lipo leo. Tunawaita ndege.

translations.source: Many people don't think about them as dinosaurs because they have feathers and can fly.
translations.reference: Watu wengi hawawachukuliii kuwa dinosau kwa sababu wana manyoya na wanaweza kupaa.
translations.hypothesis: Watu wengi hawawafikiri kama dinosaurs kwa sababu wana manyoya na wanaweza kuruka.

translations.source: But there are a lot of things about birds that still look like a dinosaur.
translations.reference: Lakini kuna mambo mengi juu ya ndege ambao bado wanaonekana kama dinosau.
translations.hypothesis: Lakini kuna mambo mengi kuhusu ndege ambayo bado yanafanana na dinosaurs.

translations.source: They have feet with scales and claws, they lay eggs, and they walk on their two back legs like a T-Rex.
translations.reference: Wana miguu yenye magamba na makucha, hutaga mayai na hutembea kwa miguu yake miwili ya nyuma kama T-Rex.
translations.hypothesis: Wanyama hawa wana miguu iliyo na mabomu na makucha, huzaa mayai, na huendelea kwa miguu yao miwili ya nyuma, kama vile dinosaur aina ya T-Rex.

translations.source: Virtually all computers in use today are based on the manipulation of information which is coded in the form of binary numbers.
translations.reference: Karibu kompyuta zote zinazotumika leo zimekitwa katika kuendeshwa kwa habari ambayo imewekwa katika msimbo ulio katika hali ya nambari za bainari.
translations.hypothesis: Takriban kompyuta zote zinazotumika leo hutegemea utendaji wa habari ambayo imewekwa katika mfumo wa namba za binary.

translations.source: A binary number can have only one of two values, i.e. 0 or 1, and these numbers are referred to as binary digits - or bits, to use computer jargon.
translations.reference: Nambari ya bainari yaweza tu kuwa na thamani moja kati ya mbili, yaani 0 au 1, na hizi nambari zinajulikana kama takwimu jozi, au biti, katika msamiati wa kompyuta.
translations.hypothesis: Nambari ya binary inaweza kuwa na thamani moja tu kati ya mbili, yaani, 0 au 1, na nambari hizi huitwa "nambari za binary" - au "biti," kama inavyotumika katika lugha ya kompyuta.

translations.source: Internal poisoning may not be immediately apparent. Symptoms, such as vomiting are sufficiently general that an immediate diagnosis cannot be made.
translations.reference: Sumu ya ndani inaweza kukosa kuwa dhahiri papo hapo. Dalili, kama vile kutapika ni jumla kiasi kwamba utambuzi wa mara moja hauwezi kufanywa.
translations.hypothesis: Usumu wa ndani unaweza kuwa haonekani mara moja. Dalili, kama vile kutapika, ni za kawaida sana hivyo kwamba hawezi kutambuliwa mara moja.

translations.source: The best indication of internal poisoning may be the presence of an open container of medication or toxic household chemicals.
translations.reference: Dalili bora ya sumu ya ndani inaweza kuwa kuwepo kwa chombo wazi cha dawa ama kemikali za kaya zenye sumu.
translations.hypothesis: Ishara bora ya sumu iliyoingia ndani ya mwili inaweza kuwa uwepo wa chupa au kontena iliyofunguliwa ya dawa au kemikali hatari za kaya.

translations.source: Check the label for specific first aid instructions for that specific poison.
translations.reference: Angalia lebo kwa maagizo maalum ya huduma ya kwanza ya sumu hiyo.
translations.hypothesis: Angalia lebo ili kupata maelekezo maalum ya kwanza ya tiba ya kutibu sumu hiyo mahususi.

translations.source: The term bug is used by entomologists in a formal sense for this group of insects.
translations.reference: Neno mdudu hutumiwa na wanaentomolojia katika matumizi rasmi ya kikundi hiki cha wadudu.
translations.hypothesis: Neno "bug" hutumika na wataalamu wa wadudu (entomolojia) kwa maana rasmi ili kurejelea kundi hilo la wadudu.

translations.source: This term derives from ancient familiarity with Bed-bugs, which are insects highly adapted to parasitize humans.
translations.reference: Nenohili limetoka kwenye kufahamiana kwa kale na Kunguni, ambao wana ustadi mkubwa wa kumelea binadamu.
translations.hypothesis: Neno hili linatokana na ujuzi wa zamani kuhusu wadudu wa aina ya "bed bugs," ambayo ni aina ya wadudu ambao wamebadilika sana ili kuishi kama wadudu wanaowatumia binadamu.

translations.source: Both Assassin-bugs and Bed-bugs are nidicolous, adapted to living in nest or housing of their host.
translations.reference: Wadudu Assasin-bugs na Kunguni wana uzoefu wa kuishi katika kiota ama makazi ya mwenyeji wao.
translations.hypothesis: Chawa aina ya "Assassin-bugs" na "Bed-bugs" zote mbili ni wadudu ambao huishi ndani ya makazi au viota vya wadudu ambao huwategemea.

translations.source: Across the United States of America, there are approximately 400,000 known cases of Multiple Sclerosis (MS), leaving it as the leading neurological disease in younger and middle aged adults.
translations.reference: Katika Amerika yote, kuna takribani kesi 400,000 zinazojulikana za Sklerosisi ya Sehemu Nyingi (MS), na kuuwacha kuwa ugonjwa wa neva unaoongoza katika vijana na watu wazima wenye umri wa kati.
translations.hypothesis: Katika Marekani, kuna takriban kesi 400,000 za ugonjwa wa Multiple Sclerosis (MS) ambao unafahamika, na hivyo kuwa ugonjwa mkuu wa neva unaowapata watu wanaoishi katika umri mdogo na wa kati.

translations.source: MS is a disease that affects the central nervous system, which is made up of the brain, the spinal cord and the optic nerve.
translations.reference: Selerosisiwingi ni ugonjwa unaoathiri mfumo mkuu wa neva, ambao unajumuisha ubongo, uti wa mgongo na neva ya macho.
translations.hypothesis: MS ni ugonjwa unaoathiri mfumo wa neva mkuu, ambao unafanywa na ubongo, uti wa mgongo, na ujasiri wa macho.

translations.source: Research has found that females are two times more likely to have MS then males.
translations.reference: Utafiti umebainisha kuwa wanawake wana uwezekano maradufu wa kuugua selerosisiwingi kuliko wanaume.
translations.hypothesis: Utafiti umebainisha kwamba wanawake wana uwezekano wa kuwa na ugonjwa wa MS (Multiple Sclerosis) mara mbili kuliko wanaume.

translations.source: A couple may decide it is not in their best interest, or in the interest of their child, to raise a baby.
translations.reference: Wenzi wawili huenda wakaamua si kwa masilahi yao bora, au masilahi ya mtoto wao, kumlea mtoto.
translations.hypothesis: Jozi ya watu inaweza kuamua kwamba si jambo zuri au la faida kwao, au kwa mtoto wao, kuendelea na uzao na kumlea mtoto.

translations.source: These couples may choose to make an adoption plan for their baby.
translations.reference: Wanandoa hawa wanaweza kuchagua kutengeneza mpango wa ulezi wa mtoto wao.
translations.hypothesis: Wanandoa hawa wanaweza kuchagua kuandaa mpango wa kulea mtoto wao, ikiwa ni pamoja na utaratibu wa kumpata mlezi.

translations.source: In an adoption, the birth parents terminate their parental rights so that another couple may parent the child.
translations.reference: Katika kuchukua ulezi, wazazi wa kuzaa hukomesha haki zao za mzazi ili wazazi wengine waweze kumlea mtoto huyo.
translations.hypothesis: Katika utaratibu wa kulea mtoto ambaye si mzao, wazazi wa asili huacha haki zao za uzazi ili jozi nyingine iweze kulea mtoto huyo.

translations.source: Science’s main goal is to figure out the way the world works through the scientific method. This method in fact guides most scientific research.
translations.reference: Lengo kuu la Sayansi ni kubaini njia ambayo ulimwengu utaendeshwa kwa mbinu za kisayansi. Kwa kweli, mbinu hii huongoza tafiti nyingi za kisayansi.
translations.hypothesis: Lengo kuu la sayansi ni kufahamu jinsi ulimwengu unafanya kazi, kupitia mbinu ya kisayansi. Mbinu hii, kwa kweli, huongoza utafiti mwingi wa kisayansi.

translations.source: It isn’t alone though, experimentation, and an experiment is a test that is used to eliminate one or more of the possible hypotheses, asking questions, and making observations also guide scientific research.
translations.reference: Haiko peke yake hata hivyo, majaribio, na jaribio ni upimaji ambao hutumiwa kuondoa nadharia moja au mbili zinazowezekana, kuuliza maswali, na kufanya uchunguzi pia huongoza utafiti wa kisayansi.
translations.hypothesis: Ingawa si tu hilo, utafiti na majaribio, ambapo jaribio ni mtihani unaotumika kuondoa nadharia moja au zaidi, pamoja na kuuliza maswali na kufanya uchunguzi, pia huongoza utafiti wa kisayansi.

translations.source: Naturalists and philosophers focused on classical texts and, in particular, on the Bible in Latin.
translations.reference: Wataalam wa asili na wanafalsafa waliangazia matini za jadi, na hususan, Biblia ya Kilatini.
translations.hypothesis: Wataalamu wa sayansi ya asili na falsafa walizingatia maandishi ya kale, na hasa Biblia iliyoandikwa katika lugha ya Kilatini.

translations.source: Accepted were Aristotle's views on all matters of science, including psychology.
translations.reference: Maoni ya Aristotle juu ya mambo yote ya sayansiyalikubalika, ikiwemo saikolojia.
translations.hypothesis: Mitazamo ya Aristotle kuhusu masuala yote ya sayansi, ikiwa ni pamoja na saikolojia, ilikubalika kwa kiasi kikubwa.

translations.source: As knowledge of Greek declined, the West found itself cut off from its Greek philosophical and scientific roots.
translations.reference: Jinsi maarifa ya Wagiriki yalivyopungua, Magharibi ilijikuta ikikatwa kutoka kwa asili za kifalsafa na kisayansi ya Kigiriki.
translations.hypothesis: Wakati ujuzi wa lugha ya Kigiriki ulipopungua, Magharibi yalikumbana na hali ya kutengwa kutoka kwa mizizi yake ya falsafa na sayansi iliyokuwa ya Kigiriki.

translations.source: Many observed rhythms in physiology and behavior often crucially depend on the presence of endogenous cycles and their production through biological clocks.
translations.reference: Wengi walifuata mtindo katika fiziolojia na tabia ambazo mara nyingi hutegemea uwepo wa vipindi vya kiasili na uzalishaji wao kupitia mida za kibiolojia.
translations.hypothesis: Mwenendo mwingi unaoonekana katika fiziolojia na tabia mara nyingi hutegemea sana uwepo wa mzunguko wa ndani na utengenezaji wake kupitia saa za kibiolojia.

translations.source: Periodic rhythms, which are not simply responses to external periodic cues, have been documented for most living beings, including bacteria, fungi, plants, and animals.
translations.reference: Midundo ya mara kwa mara, ambayo si jibu tu kwa ishara za nje za mara kwa mara, imerekodiwa kwa viumbe wengi wenye uhai, zikiwemo bakteria, kuvu, mimea na wanyama,
translations.hypothesis: Mitindo ya kawaida, ambayo siyo tu majibu kwa mambo ya nje yanayotokea kwa kawaida, yameelezwa kwa viumbe hai vingi, ikiwa ni pamoja na bakteria, fungi, mimea, na wanyama.

translations.source: Biological clocks are self sustaining oscillators which will continue a period of free-running cycling even in the absence of external cues.
translations.reference: Saa za kibiolojia ni osileta zinazojimudu ambazo zitaendeleza kipindi cha ujiendeshaji wa mzunguko hata pasipo na vidokezo vya nje.
translations.hypothesis: Saa za kibiolojia ni mifumo inayojitegemea ambayo inaendelea kufanya mzunguko wa kawaida hata wakati hakuna msisitizo wowote kutoka nje.

translations.source: The Hershey and Chase experiment was one of the leading suggestions that DNA was a genetic material.
translations.reference: Jaribio la Hershey na Chase lilikuwa mojawapo ya mapendekezo kwamba DNA ilikuwa nyenzo za nasaba.
translations.hypothesis: Jaribio la Hershey na Chase ilikuwa mojawapo ya majaribio muhimu ambayo yaliashiria kwamba DNA ndiyo nyenzo ya urithi.

translations.source: Hershey and Chase used phages, or viruses, to implant their own DNA into a bacterium.
translations.reference: Hershey na Chase walitumia virusi kuchomeka DNA yao wenyewe ndani ya bakteria.
translations.hypothesis: Hershey na Chase walitumia virusi, au "phages," kuingiza DNA yao wenyewe ndani ya bakteria.

translations.source: They did two experiments marking either the DNA in the phage with a radioactive phosphorus or the protein of the phage with radioactive sulfur.
translations.reference: Walifanya majaribio mawili kuashiria DNA kwenye virusi kwa fosforasi nururifuau protini ya virusi kwa salfa nururishi.
translations.hypothesis: Walifanya majaribio mawili ambapo walitambulisha DNA ya bakteria hiyo (phage) kwa kutumia fosforu inayobadilika (radioactive) au walitambulisha protini ya bakteria hiyo kwa kutumia sulfuri inayobadilika.

translations.source: Mutations can have a variety of different effects depending on the type of mutation, the significance of the piece of genetic material affected and whether the cells affected are germ-line cells.
translations.reference: Mabadiliko yanaweza kuwa na athari tofauti kutegemea aina ya mabadiliko, umuhimu wa kifaa cha maumbile kilichoathiriwa na ikiwa seli zilizoathiriwa ni seli za vijidudu.
translations.hypothesis: Mabadiliko ya kijeni yanaweza kusababisha athari tofauti sana, kulingana na aina ya mabadiliko, umuhimu wa sehemu ya nyenzo za kijeni iliyoathirika, na iwapo seli zilizopata madhara ni seli za uzazi.

translations.source: Only mutations in germ-line cells can be passed on to children, while mutations elsewhere can cause cell-death or cancer.
translations.reference: Ni mabadiliko ya seli za vijidudu tu ambayo yanaweza kusambazwa kwa watoto, huku mabadiliko kwingineko yakiweza kusababisha seli za kifo au saratani.
translations.hypothesis: Tupepo tu ambazo hutokea kwenye seli za uzazi ndizo zinaweza kupitishwa kwa watoto, huku mabadiliko mengine yaliyotokea katika sehemu nyingine ya mwili yanaweza kusababisha kifo cha seli au saratani.

translations.source: Nature-based tourism attracts people interested in visiting natural areas for the purpose of enjoying the scenery, including plant and animal wildlife.
translations.reference: Utalii wa asili huvutia watu walio na nia ya kutembelea maeneo ya asili kwa sababu ya kuburudishwa na maadhari, pamoja na mimea na wanyama.
translations.hypothesis: Utalii unaotegemea mazingira huwavutia watu ambao wanapenda kutembelea maeneo ya asili ili kufurahia mandhari, pamoja na mimea na wanyamapori.

translations.source: Examples of on-site activities include hunting, fishing, photography, bird watching, and visiting parks and studying information about the ecosystem.
translations.reference: Mifano ya shughuli za eneoni ni pamoja na uwindaji, uvuvi, upigaji picha, kutazama ndege, na kutembelea mbuga na kusoma habari za mfumo wa ikolojia.
translations.hypothesis: Shughuli ambazo zinafanyika katika eneo husika ni pamoja na uwindaji, uvuvi, upigaji picha, utazamaji wa ndege, pamoja na ziara za bustani na kujifunza kuhusu mfumo wa ikolojia.

translations.source: An example is visiting, photographing, and learning about organgatuangs in Borneo.
translations.reference: Mfano ni kutembelea, kupiga picha, na kujifunza juu ya nyani wakubwa huko Borneo.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa mfano, unaweza kutembelea, kupiga picha, na kujifunza kuhusu mimea ya aina ya "organgatuang" iliyopo katika kisiwa cha Borneo.

translations.source: Every morning, people leave small country towns in cars to go their workplace and are passed by others whose work destination is the place they have just left.
translations.reference: Kila asubuhi, watu huondoka miji midogo mashambani ndani ya magari wakielekea kazini wakipitana na wengine ambao wanaelekea kazini walikotoka wao.
translations.hypothesis: Kila asubuhi, watu huondoka miji midogo ya mashambani kwa kutumia magari ili kwenda kazini, na mara nyingi wanapita kwa watu wengine ambao wanaelekea mahali ambapo watu hao wameondoka.

translations.source: In this dynamic transport shuttle everyone is somehow connected with, and supporting, a transport system based on private cars.
translations.reference: Katika chombo hiki imara cha usafiri, kila mtu kwa njia fulani ameunganishwa na, na kuunga mkono, mfumo wa usafiri unaotegemea magari ya kibinafsi.
translations.hypothesis: Katika mfumo huu wa usafiri unaobadilika kila wakati, kila mtu huunganishwa na, na kusaidia, mfumo wa usafiri unaotegemea magari ya kibinafsi.

translations.source: Science now indicates that this massive carbon economy has dislodged the biosphere from one of its stable states that has supported human evolution for the past two million years.
translations.reference: Sayansi sasa inaashiria kuwa uchumi huu mkubwa wa kaboni umeondoa nyanjahai ya dunia kutoka mojawapo ya hali zake imara ambayo ilipaswa kushikilia mageuzi ya mwanadamu kwa miaka milioni mbili iliyopita.
translations.hypothesis: Sayansi sasa inaonyesha kwamba uchumi huu mkubwa wa kaboni umesababisha mazingira ya dunia kubadilika kutoka katika hali mojawapo iliyokuwa imara na ambayo imesaidia maendeleo ya binadamu kwa miongo milioni miwili iliyopita.

translations.source: Everyone participates in society and uses transportation systems. Almost everyone complains about transportation systems.
translations.reference: Kila mtu hushiriki katika jamii na kutumia mifumo ya uchukuzi. Karibu kila mtu hulalamika kuhusu mifumo ya uchukuzi.
translations.hypothesis: Kila mtu hushiriki katika jamii na hutumia mifumo ya usafiri. Karibu kila mtu hulalamika kuhusu mifumo ya usafiri.

translations.source: In developed countries you seldom hear similar levels of complaints about water quality or bridges falling down.
translations.reference: Katika nchi zilizostawi ni nadra kusikia viwango sawa vya malalamiko kuhusu ubora wa maji au uporomokaji wa madaraja.
translations.hypothesis: Katika nchi zilizoendelea, mara chache husikia malalamiko ya kiwango kama hicho kuhusu ubora wa maji au madaraja yaliyovunjika.

translations.source: Why do transportation systems engender such complaints, why do they fail on a daily basis? Are transportation engineers just incompetent? Or is something more fundamental going on?
translations.reference: Ni kwa nini mifumo ya usafiri huweka hisia kwenye malalamiko kama hayo, kwa nini wao hufeli kila siku? Ni kwamba wahandisi wa usafiri hawajiwezi? Au kuna kitu cha msingi zaidi kinachoendelea?
translations.hypothesis: Kwa nini mifumo ya usafiri husababisha malalamiko mengi, na kwa nini hutimiza kazi zao ipasavyo kila siku? Je, wahandisi wa usafiri hawana uwezo? Au kuna jambo lingine muhimu zaidi linalotokea?

translations.source: Traffic Flow is the study of the movement of individual drivers and vehicles between two points and the interactions they make with one another.
translations.reference: Mtiririko wa Trafiki ni utafiti wa mwondoko wa madereva binafsi na magari kati ya sehemu mbili na mwingiliano wanaofanya na wenzao.
translations.hypothesis: Mchakato wa usafiri wa magari unahusu utafiti wa jinsi madereva na magari husika husafiri kati ya sehemu mbili, na jinsi wanavyoshirikiana na kila mmoja.

translations.source: Unfortunately, studying traffic flow is difficult because driver behavior cannot be predicted with one-hundred percent certainty.
translations.reference: Kwa bahati mbaya, kutafiti mtiririko wa trafiki ni vigumu kwa sababu tabia ya dereva haiwezi kutabiriwa kwa uhakika wa asilimia mia moja.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa bahati mbaya, kuchunguza mtiririko wa magari ni jambo gumu kwa sababu tabia ya madereva haiwezi kutabiriwa kwa uhakika wa asilimia mia moja.

translations.source: Fortunately, drivers tend to behave within a reasonably consistent range; thus, traffic streams tend to have some reasonable consistency and can be roughly represented mathematically.
translations.reference: Kwa bahati, madereva huwa na mazoea kwa upatano fulani; kwa hivyo, misongamano ya trafiki huwa na uthabiti fulani na inaweza kuwakilishwa haswa kitakwimu.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa bahati nzuri, madereva kwa kawaida huendesha magari kwa njia inayofuata kanuni sawa; hivyo, mkondo wa magari kwa kawaida huwa na utaratibu unaoweza kueleweka, na unaweza kuwakilishwa kwa takriban kwa kutumia hesabu.

translations.source: To better represent traffic flow, relationships have been established between the three main characteristics: (1) flow, (2) density, and (3) velocity.
translations.reference: Ili kuwakilisha mtiririko wa trafiki vizuri, uhusiano umeanzishwa kati ya hali tatu kuu: (1) mtiririko, (2) uzito, (3) kasimwelekeo.
translations.hypothesis: Ili kuonyesha vizuri jinsi magari yanavyosonga, uhusiano umewekwa kati ya sifa tatu muhimu: (1) idadi ya magari, (2) ukubwa wa mkondo wa magari, na (3) kasi ya magari.

translations.source: These relationships help in planning, design, and operations of roadway facilities.
translations.reference: Mahusiano haya husaidia katika upangaji, kubuni, na uendeshaji wa welekevu barabarani.
translations.hypothesis: Mahusiano haya husaidia katika upangaji, usanifu, na utendaji wa miundombinu ya barabara.

translations.source: Insects were the first animals to take to the air. Their ability to fly helped them evade enemies more easily and find food and mates more efficiently.
translations.reference: Wadudu ndio waliokuwa wanyama wa kwanza kupaa angani. Uwezo wao wa kupaa uliwasaidia kuwakwepa maadui kwa urahisi na kupata chakula na wenzi wao kwa urahisi.
translations.hypothesis: Wanyama wa aina ya wadudu ndio walikuwa wa kwanza kuruka angani. Uwezo wao wa kuruka uliwawezesha kuepuka maadui kwa urahisi zaidi na kupata chakula na wenzi kwa ufanisi zaidi.

translations.source: Most insects have the advantage of being able to fold their wings back along the body.
translations.reference: Wadudu wengi wana bahati ya kuweza kufunga mbawa zao mwilini.
translations.hypothesis: Wanyama wengi wa aina ya wadudu wana faida ya kuweza kukunjia mabawa yao nyuma, karibu na mwili wao.

translations.source: This gives them a wider range of small places to hide from predators.
translations.reference: Hii huwapa fursa pana ya sehemu ndogondogo za kujificha na adui wao.
translations.hypothesis: Hii huwapa nafasi zaidi za kujificha katika maeneo madogo ili kuepuka hatari kutoka kwa wanyama wanaowawinda.

translations.source: Today, the only insects that cannot fold back their wings are dragon flies and mayflies.
translations.reference: Siku hizi, wadudu pekee ambao hawawezi kukunja mabawa yao kwenda nyuma ni kerengende na kipupe.
translations.hypothesis: Leo, aina pekee za wadudu ambazo hazifanyi kazi ya kurudisha mabawa yao nyuma ni wale wa aina ya "dragon flies" na "mayflies."

translations.source: Thousands of years ago, a man called Aristarchus said that the Solar System moved around the Sun.
translations.reference: Maelfu ya miaka iliyopita, mwanamume aliyeitwa Aristarchus alisema kwamba Mfumo wa Jua ulizunguka Jua.
translations.hypothesis: Elfu za miaka iliyopita, mtu aliyeitwa Aristarchus alisema kwamba mfumo wa jua huzunguka jua.

translations.source: Some people thought he was right but many people believed the opposite; that the Solar System moved around the Earth, including the Sun (and even the other stars).
translations.reference: Baadhi ya watu walidhani alikuwa sahihi lakini watu wengi waliamini kinyume chake; kwamba Mfumo wa Jua huzunguuka Dunia, pamoja na Jua (na hat nyota nyinginezo).
translations.hypothesis: Watu wengine walifikiri kwamba alikuwa sahihi, lakini wengi waliamini jambo tofauti; kwamba mfumo wa jua ulizunguka dunia, pamoja na jua (na hata nyota zingine).

translations.source: This seems sensible, because the Earth doesn't feel as if it's moving, does it?
translations.reference: Hii inaonekana kuwa busara, kwa sababu Dunia haionekani kana kwamba inasonga, au sivyo?
translations.hypothesis: Hii inaonekana kuwa jambo la busara, kwa sababu Dunia haioni kama inazunguka, sivyo?

translations.source: The Amazon River is the second longest and the biggest river on Earth. It carries more than 8 times as much water as the second biggest river.
translations.reference: Mto wa Amazon ndiyo mto wa pili kwa urefu na kubwa zaidi Duniani. Inachukua maji zaidi ya mara 8 kama mto wa pili mkubwa.
translations.hypothesis: Mto wa Amazon ni mto mrefu wa pili duniani na pia mmoja wa mito mikubwa zaidi. Una maji mengi zaidi ya mara nane kuliko mto mwingine mkubwa zaidi.

translations.source: The Amazon is also the widest river on Earth, at times six miles wide.
translations.reference: Amazon pia ni mto mpana zaidi Duniani, wakati mwingine maili sita kwa upana.
translations.hypothesis: Mto wa Amazon pia ni mto mpana zaidi duniani, na wakati mwingine unaweza kuwa na upana wa maili sita.

translations.source: A full 20 percent of the water that pours out of the planet's rivers into the oceans comes from the Amazon.
translations.reference: Asilimia 20 kamili ya maji ambayo yanatoka kwenye mito ya sayari kuenda ndani ya bahari hutoka kwenye Amazoni.
translations.hypothesis: Asilimia mia moja na ishirini ya maji ambayo hutoka kwenye mito ya sayari hii na kuingia baharini yanatoka kwenye mto Amazon.

translations.source: The main Amazon River is 6,387 km (3,980 miles). It collects water from thousands of smaller rivers.
translations.reference: Mto mkuu wa Amazon una kilomita 6,387 (maili 3,980). Hukusanya maji kutoka maelfu ya mito midogo.
translations.hypothesis: Mto mkuu wa Amazon una urefu wa kilomita 6,387 (maili 3,980). Mto huu hukusanya maji kutoka kwa mito mingi, maelfu kwa idadi, ambayo ni ndogo kuliko yake.
