translations.hypothesis: Mabadiliko yoyote au ombi lolote lazima yafanywe kupitia wakala wa usafiri kwanza, na si moja kwa moja kwa hoteli.

translations.source: For some festivals, the vast majority of the attendants to music festivals decide to camp on site, and most attendants consider it a vital part of the experience.
translations.reference: Kwa baadhi ya tamasha, idadi kubwa ya wanaohudhuria tamasha za muziki huamua kukita kambi kwenye eneo, na wengi wao hukuchukulia kuwa sehemu muhimu ya tajriba hiyo.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa tamasha zingine, idadi kubwa ya watu wanaohudhuria tamasha za muziki huamua kukaa katika eneo la tamasha, na wengi wao huona hilo kama sehemu muhimu ya uzoefu wao.

translations.source: If you want to be close to the action you're going to have to get in early to get a camping site close to the music.
translations.reference: Ikiwa ungetaka kuwa karibu na matukio utahitajika kurauka mapema ili upate eneo la kukita kambi karibu na muziki.
translations.hypothesis: Ikiwa unataka kuwa karibu na matukio, utalazimika kuwasiliana na maafisa wa eneo mapema ili upate eneo la kupiga kambi karibu na mahali ambapo muziki utapatikana.

translations.source: Remember that even though music on the main stages may have finished, there may be sections of the festival that will keep playing music until late into the night.
translations.reference: Kumbuka kuwa hata muziki kwenye jukwaa kuu ukimalizika, kunaweza kuwa na sehemu za tamasha ambazo zitaendelea kucheza muziki hadi usiku wa manane.
translations.hypothesis: Kumbuka kwamba ingawa muziki kwenye jukwaa kuu unaweza kuwa umekwisha, kunaweza kuwa na sehemu nyingine za tamasha ambazo zinaendelea kucheza muziki hadi mapema usiku.

translations.source: Some festivals have special camping areas for families with young children.
translations.reference: Tamasha kadhaa zina maeneo maalumu ya kukita kambi kwa familia zenye watoto wadogo.
translations.hypothesis: Baadhi ya tamasha zina maeneo maalum ya kupiga kambi yaliyotengenezwa kwa ajili ya familia zilizo na watoto wadogo.

translations.source: If crossing the Northern Baltic in winter, check the cabin location, as going through ice causes quite horrible noise for those most affected.
translations.reference: Kama unavuka Northern Baltic katika msimu wa baridi, kagua eneo la kibanda, kwani kupita katika theluji husababisha kelele mbaya kwa wale wanaoathirika zaidi.
translations.hypothesis: Iwapo unapanga kuvuka Bahari ya Baltic ya kaskazini wakati wa msimu wa baridi, hakikisha unajua eneo la kabini lako, kwani kupita kwenye barafu husababisha kelele kali sana ambayo inaweza kuwa ya kusumbua sana kwa wale waliomo karibu.

translations.source: Saint Petersburg cruises include time in town. Cruise passengers are exempted from visa requirements (check the terms).
translations.reference: Safari za baharini za Mtakatifu Petersburge hujumuisha muda wa mjini. Abiria hawa wameepushwa na mahitaji ya visa (angalia masharti).
translations.hypothesis: Safari za baharini za Saint Petersburg zinafahamisha muda wa kutumia katika mji. Abiria wa safari hizo hawatuhitaji visa (angalia masharti).

translations.source: Casinos typically make many efforts to maximize time and money spent by guests. Windows and clocks are usually absent, and exits can be hard to find.
translations.reference: Makasino kwa kawaida hufanya juhudi nyingi ili kuongeza pesa na muda unaotumika na wacheza kamari. Madirisha na saa kwa kawaida huwa hazipo na mlango wa kutoka huwa mgumu kupata.
translations.hypothesis: Kawaida, kasinobi hufanya juhudi nyingi ili kuongeza muda na pesa ambazo wageni hutumia ndani yao. Mara nyingi, madirisha na saa hazipo, na kuondoka kunaweza kuwa vigumu.

translations.source: They usually have special food, drink and entertainment offers, to keep guests in a good mood, and keep them at the premise.
translations.reference: Aghalabu huwa na chakula cha kipekee, vinywaji na matoleo ya burdani, ili kuwatumbuiza wageni na kuwatunza katika majengo yao.
translations.hypothesis: Wazazi hao kwa kawaida huandaa chakula maalum, vinywaji na burudani, ili kuwafurahisha wageni na kuwafanya waendelee kukaa mahali hapo.

translations.source: Some venues offer alcoholic beverages on the house. However, drunkenness impairs judgement, and all good gamblers know the importance of staying sober.
translations.reference: Baadhi ya kumbi hutoa vileo ndani ya nyumba. Hata hivyo, ulevi hutatiza maamuzi, na wacheza kamari wote wazuri wanajua umuhimu wa kuwa watulivu.
translations.hypothesis: Baadhi ya mahali huwapa wateja vinywaji vya pombe bila malipo. Hata hivyo, ulevi unaweza kufanya mtu asikimbie fikra, na kila mchezaji mahiri anajua umuhimu wa kukaa macho na busara.

translations.source: Anyone who's going to drive at high latitudes or over mountain passes should consider the possibility of snow, ice, or freezing temperatures.
translations.reference: Yeyote ambaye atakuwa akiendesha gari maeneo yaliyoinuka au vijia vya milimani anastahili kuzingatia uwezekano wa theluji, barafu, na baridi kali.
translations.hypothesis: Mtu yeyote anayepanga kuendesha gari katika maeneo ya kaskazini mwa dunia au kupitia milima, anapaswa kuzingatia uwezekano wa kuwa na theluji, barafu, au hali ya hewa baridi sana.

translations.source: On icy and snowy roadways, friction is low and you cannot drive as if you were on bare asphalt.
translations.reference: Katika barabara zenye barafu na theluji, msuguano uko chini na huwezi kuendesha gari kana kwamba uko katika lami tupu.
translations.hypothesis: Katika barabara ambazo zimefunikwa na barafu na theluji, mtego wa magurudumu unapungua, na hivyo huwezi kuendesha gari kama vile unavyoendesha kwenye barabara ambayo haijafunikwa.

translations.source: During blizzards, enough snow to get you stuck can fall in very little time.
translations.reference: Wakati wa barafu nyingi, barafu ya kutosha kukufanya ukwame inaweza kuanguka kwa muda mfupi.
translations.hypothesis: Wakati wa dhoruba za theluji, theluji nyingi ambazo zinaweza kukuzuia kusonga zinaweza kuanguka katika muda mfupi sana.

translations.source: Visibility may also be restricted by falling or blowing snow or by condensation or ice on vehicle windows.
translations.reference: Mwonekano unaweza pia kuzuiliwa kupitia kwa kuanguka au kuvumisha theluji au kwa mtonesho au barafu kwenye madirisha ya magari.
translations.hypothesis: Uwezo wa kuona unaweza pia kupunguzwa na theluji inayonyesha au inayovuma, au kutokana na ukungu au barafu iliyopo kwenye madirisha ya magari.

translations.source: On the other hand, icy and snowy conditions are normal in many countries, and traffic goes on mostly uninterrupted all year round.
translations.reference: Kwa upande mwingine, mazingira ya theluji na barafu ni ya kawaida katika mataifa mengi, na uchukuzi huendelea mwaka mzima bila kutatizwa.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa upande mwingine, hali ya baridi na theluji ni jambo la kawaida katika nchi nyingi, na trafiki huendelea kwa kawaida mwaka mzima, bila kukatizwa sana.

translations.source: Safaris are perhaps the greatest tourism draw in Africa and the highlight for many visitors.
translations.reference: Pengine safari ndizo kivutio kikubwa zaidi cha watalii katika Afrika na angazio la wageni wengi.
translations.hypothesis: Safari ndizo vivutio muhimu zaidi vya utalii barani Afrika, na ndio jambo ambalo wageni wengi huangazia zaidi wakati wa ziara zao.

translations.source: The term safari in popular use refers to overland travel to view the stunning African wildlife, particularly on savanna.
translations.reference: Neno safari linamaanisha kusafiri kuona Wanyama wa pori wa Afrika wanaoshangaza, haswa kwenye savanna
translations.hypothesis: Neno "safari," kama linavyotumika kwa kawaida, linarejelea safari za ardhi ambazo zinafanyika ili kuona wanyamapori wa Kiafrika, hasa wale wanaopatikana kwenye savana.

translations.source: Some animals, such as elephants and giraffes, tend to approach closely to cars and standard equipment will allow good viewing.
translations.reference: Baadhi ya wanyama, kama vile ndovu na twiga, huelekea kusogea kukaribia magari na vifaa vya kawaida vitaruhusu utazamaji mwema.
translations.hypothesis: Wanyama wengine, kama vile tembo na twiga, huwa wana tabia ya kukaribia magari, na vifaa vya kawaida vitakuruhusu kuwaona vizuri.

translations.source: Lions, cheetahs and leopards are sometimes shy and you will see them better with binoculars.
translations.reference: Simba, duma na chui wakati mwingine huwa na aibu na utawaona bora na darubini.
translations.hypothesis: Simba, chui na panari wakati mwingine huwa hawajali sana na huweza kuonekana vizuri zaidi kwa kutumia binoculari.

translations.source: A walking safari (also called a "bush walk", "hiking safari", or going "footing") consists of hiking, either for a few hours or several days.
translations.reference: Safari ya miguu (ijulikanayo kama "matembezi kichakani", "safari ya kukwea", au kwenda "kwa miguu") hujumuisha ukweaji, iwe kwa saa chache au siku kadhaa.
translations.hypothesis: Safari ya kutembea (pia inaitwa "tembezi katika misitu", "safari ya kupanda milima", au "tembea kwa miguu") inahusisha matembezi, iwe kwa saa chache au kwa siku kadhaa.

translations.source: The Paralympics will take place from 24 August to 5 September 2021. Some events will be held in other locations throughout Japan.
translations.reference: Mbio za Walemavu zitaanza mnamo Agosti 24 hadi Septemba 5, 2021. Baadhi ya mashindano yatafanyika katika maeneo tofauti tofauti kote Japani.
translations.hypothesis: Mchezo wa Paralimpiki utafanyika kuanzia tarehe 24 Agosti hadi 5 Septemba mwaka wa 2021. Baadhi ya mashindano yatafanyika katika maeneo mengine mbalimbali nchini Japani.

translations.source: Tokyo will be the only Asian city to have hosted two summer Olympics, having hosted the games in 1964.
translations.reference: Tokyo itakuwa mji wa kipekee wa Asia kuwahi kuwa mwenyeji wa Olimpiki mbili za kiangazi, kwani ilikuwa mwenyeji wa michezo hiyo mnamo 1964.
translations.hypothesis: Tokyo itakuwa mji pekee wa Asia ambao umewahi kuandaa michezo miwili ya Olimpiki ya majira ya joto, baada ya kuandaa michezo hiyo mwaka wa 1964.

translations.source: If you booked your flights and accommodation for 2020 before the postponement was announced, you may have a tricky situation.
translations.reference: Ikiwa ulihifadhi nafasi ya ndege na malazi yako 2020 kabla ya uahirisho kutangazwa, unaweza kuwa na hali ya hila.
translations.hypothesis: Ikiwa uliweka nafasi za ndege na malazi yako kwa mwaka wa 2020 kabla ya tangazo la kuahirishwa kufanyika, huenda ulikuwa katika hali ngumu.

translations.source: Cancellation policies vary, but as of late March most coronavirus-based cancellation policies don't extend to July 2020, when the Olympics had been scheduled.
translations.reference: Sera za kufuta zinatofautiana, lakini kufikia mwishoni mwa mwezi Machi sera nyingi za ughairi kwa sababu ya virusi vya korona hazifiki hadi Julai 2020, wakati Olimpiki ilikuwa imeratibiwa.
translations.hypothesis: Sheria za kufuta uhifadhi zinatofautiana, lakini kuanzia mwishoni mwa mwezi Machi, sera nyingi za kufuta uhifadhi zinazohusiana na virusi vya corona hazitumiki tena baada ya mwezi Julai wa mwaka wa 2020, wakati ambapo Michezo ya Olimpiki ilikuwa imeratibiwa kufanyika.

translations.source: It's expected that most event tickets will cost between ¥2,500 and ¥130,000, with typical tickets costing around ¥7,000.
translations.reference: Inatarajiwa kwamba tiketi nyingi za hafla zitagharimu kati ya Yeni 2,500 na Yeni 130,000, na tiketi za kawaida zikigharimu takriban Yeni 7,000.
translations.hypothesis: Inatarajiwa kwamba tiketi za matukio mengi zitagharimu kati ya ¥2,500 na ¥130,000, huku tiketi za kawaida zikigharimu takriban ¥7,000.

translations.source: Ironing damp clothes can help them dry. Many hotels have an iron and ironing board available for loan, even if one is not present in the room.
translations.reference: Kupiga pasi nguo zilizo na maji kunaweza kuzisaidia kukauka. Hoteli nyingi zina pasi na bodi za kupigia pasi za kukodisha, hata kama mtu hayuko ndani ya chumba hicho.
translations.hypothesis: Kupiga nguo ambazo bado hazijakauka kwa kiyoyozi kunaweza kusaidia kuzikauka haraka. Hoteli nyingi zina kiyoyozi na meza ya kupiga nguo ambazo zinaweza kukodishwa, hata kama hazipo ndani ya chumba.

translations.source: If an iron isn't available, or if you don't fancy wearing ironed socks, then you can try using a hairdryer, if available.
translations.reference: Ikiwa pasi haipatikani, au ikiwa hupendii kuvaa soksi zilizopasiwa, basi unaweza kujaribu kutumia kikaushi nywele, ikiwa kinapatikana.
translations.hypothesis: Ikiwa hakuna kiyoyozi, au ikiwa hutaki kuvaa soksi zilizopigwa, unaweza kujaribu kutumia kinyozi cha nywele, ikiwa una.

translations.source: Be careful not to allow fabric to become too hot (which can cause shrinkage, or in extreme cases, scorch).
translations.reference: Uwe mwangalifu kitambaa kisiwe moto sana (kwani inaweza kusababisha urukaji, au katika hali mbaya zaidi, kuchoma).
translations.hypothesis: Hakikisha kuwa hairuhusu kitambaa hicho kuchomwa sana (kwani hicho kinaweza kusababisha kitambaa hicho kukonda, au katika hali mbaya, kuchomwa).

translations.source: There are different ways of purifying water, some more effective against specific threats.
translations.reference: Kuna njia tofauti za kusafisha maji, baadhi zikiwa na mafanikio dhidi ya vitishio maalum.
translations.hypothesis: Kuna njia tofauti za kusafisha maji, na baadhi ya njia hizo ni bora zaidi katika kuondoa hatari fulani.

translations.source: In some areas boiling water for a minute is enough, in others several minutes are needed.
translations.reference: Katika baadhi ya maeneo mengine kuchemsha maji kwa dakika moja kunatosha, kwingineko dakika kadhaa zitahitajika.
translations.hypothesis: Katika baadhi ya maeneo, kuchemsha maji kwa dakika moja tu ni ya kutosha, lakini katika maeneo mengine, inahitajika kuchemsha kwa dakika kadhaa.

translations.source: Filters vary in effectiveness, and should you have a concern, then you should consider buying your water in a sealed bottle from a reputable company.
translations.reference: Vichujio hutofautiana katika utendaji, na iwapo utapatwa na wasiwasi, basi unafaa kufikiria kununua maji yako katika chupa iliyofungwa kabisa kutoka kwa kampuni tajika.
translations.hypothesis: Vifaa vya kuchuja maji hutofautiana kwa ufanisi, na ikiwa una wasiwasi wowote, unapaswa kuzingatia kununua maji yako katika chupa iliyofungwa kutoka kwa kampuni inayostahili.

translations.source: Travellers may encounter animal pests that they are not familiar with in their home regions.
translations.reference: Wasafiri wanaweza kukutana na wadudu wa wanyama ambao hawawatambui kutoka maeneo yao ya nyumbani.
translations.hypothesis: Watalii wanaweza kukutana na wanyama hatari ambao hawajawahi kuona katika maeneo yao ya makazi.

translations.source: Pests can spoil food, cause irritation, or in a worse case cause allergic reactions, spread venom, or transmit infections.
translations.reference: Wadudu waharibifu wanaweza kuharibu chakula, kusababisha maudhi, au katika hali mbaya kusababisha athari za mzio, kueneza sumu au kusambaza maambukizi.
translations.hypothesis: Viumbe hatari vinaweza kuharibu chakula, kusababisha uvimbe na kuwashwa, au katika hali mbaya zaidi, kusababisha athari za mzio, kusambaza sumu, au kusambaza magonjwa.

translations.source: Infectious diseases themselves, or dangerous animals that can injure or kill people by force, do not usually qualify as pests.
translations.reference: Maradhi yenyewe ya kuambukiza, au wanyama hatari ambao wanaweza kujeruhi au kuua watu kwa nguvu, kwa kawaida hawahitimu kama wanyama-vipenzi.
translations.hypothesis: Magonjwa ambayoweza kuenezwa, au wanyama hatari ambao wanaweza kujeruhi au kuuwa watu kwa nguvu, kwa kawaida hawachukuliwi kama wadudu.

translations.source: Duty free shopping is the opportunity to buy goods exempted from taxes and excises at certain locations.
translations.reference: Ununuzi bila ushuru ni nafasi ya kununua bidhaa zisizo na ushuru na kodi katika maeneo fulani.
translations.hypothesis: Ununuzi wa bidhaa bila kodi ni fursa ya kununua bidhaa ambazo hazilipi kodi au ushuru katika maeneo fulani.

translations.source: Travellers bound for countries with heavy taxation can sometimes save a considerable amount of money, especially on products such as alcoholic beverages and tobacco.
translations.reference: Wasafiri katika nchi zinazotoza ushuru wa juu wakati mwingine wanaweza kuokoa kiwango kikubwa cha pesa, hasa kwa bidhaa kama vinywaji vyenye vileo na tumbaku.
translations.hypothesis: Watalii wanaoelekea nchi ambazo zina viwango vya juu vya ushuru wakati mwingine wanaweza kuokoa pesa nyingi, hasa kwenye bidhaa kama vile vinywaji vya pombe na tumbaku.

translations.source: The stretch between Point Marion and Fairmont presents the most challenging driving conditions on the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway, passing frequently through isolated backwoods terrain.
translations.reference: Eneo katikati mwa Point Marion na Fairmont hutoa hali za uendeshaji gari zenye changamoto zaidi katika Barabara Kuu ya Buffalo-Pittsburgh, inayopitia mara kwa mara kwenye maeneo ya ardhi yaliyo katika misitu iliyotengwa.
translations.hypothesis: Sehemu iliyoko kati ya mji wa Point Marion na mji wa Fairmont ndiyo yenye hali ngumu zaidi ya barabara kwenye barabara kuu ya Buffalo-Pittsburgh, kwani inapita mara kwa mara kupitia maeneo yasiyokuwa na watu na misitu minene.

translations.source: If you're not used to driving on country roads, keep your wits about you: steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves predominate.
translations.reference: Kama hujazoea kuendesha gari katika barabara za mashambani, kaa chonjo: miinuko mikali, njia nyembamba, na na pembe kali zimejaa.
translations.hypothesis: Ikiwa huendi kwa kawaida barabara za vijijini, kuwa mwangalifu: barabara hizo huwa na mteremko mkali, njia nyembamba, na mwinuko mkali.

translations.source: Posted speed limits are noticeably lower than in previous and subsequent sections — commonly 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — and strict obedience to them is even more important than otherwise.
translations.reference: Viwango vya kasi vilivyotumwa viko chini kabisa kuliko vya sehemu za zamani na zilizofuata — kawaida maili 35-40 kwa saa (kilomita 56-64 kwa saa) — na utii mkali kwavyo ni muhimu zaidi kuliko vinginevyo.
translations.hypothesis: Viashiria vya mwendo unaokubalika vilivyowekwa katika eneo hilo ni vya chini kuliko vilivyokuwa katika sehemu zingine za barabara, na kwa kawaida ni kati ya maili 35-40 (takriban kilomita 56-64) kwa saa. Ni muhimu sana kuyafuata kwa makini zaidi kuliko katika sehemu nyingine za barabara.

translations.source: Curiously, though, mobile phone service is much stronger here than along many other stretches of the route, e.g. the Pennsylvania Wilds.
translations.reference: Cha kushangaza hata hivyo, huduma ya simu ya rununu ina nguvu sana hapa kuliko tandaa zingine za njia kama Pennsylvania Wilds.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa kushangaza, huduma ya simu za mkononi hapa ni imara zaidi kuliko katika sehemu nyingi nyingine za njia hiyo, kama vile eneo la Pennsylvania Wilds.

translations.source: German pastries are quite good, and in Bavaria, are quite rich and varied, similar to those of their southern neighbor, Austria.
translations.reference: Mikate ya Kijerumani ni mizuri mno, na huko Bavaria, ni bora zaidi na tofauti, sawasawa na ile ya jirani yao wa kusini, Austria.
translations.hypothesis: Bidhaa za kuoka za Ujerumani ni nzuri sana, na katika eneo la Bavaria, zina utajiri na utofauti mkubwa, sawa na zile za nchi jirani yao ya kusini, Austria.

translations.source: Fruit pastries are common, with apples cooked into pastries year round, and cherries and plums making their appearances during the summer.
translations.reference: Vinyunga vya matunda ni za kawaida, na tufaa zilizopikwa kuwa vinyunga mwaka mzima, na cheri na plamu zikionekana wakati wa msimu wa joto.
translations.hypothesis: Bidhaa za kuoka zilizo na matunda ni za kawaida, na matunda kama vile maapulo hutumika katika bidhaa hizo mwaka mzima, huku matunda kama vile cherries na plums zikitokea zaidi wakati wa majira ya joto.

translations.source: Many German baked goods also feature almonds, hazelnuts, and other tree nuts. Popular cakes often pair particularly well with a cup of strong coffee.
translations.reference: Nyingi ya bidhaa za kuokwa kutoka Ujerumani huwa lozi, na karanga. Keki zilizo maarufu mara nyingi huambatana vizuri na kikombe cha kahawa kali.
translations.hypothesis: Bidhaa nyingi za kuoka za Ujerumani pia zina matunda ya karanga kama vile karanga, hasha, na aina nyingine za karanga. Keki maarufu nyingi huwa zinafaa sana kuambatana na kikombe cha kahawa kali.

translations.source: If you want some small though rich pastries, try what depending on region are called Berliner, Pfannkuchen or Krapfen.
translations.reference: Ikiwa unataka vitumbua vidogo ingawa bora, jaribu kile ambacho kutegemea eneo kinaitwa Berliner, Pfannkuchen au Krapfen.
translations.hypothesis: Ikiwa unataka vitafunwa vidogo lakini vyenye ladha, jaribu kile ambacho, kulingana na eneo, huitwa "Berliner," "Pfannkuchen," au "Krapfen."

translations.source: A curry is a dish based on herbs and spices, together with either meat or vegetables.
translations.reference: Bizari ni chakula kilichoundwa kwa mimea na viungo, pamoja na nyama au mboga.
translations.hypothesis: Chakula cha curry ni sahani ambayo huandaliwa kwa kutumia mimea na viungo mbalimbali, pamoja na nyama au mboga.

translations.source: A curry can be either "dry" or "wet" depending on the amount of liquid.
translations.reference: Bizari inaweza kuwa "kavu" au "yenye unyevunyevu" kulingana na kiasi cha kioevu.
translations.hypothesis: Chakula cha curry kinaweza kuwa "kavu" au "cha kioevu," kulingana na kiasi cha kioevu kilichomo.

translations.source: In inland regions of Northern India and Pakistan, yogurt is commonly used in curries; in Southern India and some other coastal regions of the subcontinent, coconut milk is commonly used.
translations.reference: katika maeneo ya bara la Kaskazini mwa India na Pakistani, mtindi kwa kawaida hutumiwa katika mchuzi wenye viungo; Katika Kusini mwa India na mikoa mingine ya pwani ya bara ndogo, maziwa ya nazi hutumiwa sana.
translations.hypothesis: Katika maeneo ya ndani ya kaskazini mwa India na Pakistan, mtindi hutumika kwa kawaida katika vyakula vya aina ya "curry"; katika kusini mwa India na baadhi ya maeneo mengine ya pwani ya eneo hilo, maziwa ya kokoti hutumika kwa kawaida.

translations.source: With 17,000 islands to choose from, Indonesian food is an umbrella term covering a vast variety of regional cuisines found across the nation.
translations.reference: Kukiwa na visiwa 17,000 vya kuchagua, chakula cha Indonesia ni jina la kijumla linalosimamia aina kubwa ya vyakula vinavyopatikana kote nchini.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa kuwa Indonesia ina visiwa 17,000, vyakula vya Indonesia ni neno pana ambalo linajumuisha aina mbalimbali za vyakula vya kanda tofauti ambazo zipo katika nchi nzima.

translations.source: But, if used without further qualifiers, the term tends to mean the food originally from the central and eastern parts of the main island Java.
translations.reference: Lakini, llikitumiwa bila vivumishi zaidi, neno hilo huelekea kumaanisha chakula ambacho mwanzoni kilitoka sehemu za kati na mashariki mwa kisiwa kikuu cha Java.
translations.hypothesis: Hata hivyo, ikiwa neno hilo litatumika bila maelezo mengine, kwa kawaida linamaanisha chakula ambacho kilitoka awali katika sehemu za kati na za mashariki za kisiwa kikubwa cha Java.

translations.source: Now widely available throughout the archipelago, Javanese cuisine features an array of simply seasoned dishes, the predominant flavorings the Javanese favor being peanuts, chillies, sugar (especially Javanese coconut sugar) and various aromatic spices.
translations.reference: Chakula kinachopatikana sana katika maeneo mapana ya funguvisiwa, ni vyakula vya Kijavanese vilivyotayarishwa kwa ustadi sahili, ladha yake ya kimsingi ikiwa ni njugu karanga, pilipili, sukari (hususan sukari ya nazi ya Javanese) na viungo tofauti vinavyonukia.
translations.hypothesis: Sasa, vyakula vya Java vinapatikana kwa urahisi katika archipelago nzima, na vina aina mbalimbali za vyombo ambavyo vimechanganywa kwa viungo vichache. Viungo muhimu ambavyo watu wa Java wanapenda kutumia ni karanga, pilipili, sukari (hasa sukari ya nazi ya Java) na viungo mbalimbali vinavyotoa harufu nzuri.

translations.source: Stirrups are supports for the rider's feet that hang down on either side of the saddle.
translations.reference: Vikuku ni nguzo zinazoshikilia miguu ya mwendeshaji ambazo huning’inia chini katika pande zote mbili za matandiko.
translations.hypothesis: "Mifupa ni sehemu ambazo huunganishwa kwenye kiti cha farasi na hutumika kuunga mkono miguu ya mpanda farasi, na huwekwa pande zote mbili za kiti."

translations.source: They provide greater stability for the rider but can have safety concerns due to the potential for a rider's feet to get stuck in them.
translations.reference: Zinampa mpanda farasi utulivu mkubwa lakini zinaweza kuwa na wasiwasi wa kiusalama kwa sababu ya uwezo wa miguu ya mpanda farasi kukwama ndani yake.
translations.hypothesis: Zinatoa utulivu zaidi kwa mtu anayeendesha, lakini zinaweza kusababisha wasiwasi wa usalama kwa sababu kuna uwezekano wa miguu ya mtu anayeendesha kukwama ndani yao.

translations.source: If a rider is thrown from a horse but has a foot caught in the stirrup, they could be dragged if the horse runs away. To minimize this risk, a number of safety precautions can be taken.
translations.reference: Ikiwa mwendeshaji farasi atatupwa kuotka kwa farasi lakini mguu wake ufungiwe kwenye tandiko, wanaweza kukokotwa ikiwa farasi atatoroka. Ili kupunguza hatari hii, hatua kadhaa za usalama zinaweza kuchukuliwa.
translations.hypothesis: Iwapo mpanda farasi atanguka kutoka kwenye farasi lakini mguu wake umekwama kwenye kamba ya mguu, anaweza kuvutwa pamoja ikiwa farasi huyo atakimbia. Ili kupunguza hatari hii, hatua kadhaa za usalama zinaweza kuchukuliwa.

translations.source: First, most riders wear riding boots with a heel and a smooth, quite narrow, sole.
translations.reference: Kwanza, waendeshaji wengi huvaa kiatu cha buti kilicho juu na laini, chembamba kabisa, soli.
translations.hypothesis: Kwanza, waendesha pikipiki wengi huvaa buti maalum za kuendesha ambazo zina kisigino na sole laini, nyembamba sana.

translations.source: Next, some saddles, particularly English saddles, have safety bars that allow a stirrup leather to fall off the saddle if pulled backwards by a falling rider.
translations.reference: Kisha, matandiko mengine, hasa matandiko ya Kiingereza yana fito za kiusalama ambzo huruhusu ngozi ya kuvutwa kuangukia tandiko kama kama itavutwa nyuma na mpanda farasi anayeanguka.
translations.hypothesis: Baada ya hayo, baadhi ya kiti cha farasi, hasa kiti cha farasi cha mtindo wa Kiingereza, zina vipengele vya usalama ambavyo huruhusu kamba ya kishikilia miguu (stirrup) kutenguka kutoka kwenye kiti cha farasi ikiwa itanyukwa nyuma na mpanda farasi ambaye amevunjika.

translations.source: Cochamó Valley - Chile's premier climbing destination, known as the Yosemite of South America, with a variety of granite big walls and crags.
translations.reference: Bonde la Cochamo – eneo kuu la makusudio ya ukweaji nchini Chile, lijulikanalo kama Yosemite ya Marekani Kusini, na kuta kubwa anuwai za matale na majabali.
translations.hypothesis: Bonde la Cochamó - eneo maarufu nchini Chile kwa kupanda milima, linalojulikana kama "Yosemite ya Amerika Kusini," na linajumuisha kuta kubwa za granite na maeneo mengine ya kupanda.

translations.source: Summits include breath-taking views from peaks. Climbers from all parts of the world are continually establishing new routes amongst its endless potential of walls.
translations.reference: Mikutano huwa na mandhari za kusisimua kutoka vileleni. Wapanda mlima kutoka pande zote za ulimwengu wanaendelea kuanzisha njia mpya kati ya uwezo wake wa kuta.
translations.hypothesis: Machozi ya kuvutia yanaonekana kutoka kilele cha milima hiyo. Wafanyakazi wa kupanda milima kutoka sehemu mbalimbali za dunia wanaendelea kutengeneza njia mpya katika milima hiyo, ambayo ina uwezo usio na kikomo wa kupanda.

translations.source: Downhill snowsports, which include skiing and snowboarding, are popular sports involving sliding down snow-covered terrain with skis or a snowboard attached to your feet.
translations.reference: Michezo ya theluji ya kuteremka, ambayo ni pamoja na mchezo wa kuteleza juu ya theluji na mchezo wa kupanda theluji, ni michezo maarufu inayohusisha kuteleza chini ya ardhi iliyofunikwa na theluji kwa ubaos au bao za theluji zilizofungiwa kwenye miguu yako.
translations.hypothesis: Mchezo wa michezo ya theluji unaofanyika kwenye mteremko, kama vile skiing na snowboarding, ni michezo maarufu ambayo inahusisha kupiga theluji kwenye eneo lililojaa theluji, huku ukitumia skis au bodi ya theluji ambayo imechomekwa kwenye miguu yako.

translations.source: Skiing is a major travelling activity with many enthusiasts, occasionally known as "ski bums," planning entire vacations around skiing at a particular location.
translations.reference: Kuteleza juu ya theluji ni shughuli kubwa huku washiriki wengi, ambao mara kwa mara hujulikana kama "ski bums," wakipanga likizo nzima kwa kuteleza juu ya theluji katika eneo fulani.
translations.hypothesis: Uporaji ni shughuli muhimu ya utalii, na watu wengi wanapenda sana. Wakati mwingine, watu hawa hujulikana kama "waporaji wa kawaida," na wengi wao huandaa likizo zao nzima kulingana na uwezekano wa kuporanga katika eneo fulani.

translations.source: The idea of skiing is very old — cave paintings depicting skiers date back as far as 5000 BC!
translations.reference: Wazo la uendeshaji ubao kwenye theluji ni la zamani sana - michoro ya pango inaonyesha waendeshaji wa ubao kwenye theluji wa miaka ya zamani ya hadi 5000 KK!
translations.hypothesis: Wazo la kupiga risasi (skiing) ni la zamani sana—picha za kuchorwa kwenye kuta za magamba zinazoonyesha watu wakipiga risasi zimetambulika kuwa zimetoka miaka 5000 iliyopita!

translations.source: Downhill skiing as a sport goes back to at least the 17th century, and in 1861 the first recreational ski club was opened by Norwegians in Australia.
translations.reference: Mchezo wa kuteleza kwa kasi kwenye mteremko wenye theluji ulianza angalau karne ya 17, na mnamo 1861 kilabu cha kwanza cha burudani cha utelezaji kwenye barafu kilifunguliwa na watu wa Norwegi huko Australia.
translations.hypothesis: Mchezo wa kupiga risasi kwenye mteremko una mizizi yake angalau tangu karne ya 17, na mwaka wa 1861, Wanorwe walifungua klabu ya kwanza ya burudani ya kupiga risasi nchini Australia.

translations.source: Backpacking by ski: This activity is also called backcountry ski, ski touring or ski hiking.
translations.reference: Kuteleza kwa kubeba shanta: Shughuli hii pia huitwa kuteleza mashambani, kutalii kwa kuteleza au matembezi ya kuteleza.
translations.hypothesis: Kuendesha kwa ski katika maeneo yasiyo na barabara: Shughuli hii pia inajulikana kama "skiing katika maeneo ya mbali," "ziara za ski," au "tembea kwa ski."

translations.source: It is related to but usually not involving alpine style ski touring or mountaineering, the latter ones done in steep terrain and requiring much stiffer skis and boots.
translations.reference: Inahusiana na lakini kawaida haishirikiani na ziara za utelezaji kwenye theluji ya milima mirefu au upandaji wa milima, hilo la mwisho hufanywa katika eneo lenye mteremko na linahitaji bao na buti ngumu.
translations.hypothesis: Ni aina ya shughuli inayohusiana na utalii wa skiing na kupanda milima, lakini kwa kawaida haihusishi kupanda milima kwa mtindo wa "alpine" au kupanda milima katika maeneo magumu, ambapo inahitajika kutumia vifaa vya skiing na viatu vikali zaidi.

translations.source: Think of the skiing route as of a similar hiking route.
translations.reference: Fikiria kuhusu njia ya utelezaji kwa theluji kama njia mfanano ya kukwea.
translations.hypothesis: Fikiria njia ya kupiga risasi kama njia ya kupanda mlima.

translations.source: In good conditions you will be able to cover somewhat greater distances than walking – but only very seldom you will get the speeds of cross country skiing without a heavy backpack in groomed tracks.
translations.reference: Katika hali nzuri utaweza kufikia umbali mkubwa kiasi kuliko kutembea – lakini ni mara chache sana utapata kasi za kuteleza sehemu za mashambani bila shanta nzito katika njia zilizopitiwa awali.
translations.hypothesis: Katika hali nzuri, utaweza kufikia umbali mkubwa zaidi kuliko unapokuwa mtembelezi—lakini mara chache tu utapata mwendo sawa na ule wa skiing kwenye njia zilizotayarishwa, bila kuwa na mfuko mzito mgongoni.

translations.source: Europe is a continent that is relatively small but with many independent countries. Under normal circumstances, travelling through multiple countries would mean having to go through visa applications and passport control multiple times.
translations.reference: Uropa ni bara ambalo ni dogo kiasi lakini lina nchi nyingi huru. Katika hali ya kawaida, kusafiri kupitia nchi nyingi kungemaanisha kulazimika kufanya maombi ya visa na udhibiti wa pasipoti mara nyingi.
translations.hypothesis: Ulaya ni bara dogo, lakini lenye mataifa mengi huru. Kwa kawaida, kusafiri kupitia mataifa mengi kunamaanisha kuwa lazima upitie michakato ya maombi ya visa na ukaguzi wa pasipoti mara nyingi.

translations.source: The Schengen zone, however, works somewhat like one country in this respect.
translations.reference: Eneo la Schengen, hata hivyo, hufanya kazi kiasi kama nchi moja kuhusiana na jambo hili.
translations.hypothesis: Hata hivyo, eneo la Schengen linafanya kazi kama nchi moja katika suala hilo.

translations.source: As long as you stay in this zone, you can generally cross borders without going through passport control checkpoints again.
translations.reference: Bora ubakie katika eneo hili, unaweza kuvuka mipaka bila kupitia maeneo ya ukaguzi wa pasipoti tena.
translations.hypothesis: Mradi utakaa katika eneo hili, kwa kawaida unaweza kuvuka mipaka bila kuhitajika kupitia tena vituo vya ukaguzi wa pasipoti.

translations.source: Similarly, by having a Schengen visa, you do not need to apply for visas to each of the Schengen member countries separately, hence saving time, money and paperwork.
translations.reference: Vilevile, kwa kuwa na visa ya Schengen, huhitaji kutoa maombi ya visa kwa kila nchi iliyo memba wa Schengen kivyake, hivyo kuokoa muda, pesa na nyaraka.
translations.hypothesis: Vivyo hivyo, kwa kuwa una visa ya Schengen, huna haja ya kuomba visa kwa kila nchi mojawapo ambazo ni sehemu ya eneo la Schengen, na hivyo kuokoa muda, pesa na utaratibu wa karatasi.

translations.source: There is no universal definition for which manufactured items are antiques. Some tax agencies define goods older than 100 years as antiques.
translations.reference: Hakuna ufafanuzi wa kijumla kuhusu ni bidhaa zipi za viwandani ni za kale. Baadhi ya mashirika ya ushuru hufafanua bidhaa zenye zaidi ya miaka 100 kuwa za kale.
translations.hypothesis: Hakuna ufafanuzi mmoja unaokubalika kwa vitu gani vilivyotengenezwa ambavyo vinaweza kuchukuliwa kama vitu vya kale. Baadhi ya mashirika ya ukusanyaji kodi hufafanua bidhaa ambazo zina umri wa zaidi ya miaka 100 kama vitu vya kale.

translations.source: The definition has geographic variations, where the age limit might be shorter in places such as North America than in Europe.
translations.reference: Ufafanuzi una tofauti za kijiografia, ambapo kikomo cha umri kinaweza kuwa kifupi katika maeneo kama Marekani ya Kaskazini kuliko Ulaya.
translations.hypothesis: Ufafanuzi huo una tofauti kulingana na eneo, ambapo kikomo cha umri kinaweza kuwa tofauti katika maeneo kama vile Amerika Kaskazini kuliko Ulaya.

translations.source: Handicraft products might be defined as antiques, though they are younger than similar mass-produced goods.
translations.reference: Bidhaa za sanaa zinaweza kufafanuliwa kama bidhaa za kale, ingawa ni changa kuliko bidhaa sawa zinazotengenezwa kwa wingi.
translations.hypothesis: Bidhaa za mikono zinaweza kufafanuliwa kama vitu vya kale, ingawa ni vipya zaidi kuliko bidhaa sawa ambazo hutengenezwa kwa wingi.

translations.source: Reindeer husbandry is an important livelihood among the Sámi and the culture surrounding the trade is important also for many with other professions.
translations.reference: Ukulima wa kulungu aktiki ni riziki muhimu miongoni mwa watu wa Sámi na utamaduni unaozunguka biashara hiyo ni muhimu pia kwa wengi walio na taaluma nyingine.
translations.hypothesis: Kilimo cha nyumbu ni jambo muhimu kwa watu wa kabila la Sámi, na utamaduni unaohusiana na biashara hiyo pia ni muhimu kwa watu wengi wanaofanya kazi nyingine.

translations.source: Even traditionally, though, not all Sámi have been involved in big scale reindeer husbandry, but lived from fishing, hunting and similar, having reindeer mostly as draft animals.
translations.reference: Hata hivyo tangu jadi, sio Sami wote wamekuwa wakijihusisha na ufugaji mkubwa wa kulungu aktiki, lakini waliishi kutoka kwa uvuvi, uwindaji na nyingine kama hizo, na kufuga kulungu aktiki sana sana kama wanyama wa kufanya kazi.
translations.hypothesis: Hata hivyo, hata katika mila za zamani, si Wasaami wote walishiriki katika ufugaji mkubwa wa nyumbu, bali walitoka kwa uvuvi, uwindaji na shughuli nyinginezo, huku wakitumia nyumbu hasa kama wanyama wa kuvuta.

translations.source: Today many Sámi work in modern trades. Tourism is an important income in Sápmi, the Sámi area.
translations.reference: Leo Wasámi wengi hufanya kazi katika biashara za kisasa. Utalii ni wa mapato muhimu katika Sápmi, eneo la Sámi.
translations.hypothesis: Leo, watu wengi wa kabila la Sámi hufanya kazi katika biashara za kisasa. Utalii ni chanzo muhimu cha mapato katika eneo la Sápmi, ambako wanaishi watu wa Sámi.

translations.source: Though it is widely used, especially among non-Romani, the word "Gypsy" is often considered offensive because of its associations with negative stereotypes and inaccurate perceptions of Romani people.
translations.reference: Ingawa inatumika sana, na hususana miongoni mwa watu wasio Waromani, neno "Jipsi" mara nyingi huchukuliwa kama la kukera kwa sababu linahusishwa na ubaguzi hasi na mitazamo isiyo sahihi ya watu wa Romani.
translations.hypothesis: Ingawa neno "Gypsy" linatumika sana, hasa miongoni mwa watu ambao si wa kabila la Romani, mara nyingi linaonekana kuwa dhalilifu kwa sababu linahusishwa na fikra mbaya na maoni yasiyo sahihi kuhusu watu wa kabila la Romani.

translations.source: If the country you will be visiting becomes subject to a travel advisory, your travel health insurance or your trip cancellation insurance may be affected.
translations.reference: Kama nchi utakayozuru itakua ni somo kwa ushauri wa kusafiri, bima ya afya yako au bima ya kufuta usafiri wako huenda ikaathirika.
translations.hypothesis: Iwapo nchi unayopanga kuitembelea itatoa onyo la usafiri, bima yako ya afya ya usafiri au bima ya kusitisha safari inaweza kuathirika.

translations.source: You may also wish to consult the advice of governments other than your own, but their advice is designed for their citizens.
translations.reference: Pia pengine ungetaka kushauriana na ushauri wa serikali bali na yako, lakini ushauri wao umeundiwa raia wao.
translations.hypothesis: Unaweza pia kutaka kushauriana na ushauri wa serikali zingine, lakini ushauri huo umebuniwa kwa ajili ya wananchi wao.

translations.source: As one example, American citizens in the Middle East might face different situations from Europeans or Arabs.
translations.reference: Kama mfano mmoja, raia wa Marekani katika Mashariki ya Kati huenda wakakumbwa na hali tofauti kutoka kwa Wazungu na Waarabu.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa mfano, raia wa Marekani wanaokaa Mashariki ya Kati wanaweza kukumbana na hali tofauti kuliko Waeuroperi au Waarabu.

translations.source: Advisories are merely a brief summary of the political situation in one country.
translations.reference: Ushauri ni muhtasari mfupi tu wa hali ya kisiasa katika nchi moja.
translations.hypothesis: Taarifa za onyo ni tu muhtasari mfupi wa hali ya kisiasa katika nchi moja.

translations.source: The views presented are often cursory, general and oversimplified compared to the more detailed information available elsewhere.
translations.reference: Maoni yanayowasilishwa mara nyingi huwa ni ya haraka, ya kijumla na yaliyosahilishwa sana yakilinganishwa na habari za kina zinazopatikana kwingineko.
translations.hypothesis: Maoni yaliyowasilishwa mara nyingi ni ya kawaida, ya jumla, na yamefupushwa sana kulinganisha na taarifa za kina ambazo zipo mahali pengine.

translations.source: Severe weather is the generic term for any dangerous weather phenomenon with the potential to cause damage, serious social disruption, or loss of human life.
translations.reference: Hali kali ya hewa ni neno la kawaida kwa hali yoyote hatari ya hali ya hewa na ina uwezo wa kusababisha uharibifu, usumbufu mkubwa wa kijamii, au kupotea kwa maisha ya mwanadamu.
translations.hypothesis: Hali mbaya ya hewa ni neno la jumla linalotumika kuelezea hali yoyote ya hewa hatari ambayo ina uwezo wa kusababisha uharibifu, msukosuko mkubwa katika jamii, au kupoteza maisha ya binadamu.

translations.source: Severe weather can occur anywhere in the world, and there are different types of it, which can depend on geography, topography, and atmospheric conditions.
translations.reference: Hali kali ya hewa inawezakuwa popote duniani, na kuna aina nyingi ambazo zinaweza kutegemea jiografia, sura ya nchi, na hali ya anga.
translations.hypothesis: Hali mbaya ya hewa inaweza kutokea katika sehemu yoyote ya dunia, na kuna aina tofauti za hali hiyo, ambazo zinaweza kutegemea eneo, muundo wa ardhi, na hali za anga.

translations.source: High winds, hail, excessive precipitation, and wildfires are forms and effects of severe weather, as are thunderstorms, tornadoes, waterspouts, and cyclones.
translations.reference: Upepo mkubwa,mvua ya mawe, ukaukaji, na mioto ya msitu ni maumbo na athari za hali kali za hewa, vilevile dhoruba, , tufani, mifereji ya maji na vimbunga.
translations.hypothesis: Upepo mkali, theluji, mvua kubwa, na moto wa misitu ni baadhi ya aina na matokeo ya hali ya hewa kali, kama vile dhoruba, twista, vimbunga vya maji, na dhoruba.

translations.source: Regional and seasonal severe weather phenomena include blizzards, snowstorms, ice storms, and dust storms.
translations.reference: Matukio ya hali kali ya hewa ya kieneo na kimsimu yanatia ndani dhoruba kali za theluji, dhoruba za theluji, dhoruba za barafu, na dhoruba za vumbi.
translations.hypothesis: Matukio makubwa ya hali ya hewa katika eneo na wakati fulani, kama vile dhoruba, vimbunga vya theluji, mvua ya barafu, na vimbunga vya vumbi, ni baadhi ya mifano.

translations.source: Travellers are strongly advised to be aware of any risk of severe weather affecting their area as they may affect any travel plans.
translations.reference: Wasafiri wanashauriwa kwa dhati kujua kuhusu hatari yoyote ya anga mbaya inayoathiri eneo lao kwani huenda ikaathiri mipango yoyote ya usafiri.
translations.hypothesis: Watalii wanashauriwa sana kuwa waangalifu na hatari yoyote ya hali ya hewa kali ambayo inaweza kuathiri eneo lao, kwani hali hiyo inaweza kuathiri mipango yoyote ya usafiri.

translations.source: Anyone planning a visit to a country that could be considered a war zone should get professional training.
translations.reference: Mtu yeyote anayepanga kutembelea nchi ambayo inazingatiwa kuwa eneo la vita anapaswa kupata mafunzo ya kitaalamu.
translations.hypothesis: Mtu yeyote anayetarajia kutembelea nchi ambayo inaweza kuzingatiwa kuwa eneo la vita anapaswa kupata mafunzo ya kitaalamu.

translations.source: A search of the Internet for 'Hostile environment course' will probably provide the address of a local company.
translations.reference: Utafutaji wa ‘Kozi ya mazingira yenye uhasama’ kwenye Intaneti huenda pengine ukatoa anwani ya kampuni ya kienyeji.
translations.hypothesis: Utafiti wa mtandao kwa maneno "kozi ya mazingira hatari" pengine utatoa anwani ya kampuni iliyoko karibu na wewe.

translations.source: A course will normally cover all the issues discussed here in far greater detail, usually with practical experience.
translations.reference: Kwa kawaida kozi itashughulikia masuala yote yaliyojadiliwa hapa kwa kina, na aghalabu pamoja na uzoefu wa moja kwa moja.
translations.hypothesis: Kozi husika kwa kawaida inashughulikia masuala yote yaliyojadiliwa hapa kwa kina zaidi, na kwa kawaida huwa na sehemu za vitendo ambazo huwapa wanafunzi uzoefu wa moja kwa moja.

translations.source: A course will normally be from 2-5 days and will involve role play, a lot of first aid and sometimes weapons training.
translations.reference: Kwa kawaida kozi itachukua siku 2-5 na itahusisha uigizaji, huduma nyingi za kwanza na wakati mwingine mafunzo ya kutumia silaha.
translations.hypothesis: Kozi kawaida hudumu kutoka siku 2 hadi 5, na huwa inajumuisha mazoezi ya kuigiza, mafunzo mengi ya kwanza ya tiba, na wakati mwingine mafunzo ya matumizi ya silaha.

translations.source: Books and magazines dealing with wilderness survival are common, but publications dealing with war zones are few.
translations.reference: Vitabu na majarida yanayozungumzia maisha ya nyikani ni ya kawaida, lakini machapisho yanayohusiana na maeneo ya vita ni machache.
translations.hypothesis: Vitabu na majarida yanayoshughulikia mbinu za kuishi katika maeneo hatari ni vya kawaida, lakini machapisho yanayohusu maeneo ya vita ni machache.

translations.source: Voyagers planning sex reassignment surgery abroad must ensure they're carrying valid documents for the return trip.
translations.reference: Wasafiri wanaonuia kwenda ng'ambo kwa upasuaji wa kijinsia lazima wahakikishe kuwa wamebeba stakabadhi halali kwa sababu ya safari ya kurudi.
translations.hypothesis: Watu wanaopanga kufanya operesheni ya kubadilisha jinsia nje ya nchi lazima wawe na hati muhimu na halali ili kuwezesha safari yao ya kurudi nyumbani.

translations.source: The willingness of governments to issue passports with gender not stated (X) or documents updated to match a desired name and gender varies.
translations.reference: Utayari wa serikali kutoa pasipoti zisizotaja jinsia (X) au hati zilizosasishwa ili kulingana na jina na jinsia inayonuiwa unatofautiana.
translations.hypothesis: Uwezekano wa serikali kutoa pasipoti ambazo hazibainishi jinsia (ikiwa na alama "X") au hati ambazo zimebadilishwa ili kuendana na jina na jinsia inayotakikwa, hutofautiana.

translations.source: Willingness of foreign governments to honour these documents is just as widely variable.
translations.reference: Utayari wa serikali za kigeni kukubali nyaraka hizi unatofautiana vilevile.
translations.hypothesis: Utekelezaji wa makubaliano haya na serikali za kigeni pia hutofautiana sana.

translations.source: Searches at security checkpoints have also become far more intrusive in the post-September 11, 2001 era.
translations.reference: Utafutaji katika vituo vya ukaguzi wa kiusalama pia umekuwa wenye uingiliaji zaidi katika enzi za baada ya Septemba 11, 2001.
translations.hypothesis: Tangu tukio la Septemba 11, 2001, ukaguzi wa usalama katika vituo vya doria umeongezeka sana na umeendelea kuwa mkali zaidi.

translations.source: Pre-operative transgender people should not expect to pass through the scanners with their privacy and dignity intact.
translations.reference: Wasenge hawafai kutarajia kupitia kwenye kiwambo cha uchunguzi na watoke huko ikiwa utu na siri zao ziko kamilifu.
translations.hypothesis: Watu wanaotarajia kufanyiwa upasuaji wa kubadilisha jinsia hawapaswi kutarajia kuwa watapita kupitia vifaa vya uchunguzi bila kuathirika faragha na heshima yao.

translations.source: Rip currents are the returning flow from waves breaking off the beach, often at a reef or similar.
translations.reference: Mikondo ya mawimbi ya maji ni yale yanayorudi kutokwa kwa mawimbi yanayoachana ufukoni, aghalabu mwambani au mahali sawa.
translations.hypothesis: Majarorasi ni mkondo wa maji ambao hurudi baharini baada ya mawimbi kuvunjika karibu na pwani, mara nyingi karibu na mwamba au eneo lingine kama hilo.

translations.source: Due to the underwater topology the return flow is concentrated at a few deeper sections, and a fast current to deep water may form there.
translations.reference: Kwa sababu ya topolojia ya chini ya maji, yale yanayorudi huwa yamelimbikizia katika maeneo machache ya kina, na mawimbi ya kasi kwa maji ya kina yanaweza kuundika hapo.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa sababu ya muundo wa eneo hilo chini ya maji, maji yanayorudi hujaribuwa katika sehemu chache za kina, na mkondo wa haraka unaoelekea kwenye maji ya kina unaweza kuundwa katika maeneo hayo.

translations.source: Most deaths happen as result of fatigue trying to swim back against the current, which may be impossible.
translations.reference: Vifo vingi hutokea kutokana na machovu ya kujaribu kuogelea kinyume na mawimbi, hali ambayo huenda ikawa ngumu.
translations.hypothesis: Kifo cha watu wengi hutokea kutokana na uchovu wa kujaribu kuogelea dhidi ya mkondo wa maji, jambo ambalo huenda likawa jambo lisilowezekana.

translations.source: As soon as you get out of the current, swimming back is no more difficult than normally.
translations.reference: Mara tu utakapotoka kwenye mkondo, kuogelea kurudi si kugumu zaidi ya kawaida.
translations.hypothesis: Mara tu unapoondoka kwenye mkondo wa maji, kuogelea kurudi nyuma hakutakuwa na ugumu zaidi kuliko kawaida.

translations.source: Try aiming somewhere where you are not caught again or, depending on your skills and on whether you have been noticed, you might want to wait for rescue.
translations.reference: Jaribu kulenga mahali ambapo hutashikwa tena au, kulingana na ujuzi wako au kama umeonekana, huenda ukataka kungoja uokovu.
translations.hypothesis: Jaribu kuelekea mahali ambapo huenda usikamatwe tena, au, kulingana na ujuzi wako na iwapo umeshawahi kuonekana, unaweza kuamua kusubiri usaidizi.

translations.source: Re-entry shock comes on sooner than culture shock (there's less of a honeymoon phase), lasts longer, and can be more severe.
translations.reference: Mshtuko wa kurudi tena huja upesi kuliko mshtuko wa tamaduni (kuna kipindi chini ya fungate), hukaa kwa muda mrefu, na huweza kuwa kali zaidi.
translations.hypothesis: Mshtuko wa kurudi nyumbani hutokea mapema kuliko mshtuko wa kitamaduni (kipindi cha "furaha" huwa mfupi), hudumu kwa muda mrefu, na unaweza kuwa mkali zaidi.

translations.source: Travellers who had an easy time adjusting to the new culture sometimes have a particularly hard time readjusting to their native culture.
translations.reference: Wasafiri ambao walikuwa na wakati rahisi kuzoea utamaduni mpya wakati mwingine wana wakati mgumu wa kurekebisha upya utamaduni wao wa asili.
translations.hypothesis: Watu wanaotembelea maeneo mengine na ambao wamekuwa na urahisi wa kukabiliana na utamaduni mpya, wakati mwingine huona ugumu mkubwa wa kurudi na kukabiliana tena na utamaduni wao wa asili.

translations.source: When returning home after living abroad, you've adapted to the new culture and lost some of your habits from your home culture.
translations.reference: Wakati wa kurudi nyumbani baada ya kuishi ughaibuni, umezoea utamaduni mpya na kupoteza baadhi ya tabia zako kutoka kwa utamaduni wako wa nyumbani.
translations.hypothesis: Wakati wa kurudi nyumbani baada ya kuishi nje ya nchi, huenda umekuwa na tabia mpya kulingana na utamaduni mpya ambao ulikuwa nao, na huenda umepoteza baadhi ya tabia ambazo ulikuwa na kutoka katika utamaduni wako wa asili.

translations.source: When you went abroad at first, people were probably patient and understanding, knowing that travellers in a new country need to adapt.
translations.reference: Wakati ulienda ng’ambo kwa mara ya kwanza, watu walikuwa pengine na subira na kuelewa, wakijua wasafiri katika nchi ya kigeni, wanahitaji kuzoea.
translations.hypothesis: Wakati ulipokuenda nje ya nchi kwa mara ya kwanza, watu pengine walikuwa wakarimu na wenye uvumilivu, wakijua kwamba wasafiri katika nchi mpya wanahitaji kujifunza na kukabiliana na mazingira mapya.

translations.source: People may not anticipate that patience and understanding are also necessary for travellers returning home.
translations.reference: Huenda watu wasitarajie kwamba uvumilivu na ufahamu pia ni muhimu kwa wasafiri wanaorudi nyumbani.
translations.hypothesis: Watu wengi huenda wakisikia kwamba subira na uelewa pia ni muhimu kwa wasafiri wanaorudi nyumbani.

translations.source: The pyramid sound and light show is one of the most interesting things in the area for kids.
translations.reference: Sauti ya piramidi na onyesho la nuru ni mojawapo ya mambo yanayofurahisha zaidi katika eneo la watoto.
translations.hypothesis: Maonyesho ya sauti na mwanga yanayofanyika kwenye piramidi ni mojawapo ya vitu vya kuvutia zaidi katika eneo hilo kwa watoto.

translations.source: You can see the pyramids in the dark and you can see them in silence before the show begins.
translations.reference: Unaweza kuona piramidi gizani na unaweza kuziona katika utulivu kabla ya maonyesho kuanza.
translations.hypothesis: Unaweza kuona piramidi hizo hata katika giza, na unaweza kuziona kwa utulivu kabla ya tamasha kuanza.

translations.source: Usually you always here the sound of tourists and vendors. The story of the sound and light is just like a story book.
translations.reference: Kwa kawaida huwa unasikia sauti ya watalii na wauzaji. Hadithi ya sauti na mwanga ni kama kitabu cha hadithi.
translations.hypothesis: Kawaida, huwa unasikia sauti za watalii na wafanyabiashara. Hadithi ya sauti na taa ni kama hadithi iliyoandikwa kwenye kitabu.

translations.source: The Sphinx is set as the backdrop and the narrator of a long story.
translations.reference: Sphinx amewekwa kama usuli na msimulizi wa hadithi ndefu.
translations.hypothesis: Sanju ya Gizani imewekwa kama mandhari ya asili na kama kielelezo cha hadithi ndefu.

translations.source: The scenes are displayed on the pyramids and the different pyramids are lit up.
translations.reference: Matuko yanaonyeshwa kwenye piramidi na piramidi tofauti huangaza.
translations.hypothesis: Picha hizo zinaonyeshwa kwenye piramidi, na kila piramidi huangazwa kwa rangi tofauti.

translations.source: South Shetland Islands, discovered in 1819, are claimed by several nations and have the most bases, with sixteen active in 2020.
translations.reference: Visiwa vya kusini mwa Shetlandi, vilivyogunduliwa mnamo 1819, vinadaiwa kuwa milki ya mataifa kadhaa na vina misingi mingi, ikiwemo kumi na sita iliyo hai mnamo 2020.
translations.hypothesis: Visiwa vya Kusini mwa Shetland, viligunduliwa mwaka wa 1819, vinadaiwa na mataifa mengi na vina vituo vingi, ambapo vituo kumi na sita vilikuwa vinatumika mwaka wa 2020.

translations.source: The archipelago lies 120 km north of the Peninsula. The largest is King George Island with the settlement of Villa Las Estrellas.
translations.reference: Visiwa vimo kilomita 120 kaskazini mwa Rasi. Kubwa zaidi ni Kisiwa cha King George kilicho na makazi ya Villa Las Estrellas.
translations.hypothesis: Visiwa hivyo viko umbali wa kilomita 120 kaskazini mwa peninsula. Kisiwa kikubwa zaidi ni Kisiwa cha King George, ambako kuna makazi ya Villa Las Estrellas.

translations.source: Others include Livingston Island, and Deception where the flooded caldera of a still-active volcano provides a spectacular natural harbour.
translations.reference: Vingine ni pamoja na Kisiwa cha Livingston, na Udanganyifu, ambapo kaldera iliyofurika ya volkano hai hutoa bandari asili ya kipekee.
translations.hypothesis: Vile vile, visiwa vingine ni Visiwa vya Livingston na Visiwa vya Deception, ambapo bonde kubwa lililojaa maji la volkano bado linaloendelea kulitoa moshi, linatoa bandari nzuri sana ya asili.

translations.source: Ellsworth Land is the region south of the Peninsula, bounded by the Bellingshausen Sea.
translations.reference: Ellsworth Land ni mkoa kusini mwa Peninsula, unaopakana na Bahari la Bellingshausen.
translations.hypothesis: Eneo la Ellsworth ni eneo lililo kusini mwa Rasi, na limepakana na Bahari ya Bellingshausen.

translations.source: The mountains of the Peninsula here merge into the plateau, then re-emerge to form the 360 km chain of the Ellsworth Mountains, bisected by the Minnesota Glacier.
translations.reference: Milima ya Peninsula hapa inajiunga na huu uwanda, kisha ikaibuka tena kuunda safu ya kilomita 360 ya Milima ya Ellsworth, na kugawanywa na Tungamo za barafu za Minnesota.
translations.hypothesis: Milima ya peninsula hii huungana na eneo la juu (plateau), kisha huonekana tena ili kuunda mnyororo mrefu wa milima wa Ellsworth, unaopimwa kilomita 360, na umegawanywa na glasiari ya Minnesota.

translations.source: The northern part or Sentinel Range has Antarctica's highest mountains, the Vinson Massif, peaking at 4892 m Mount Vinson.
translations.reference: Sehemu ya kaskazini au msafa wa Sentinel una milima mirefu zaidi ya Antaktika kama vile Vinson Massif, iliyofikia urefu wa 4892 na Mlima Vinson.
translations.hypothesis: Sehemu ya kaskazini, au Mlima Sentinel, ina milima mirefu zaidi ya Antaktika, ambayo ni Mlima Vinson, wenye kilele ambacho kina urefu wa metri 4892.

translations.source: In remote locations, without cell phone coverage, a satellite phone may be your only option.
translations.reference: Katika sehemu za mbali, bila signali za simu za mkononi, simu ya setilaiti huenda ikawa chaguo lako la pekee.
translations.hypothesis: Katika maeneo mbali ambapo hakuna mawasiliano ya simu za mkononi, simu ya satelaiti inaweza kuwa suluhisho pekee linalopatikana.

translations.source: A satellite phone is not generally a replacement for a mobile phone, as you have to be outdoors with clear line of sight to the satellite to make a phone call.
translations.reference: Simu ya satelaiti sio kwa ujumla mbadala wa simu ya rununu, kwani lazima uwe nje wazi na kuona laini za satelaiti ili kupiga simu.
translations.hypothesis: Simu ya satelaiti kwa kawaida si badala ya simu ya mkononi, kwa sababu ili kupiga simu, lazima uwe nje na kuwa na mstari wa moja kwa moja usiozuiliwa wa kuona satelaiti.

translations.source: The service is frequently used by shipping, including pleasure craft, as well as expeditions who have remote data and voice needs.
translations.reference: Huduma hutumika mara kwa mara na usafirishaji, vikiwemo vyombo vya anasa, vilevile safari zilizo na mahitaji ya data na sauti ya mbali.
translations.hypothesis: Huduma hii hutumika mara kwa mara na kampuni za usafirishaji, ikiwa ni pamoja na boti za starehe, pamoja na makundi ya utafiti ambayo yanahitaji mawasiliano ya data na sauti katika maeneo mbali.

translations.source: Your local telephone service provider should be able to give more information about connecting to this service.
translations.reference: Mtoaji wako wa huduma za simu anastahili aweze kutoa habari zaidi kuhusu kuunganishwa na huduma hii.
translations.hypothesis: Mtoa huduma wa simu za mkononi katika eneo lako angeweza kutoa maelezo zaidi kuhusu jinsi ya kuunganishwa na huduma hii.

translations.source: An increasingly more popular option for those planning a gap-year is to travel and learn.
translations.reference: Uchaguzi unaozidi kuwa maarufu kwa wale wanaopanga pengo la mwaka mmoja ni kusafiri na kujifunza.
translations.hypothesis: Moja ya chaguo zinazopata umaarufu zaidi kwa wale wanaopanga mwaka wa mapumziko ni kusafiri na kujifunza.

translations.source: This is especially popular with school leavers, allowing them to take a year out before university, without compromising their education.
translations.reference: Hii haswa ni maarufu kwa waliohitimu shuleni, ikiwaruhusu kukaa nje kwa mwaka mmoja kabla ya kuingia chuo kikuu, bila kuathiri masomo yao.
translations.hypothesis: Hii ni programu ambayo ni maarufu sana kwa wanafunzi ambao wamehitimu shule, na inawapa fursa ya kuchukua mwaka mmoja kabla ya kujiunga na chuo kikuu, bila kuathiri elimu yao.

translations.source: In many cases, enrolling on a gap-year course abroad can actually improve your chances of moving into higher education back in your home country.
translations.reference: Katika hali nyingi, kujisajilisha kwa kozi mwaka-pengo ughaibuni kwa hakika kunaweza kuboresha nafasi zako za kuendeleza elimu ya juu katika nchi yako.
translations.hypothesis: Katika kesi nyingi, kujiunga na kozi ya mwaka mmoja nje ya nchi inaweza kuongeza nafasi zako za kuendelea na masomo ya juu katika nchi yako.

translations.source: Typically there will be a tuition fee to enroll in these educational programs.
translations.reference: Kwa kawaida kutakuwa na ada ya mafunzo ili kujisajili katika mipango hii ya kielimu.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa kawaida, kuna ada ya masomo ambayo inalipwa ili kujiunga na programu hizi za elimu.

translations.source: Finland is a great boating destination. The "Land of a thousand lakes" has thousands of islands too, in the lakes and in the coastal archipelagos.
translations.reference: Ufini ni mahali pazuri pa uendeshaji mashua. “Nchi ya maziwa elfu” ina maelfu ya visiwa pia, katika maziwa na katika visiwa vya pwani.
translations.hypothesis: Finlandi ni mahali pazuri sana pa kufurahia safari za maji. "Nchi ya Mito Elfu" ina maelfu ya visiwa, yaliyoko ndani ya maziwa na pia katika visiwa vya pwani.

translations.source: In the archipelagos and lakes you do not necessarily need a yacht.
translations.reference: Kwa funguvisiwa na visiwa sio lazima uhitaji meli.
translations.hypothesis: Katika visiwa na maziwa, si lazima uwe na boti kubwa (ya ghali).

translations.source: Although the coastal archipelagos and the biggest lakes are indeed big enough for any yacht, smaller boats or even a kayak offer a different experience.
translations.reference: Ingawa visiwa vya pwani na maziwa makubwa zaidi kwa kweli ni makubwa kutosha kwa mashua yoyote, boti ndogo ama hata kayaki hutoa uzoefu tofauti.
translations.hypothesis: Ingawa visiwa vya pwani na maziwa makubwa ni ya kutosha kwa meli yoyote ya kifahari, boti ndogo au hata boti ndogo za maji (kayak) huleta uzoefu tofauti.

translations.source: Boating is a national pastime in Finland, with a boat to every seven or eight people.
translations.reference: Kuendesha mashua ni mchezo wa kimataifa nchini Finland, na mashua kwa kila watu saba au nane.
translations.hypothesis: Nchini Finland, urudini ni shughuli maarufu sana, na kuna boti moja kwa kila watu saba au nane.

translations.source: This is matched by Norway, Sweden and New Zealand, but otherwise quite unique (e.g. in the Netherlands the figure is one to forty).
translations.reference: Hii inaendana na Norway, Sweden na Nyuzilandi, lakini vinginevyo ni tofauti kabisa (kwa mfano katika Uholanzi takwimu ni moja kwa arobaini).
translations.hypothesis: Hii ni hali ambayo pia inaonekana nchini Norway, Sweden, na New Zealand, lakini kwa sehemu nyingine, ni jambo la kipekee (kwa mfano, nchini Uholanzi, uwiano ni moja kwa thelathini).

translations.source: Most of the distinct Baltic Cruises feature an extended stay in St. Petersburg, Russia.
translations.reference: Nyingi ya safari za Baltic huwa na kukaa kwa muda mrefu katika St. Petersburg, Urusi.
translations.hypothesis: Safari nyingi za baharini za eneo la Baltic zina kipindi kirefu cha ziara katika mji wa St. Petersburg, nchini Urusi.

translations.source: This means you can visit the historic city for a couple of full days while returning and sleeping on the ship at night.
translations.reference: Hii ina maana kuwa unaweza kulitembelea jiji la kihistoria kwa kutwa kadhaa huku ukirudi na kulala kwenye meli wakati wa usiku.
translations.hypothesis: Hii inamaanisha kwamba unaweza kutembelea jiji hilo lenye historia kwa siku kadhaa kamili, huku ukirudi kwenye meli usiku na kulala humo.

translations.source: If you only go ashore using shipboard excursions you will not need a separate visa (as of 2009).
translations.reference: Ikiwa huwa unaenda ufukweni tu ukitumia safari za meli hutahitaji visa tofauti (kufikia mwaka wa 2009).
translations.hypothesis: Ikiwa utatembea tu kwenye ardhi kwa kutumia safari za ziara ambazo zinafanywa kutoka kwenye meli, basi hautahitaji visa tofauti (kama ilivyo kwa mwaka wa 2009).

translations.source: Some cruises feature Berlin, Germany in the brochures. As you can see from the map above Berlin is no where near the sea and a visit to the city is not included in the price of the cruise.
translations.reference: Baadhi ya safari za baharini huonyesha Berlin na Ujerumani katika brosha zao. Kama unavyoona katika ramani iliyo hapo juu, Berlin haipo popote karibu na bahari na safari ya jiji hili haijumuishwi katika bei ya safari za baharini.
translations.hypothesis: Baadhi ya matangazo ya safari za baharini yanaonyesha jiji la Berlin, nchini Ujerumani. Kama ambavyo unaweza kuona kwenye ramani iliyo hapo juu, Berlin iko mbali sana na bahari, na hivyo basi, ziara ya jiji hilo haijajumuishwa katika bei ya safari ya baharini.

translations.source: Travelling by plane can be a scary experience for people of all ages and backgrounds, particularly if they've not flown before or have experienced a traumatic event.
translations.reference: Kusafiri kwa ndege kunaweza kuwa uzoefu wa kuogofya kwa watu wa umri na malezi yote, hasa kama hawajasafiri kwa ndege tena au walipatwa na tukio la kufadhaisha.
translations.hypothesis: Kusafiri kwa ndege kunaweza kuwa jambo la kutisha kwa watu wa rika na asili zote, hasa ikiwa hawajawahi kusafiri kwa ndege au wamepitia tukio la kusumbua.

translations.source: It is not something to be ashamed of: it is no different from the personal fears and dislikes of other things that very many people have.
translations.reference: Si jambo la kuaibikia: si tofauti sana na hofu ya kibinafsi na isiyopenda vitu vingine ambayo watu wengi wako nayo.
translations.hypothesis: Si jambo la kujitosa: si tofauti na hofu na mambo ambayo watu wengi huogopa au kuyapenda.

translations.source: For some, understanding something about how aircraft work and what happens during a flight may help to overcome a fear which is based on the unknown or on not being in control.
translations.reference: Kwa wengine, kuelewa jinsi ndege inavyofanya kazi na kinachotokea wakati wa ndege kuruka inaweza kusaidia kushinda hofu ambayo msingi wake ni mambo yasiyojulikana ama kutokuwa kwenye udhibiti.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa wengine, kujifunza kuhusu jinsi ndege zinavyofanya kazi na kile kinachotokea wakati wa safari ya ndege kunaweza kusaidia kuondoa hofu inayotokana na ukosefu wa ufahamu au hisia ya kutokuwa na udhibiti.

translations.source: Courier companies are well paid for delivering things quickly. Frequently, time is very important with business documents, merchandise or spare parts for an urgent repair.
translations.reference: Kampuni za uchukuzi hulipwa vizuri kwa kufikisha vitu haraka. Mara kwa mara, muda ni muhimu sana kwa hati za kibiashara, bidhaa, au vipuli kwa ukarabati wa haraka.
translations.hypothesis: Kampuni za utumaji haraka zinapata malipo mazuri kwa kuwasilisha vitu kwa haraka. Mara nyingi, wakati huwa muhimu sana, hasa kwa nyaraka za biashara, bidhaa au sehemu za ziada zinazohitajika kwa ukarabati wa dharura.

translations.source: On some routes, the larger companies have their own planes, but for other routes and smaller firms there was a problem.
translations.reference: Katika baadhi ya njia, kampuni kubwa zina ndege zao wenyewe, lakini kwa njia nyingine na kampuni ndogo kulikuwa na shida.
translations.hypothesis: Katika baadhi ya njia za usafiri, kampuni kubwa zina ndege zao wenyewe, lakini kwa njia nyingine na kwa kampuni ndogo, kulikuwa na tatizo.

translations.source: If they sent things by air freight, on some routes it may have taken days to get through unloading and customs.
translations.reference: Kama wangetuma vitu kwa mizigo ya ndege, katika baadhi ya njia huenda ingechukua siku kadhaa kukamilisha upakuaji na forodha.
translations.hypothesis: Ikiwa walikuwa wanasafirisha bidhaa kwa ndege, katika baadhi ya njia, huenda ilichukua siku kadhaa kumaliza mchakato wa kupakua na ukaguzi wa forodha.

translations.source: The only way to get it through faster was to send it as checked luggage. Airline regulations will not allow them to send luggage without a passenger, which is where you come in.
translations.reference: Njia pekee ya kuipitisha kwa haraka ilikuwa kuituma kama mzigo uliokaguliwa. Kanuni za kampuni za ndege hazitazikubalia kutuma mzigo bila abiria, ambapo ndipo unaingilia.
translations.hypothesis: Njia pekee ya kusafirisha bidhaa hiyo haraka zaidi ilikuwa kuipakia kama mizigo iliyoidhinishwa. Kanuni za mashirika ya ndege haziruhusu kusafirisha mizigo bila abiria, na ndipo wewe unahitajika.

translations.source: The obvious way of flying in first or business class is to fork out a thick wad of money for the privilege (or, better yet, get your company to do it for you).
translations.reference: Njia dhahiri ya kusafiri katika daraja la kwanza au kibiashara ni kutoa pesa nyingi kwa fursa hiyo (au, bora zaidi, kufanya kampuni yako ikulipie).
translations.hypothesis: Njia iliyo wazi ya kusafiri kwa daraja la kwanza au la biashara ni kulipa kiasi kikubwa cha pesa ili kupata huduma hizo (au, bora zaidi, waombee kampuni yako ili wafanye hivyo kwa ajili yako).

translations.source: However, this does not come cheap: as rough rules of thumb, you can expect to pay up to four times the normal economy fare for business, and eleven times for first class!
translations.reference: Walakini, hii haikuji kwa bei rahisi: kwa sababu ya sheria mbaya zisizobainika, unaweza kutarajia kulipa hadi mara nne ya kawaida ya uchumi, nauli ya biashara, na mara 11 kwa cheo cha kwanza!
translations.hypothesis: Hata hivyo, bei hii si rahisi: kwa kawaida, unaweza kulazimika kulipa hadi mara nne bei ya kawaida ya tiketi ya kawaida kwa daraja la kibiashara, na hadi mara kumi na moja kwa daraja la kwanza!

translations.source: Generally speaking, there is no point in even looking for discounts for business or first-class seats on direct flights from A to B.
translations.reference: Kuongea kwa jumla, hakuna haja ya hata kutafuta vipunguzo kwa biashara au viti vya daraja la kwanza katika safari za ndege za moja kwa moja toka A hadi B.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa ujumla, hakuna maana ya hata kutafuta punguzo kwa ajili ya viti vya daraja la kwanza au vya biashara kwenye ndege zinazotoa safari moja kwa moja kutoka mahali fulani (A) hadi mahali pengine (B).

translations.source: Airlines know well that there is a certain core group of flyers who are willing to pay top dollar for the privilege of getting somewhere fast and in comfort, and charge accordingly.
translations.reference: Kampuni za ndege zinajua vizuri kwamba kuna kundi fulani la ndani la wasafiri ambao wako tayari kulipa pesa nyingi kwa haki ya kufika mahali kwa haraka na kwa starehe, na wanabadilisha ipasavyo.
translations.hypothesis: Makampuni ya ndege yanakubali vizuri kwamba kuna kundi fulani la wasafiri ambao wako tayari kulipa bei ya juu ili kupata huduma ya kusafiri kwa haraka na kwa starehe, na kwa hivyo wanatoza ada inayofaa.

translations.source: The capital of Moldova is Chişinău. The local language is Romanian, but Russian is widely used.
translations.reference: Mji mkuu wa Moldova ni Chisinau. Lugha ya ndani ni Kiroma, lakini Kirusi inatumika sana.
translations.hypothesis: Mji mkuu wa Moldova ni Chișinău. Lugha rasmi ya eneo hilo ni Kirumani, lakini Kirusi pia hutumika kwa ukubwa.

translations.source: Moldova is a multi-ethnic republic that has suffered from ethnic conflict.
translations.reference: Moldova ni taifa lenye makabila mngi ambayo yameteseka kutokana na migogoro ya kikabila.
translations.hypothesis: Moldova ni jamhuri yenye makabila mengi tofauti ambayo imekuwa ikikabiliwa na migogoro ya kikabila.

translations.source: In 1994, this conflict led to the creation of the self-proclaimed Transnistria Republic in eastern Moldova, which has its own government and currency but is not recognised by any UN member country.
translations.reference: Mnamo 1994, migogoro hii ilipelekea kuundwa na kujitangaza kwa Taifa la Transnistria mashariki mwa Moldova, ambalo lina serikali na sarafu yake, lakini halitambuliwa na taifa lolote wanachama wa Umoja wa Mataifa.
translations.hypothesis: Mnamo mwaka wa 1994, mzozo huo ulisababisha kuundwa kwa Jamhuri ya Transnistria, ambayo ilijitangaza kuwa nchi huru katika sehemu ya mashariki ya Moldova. Jamhuri hiyo ina serikali na fedha yake mwenyewe, lakini haitambuliwi na nchi yoyote mwanachama wa Umoja wa Mataifa.

translations.source: Economic links have been re-established between these two parts of Moldova despite the failure in political negotiations.
translations.reference: Viungo vya kiuchumi vimeanzishwa tena kati ya sehemu hizi mbili za Moldova licha ya kutofaulu kwa majadiliano ya kisiasa.
translations.hypothesis: Uhusiano wa kiuchumi umeanzishwa upya kati ya sehemu hizo mbili za Moldova, licha ya kushindwa katika mazungumzo ya kisiasa.

translations.source: The major religion in Moldova is Orthodox Christian.
translations.reference: Dini kuu katika Moldova ni Ukristo wa Kiorthodoksi.
translations.hypothesis: Dini kuu nchini Moldova ni Ukristo wa Kikristo wa Orthodox.

translations.source: İzmir is the third largest city in Turkey with a population of around 3.7 million, the second biggest port after Istanbul, and a very good transport hub.
translations.reference: Izmir ni mji wa tatu kwa ukubwa nchini Uturuki na idadi ya watu ya takribani milioni 3.7, bandari ya pili kwa ukubwa baada ya Istanbul, na kitovu kizuri sana cha uchukuzi.
translations.hypothesis: Izmir ndio mji wa tatu kwa ukubwa nchini Uturuki, wenye idadi ya watu takriban milioni 3.7, na ndio bandari ya pili kubwa baada ya Istanbul, pamoja na kuwa kitovu muhimu cha usafiri.

translations.source: Once the ancient city of Smyrna, it is now a modern, developed, and busy commercial center, set around a huge bay and surrounded by mountains.
translations.reference: Uliokuwa mji wa kale wa Smyma, sasa ni wa kisasa, ulioendelea, na wa kibiashara wenye shughuli nyingi, ulioewekwa kuzunguka kituo kikubwa na umezungukwa na milima.
translations.hypothesis: Mji huo, ambao zamani ulijulikana kama Smyrna, sasa ni kituo cha kisasa, chenye maendeleo, na chenye shughuli nyingi za kibiashara, kilichopo karibu na kisiwa kikubwa na kilicholizunguka na milima.

translations.source: The broad boulevards, glass-fronted buildings and modern shopping centers are dotted with traditional red-tiled roofs, the 18th century market, and old mosques and churches, although the city has an atmosphere more of Mediterranean Europe than traditional Turkey.
translations.reference: Njia pana, majengo yenye vioo sehemu za mbele na vituo vya kisasa vya kibiashara vimejaa paa za vigae vyekundu vya jadi, soko la karne ya 18, misikiti na makanisa ya zamani, ingawa jiji lenyewe lina anga ya Uropa kuliko Uturuki ya jadi.
translations.hypothesis: Barabara pana, majengo yenye madirisha makubwa, na vituo vya ununuzi vya kisasa, yote yamechanganywa na paa za rangi nyekundu za jadi, soko la karne ya 18, na misikiti na makanisa ya kale. Ingawa jiji hilo lina hali ambayo inafanana zaidi na Ulaya ya Mediterania kuliko Uturuki ya jadi.

translations.source: The village of Haldarsvík offer views of the nearby island Eysturoy and has an unusual octagonal church.
translations.reference: Kijiji cha Haldarsvik kina mtazamo wa kisiwa kilicho karibu cha Eysturoi na kina kanisa lenye umbo lisilo la kawaida la pembe nane.
translations.hypothesis: Kijiji cha Haldarsvík kinatoa mandhari nzuri ya kisiwa cha Eysturoy kilicho karibu, na pia kina kanisa lenye umbo la mraba la pembe nane, ambalo ni jambo la kipekee.

translations.source: In the churchyard, there are interesting marble sculptures of doves over some tombs.
translations.reference: Katika uwanja wa kanisa, kuna vinyago vya kuvutia vya marumaru vya njiwa juu ya kaburi.
translations.hypothesis: Katika eneo la kanisa, kuna sanamu nzuri za kauri ambazo zina umbo la ndege aina ya "dove" zilizowekwa juu ya makaburi fulani.

translations.source: It's worth half an hour to stroll about the intriguing village.
translations.reference: Inafaa nusu saa kutembeatembea katika kijiji hicho ambacho kinavutia.
translations.hypothesis: Inaweza kuwa na thamani ya dakika nusu tu kutembea na kuchunguza kijiji hicho cha kuvutia.

translations.source: To the north and within easy reach is the romantic and fascinating town of Sintra and which was made famous to foreigners after a glowing account of its splendours recorded by Lord Byron.
translations.reference: Upande wa kaskazini na mahali rahisi kufika kuna mji wa mahaba na wa kuvutia, uliofanywa maarufu na wageni baada ya kusimulia mapambo yake ya kung'aa kama yalivyorekodiwa na Lord Byron.
translations.hypothesis: Kaskazini, na iko karibu sana, kuna mji wa Sintra, ambao ni wa kupendeza na wa kuvutia, na ambao ulipata umaarufu mkubwa kwa watu kutoka nje baada ya Lord Byron kuandika maelezo mazuri kuhusu uzuri wake.

translations.source: Scotturb Bus 403 travels regularly to Sintra, stopping at Cabo da Roca.
translations.reference: Basi la Skotabu 403 husafiri mara kwa mara hadi Sintra, na kusimama Kabo da Roka.
translations.hypothesis: Basi ya Scotturb namba 403 husafiri mara kwa mara hadi Sintra, na inaacha abiria katika eneo la Cabo da Roca.

translations.source: Also to the north visit the great Sanctuary of Our Lady of Fatima (Shrine), a place of worldwide famous Marian apparitions.
translations.reference: Pia upande wa kaskazini tembelea Hekalu la Mama Yetu Fatima (Madhabahu), mahali maarufu duniani pa maonyesho ya Maria.
translations.hypothesis: Pia, kaskazini, tembelea Hekalu kuu la Bikira Maria wa Fatima, eneo ambalo linajulikana duniani kote kwa maonekane ya Bikira Maria.

translations.source: Please remember that you are essentially visiting a mass grave site, as well as a site that has an almost incalculable meaning to a significant portion of the world's population.
translations.reference: Tafadhali kumbuka kuwa hasa unatembelea mahali penye kaburi la watu wengi, na pia mahali ambapo pana maana isiyoweza kutabiriwa kwa sehemu kubwa ya idadi ya watu ulimwenguni.
translations.hypothesis: Tafadhali kumbuka kwamba msingi huu ni eneo la makaburi makubwa, na pia ni mahali ambapo ina maana kubwa sana kwa idadi kubwa ya watu ulimwenguni.

translations.source: There are still many men and women alive who survived their time here, and many more who had loved ones who were murdered or worked to death there, Jews and non-Jews alike.
translations.reference: Kungali kuna wanaume na wanawake wengi walio hai walioishi muda wao hapa, na wengine wengi ambao wapendwa wao waliuawa au walifanyishwa kazi hadi kufa, Wayahudi na wasio Wayahudi vilevile.
translations.hypothesis: Bado kuna watu wengi, wanaume na wanawake, ambao wameishi na kushuhudia kipindi hicho, na pia kuna wengine wengi ambao walipenda watu ambao waliuawa au walifanywa kazi hadi kufa huko, iwe ni Wayahudi au watu wengine.

translations.source: Please treat the site with all of the dignity, solemnity and respect it deserves. Do not make jokes about the Holocaust or Nazis.
