translations.reference: Tafadhali tendea mahali hapo kwa hadhi yote, utaratibu na heshima inayostahiki. Usifanye utani juu ya Maangamizo au Wanazi.
translations.hypothesis: Tafadhali, shiriki katika eneo hili kwa heshima, umakini na utunzaji unaostahili. Usifanye utani au maneno yasiyofaa kuhusu Holocaust au Wajerumani wa Nazi.

translations.source: Do not deface the site by marking or scratching graffiti into structures.
translations.reference: Usiumbue tovuti kwa kuashiria au kukata michoro kwenye miundo.
translations.hypothesis: Usiharibu eneo hilo kwa kuandika au kuchonga maandishi yasiyofaa kwenye majengo.

translations.source: Barcelona's official languages are Catalan and Spanish. About a half prefer to speak Catalan, a vast majority understands it, and virtually everyone knows Spanish.
translations.reference: Lugha rasmi za Baselona Kikatalani na Kihispania. Takribani nusu yao wanapendelea kuongea Kikatalani, idadi kubwa wanaielewa, na karibu kila mtu anajua Kihispania.
translations.hypothesis: Lugha rasmi za Barcelona ni Kikatali na Kihispania. Takriban nusu ya watu wanapendelea kuzungumza Kikatali, idadi kubwa sana wanaelewa lugha hiyo, na karibu kila mtu anajua Kihispania.

translations.source: However, most signs are indicated only in Catalan because it is established by law as the first official language.
translations.reference: Hata hivyo, ishara nyingi huonyeshwa kwa Kikatalani kwa sababu imewekwa kisheria kama lugha rasmi ya kwanza.
translations.hypothesis: Hata hivyo, ishara nyingi huonyeshwa tu kwa lugha ya Kikatalani kwa sababu, kisheria, lugha hiyo imetambuliwa kama lugha rasmi ya kwanza.

translations.source: Yet, Spanish is also widely used in public transport and other facilities.
translations.reference: Kihispania bado hutumika sana katika uchukuzi wa umma na maeneo mengine.
translations.hypothesis: Hata hivyo, lugha ya Kihispania pia hutumika sana katika usafiri wa umma na katika huduma nyinginezo.

translations.source: Regular announcements in the Metro are made only in Catalan, but unplanned disruptions are announced by an automated system in a wide variety of languages including Spanish, English, French, Arabic and Japanese.
translations.reference: Matangazo ya mara kwa mara katika Metro hufanywa tu kwa Kitalani, lakini usumbufu usiopangwa hutangazwa kwa mifumo otomatiki kwa kutumia lugha mbalimbali zikiwemo Kihispania, Kiingereza, Kifaransa, Kiarabu na Kijapanisi.
translations.hypothesis: Matangazo ya kawaida katika mfumo wa usafiri wa Metro hutolewa kwa lugha ya Kikatalani pekee, lakini taarifa kuhusu matatizo yasiyotarajiwa hutolewa na mfumo wa kiotomatiki kwa lugha mbalimbali, ikiwa ni pamoja na Kihispania, Kiingereza, Kifaransa, Kiarabu na Kijapani.

translations.source: Parisians have a reputation for being egocentric, rude and arrogant.
translations.reference: Waparisi wana sifa ya kujipenda, jeuri na wenye kiburi.
translations.hypothesis: Wakaazi wa Paris wana sifa ya kuwa watu wanaojiona kuwa wakuu, wasiyeweza kuheshimu wengine, na wenye kiburi.

translations.source: While this is often only an inaccurate stereotype, the best way to get along in Paris still is to be on your best behavior, acting like someone who is "bien élevé" (well brought up). It will make getting about considerably easier.
translations.reference: Wakati hii mara nyingi ni aina ya dhana tu isiyofaa, njia nzuri ya kupatana kule Paris bado ni kuwa katika tabia yako njema, kufanya kama mtu ambaye ni “bien e’lev’e” (amelelewa vizuri). Itafanya kupatana rahisi mno.
translations.hypothesis: Ingawa mara nyingi hii ni tu dhana potofu, njia bora zaidi ya kuishi vizuri jijini Paris bado ni kuwa na tabia nzuri, na kuonyesha tabia ya mtu "aliyetunzwa vizuri" (aliyetolewa malezi mazuri). Hii itarahisisha sana mambo mengi.

translations.source: Parisians' abrupt exteriors will rapidly evaporate if you display some basic courtesies.
translations.reference: Umbo za nje za ghafla za Parisiani zitayeyuka haraka ikiwa unaonyesha ustahifu kadhaa za kimsingi.
translations.hypothesis: Tabia kali za watu wa Paris huweza kubadilika haraka ikiwa utaonyesha heshima na adabu ya msingi.

translations.source: The Plitvice Lakes national park is heavily forested, mainly with beech, spruce, and fir trees, and features a mixture of Alpine and Mediterranean vegetation.
translations.reference: Mbuga ya Kitaifa ya Plitvice Lakes ina misitu sana, hususan mifune, misonobari, na miti ya misonobari, na mchanganyiko wa uoto wa safu ya milima ya Alp na mediterania.
translations.hypothesis: Hifadhi ya Taifa ya Ziwa za Plitvice ina misitu mingi, hasa ya miti ya beech, spruce, na fir, na ina aina mbalimbali za mimea inayopatikana katika maeneo ya milima ya Alpine na Mediterranean.

translations.source: It has a notably wide variety of plant communities, due to its range of microclimates, differing soils and varying levels of altitude.
translations.reference: Ina aina anuwai za jamii za mimea, kutokana na masafa yake ya hali ndogondogo za anga, mchanga tofauti na kutofautiana kwa viwango vya urefu.
translations.hypothesis: Eneo hilo lina aina mbalimbali sana za makundi ya mimea, kutokana na tofauti za hali ya hewa, aina tofauti za udongo, na viwango tofauti vya urefu.

translations.source: The area is also home to an extremely wide variety of animal and bird species.
translations.reference: Eneo hilo pia ni nyumbani mwa aina nyingi sana mbalimbali za spishi za wanyama na ndege.
translations.hypothesis: Eneo hilo pia ni makazi ya aina mbalimbali sana za wanyama na ndege.

translations.source: Rare fauna such as the European brown bear, wolf, eagle, owl, lynx, wild cat and capercaillie can be found there, along with many more common species
translations.reference: Wanyama nadra kama vile Dubu wa hudhurungi wa Ulaya, mbwa mwitu, tai, bundi, simba-mangu, paka mwitu na kware wa Ulaya wanaweza kupatikana huko, pamoja na spishi nyingine nyingi za kawaida.
translations.hypothesis: Wanyamapori adimu kama vile dubu wa kahawia wa Ulaya, mbwa mwitu, tai, pundu, nyoka wa aina ya lynx, paka mwitu na ndege wa aina ya capercaillie wanaweza kupatikana huko, pamoja na spishi nyingine nyingi za kawaida.

translations.source: While visiting the monasteries, women are required to wear skirts covering the knees and have their shoulders covered, too.
translations.reference: Wakati wa kutembelea nyumba za watawa, wanawake wanatarajiwa kuvaa sketi zinazofunika magoti na pia wafunike mabega yao.
translations.hypothesis: Wakati wa kutembelea monasteri, wanawake wanatakiwa kuvaa sketi ambazo zinafunika goti na pia kuvaa nguo ambazo zinafunika bega.

translations.source: Most of the monasteries do provide wraps for women who come unprepared, but if you bring your own, especially one with bright colors, you'll get a smile from the monk or nun at the entrance.
translations.reference: Nyingi za monasteri hutoa kanga kwa wanawake wanaokuja bila, lakini ukija na kanga yako, haswa iliyo na rangi kali, utapata tabasamu kutoka kwa monaki au sista kwenye kiingilio.
translations.hypothesis: Monastari nyingi huandaa vitambaa vya kufunika kwa wanawake ambao huja bila vitambaa hivyo, lakini ikiwa utaleta wako mwenyewe, hasa kile ambacho kina rangi angavu, utapata tabasamu kutoka kwa mmonaki au mmonaki mwanamke aliye mlango.

translations.source: Along the same line, men are required to wear trousers covering the knees.
translations.reference: Vile vile, wanaume wanahitajika kuvaa suruali zinazofunika magoti.
translations.hypothesis: Kama vile hivyo, wanaume wanatakiwa kuvaa suruali ambazo zinafunika goti.

translations.source: This too can be borrowed from the stock at the entrance but that clothing isn't washed after every user so you may not feel comfortable wearing these skirts. One size fits all for men!
translations.reference: Hii pia inaweza kuombwa kutoka kwa akiba kwenye lango lakini nguo hizo hazifuliwi baada ya kila mtumiaji kwa hivyo huenda usijihisi mwenye starehe unapovaa sketi hizo. Saizi moja hutosha wote kwa wanaume!
translations.hypothesis: Vazi hilo pia linaweza kukodishwa kutoka kwa vitu vilivyopo kwenye eneo la kuingilia, lakini nguo hizo hazioshi baada ya kila mtu kuzitumia, kwa hivyo huenda usihisi raha kuvalia viwani hivyo. Kwa wanaume, kuna ukubwa mmoja unaofaa kwa wote!

translations.source: Majorcan cuisine, like that of similar zones in the Mediterranean, is based on bread, vegetables and meat (specially pork), and uses olive oil throughout.
translations.reference: Vyakula vya Majokan, kama vile vya sehemu nyingine kwenye kanda ya bahari ya Mediterranean, vimetengenezwa kwa mkate, mboga na nyama (hasa ya nguruwe), na hutumia mafuta ya mizeituni nyakati zote.
translations.hypothesis: Jikoni ya Mallorca, kama vile ya maeneo mengine yanayofanana katika eneo la Mediterania, inategemea sana mkate, mboga na nyama (hasa nyama ya nguruwe), na hutumia mafuta ya mboga katika kila kitu.

translations.source: A simple popular dinner, especially during the summer, is the Pa amb Oli: Bread with olive oil, tomato, and any available condiments such as cheese, tunafish, etc.
translations.reference: Chakula rahisi cha jioni, hasa wakati wa kiangazi, huwa ni Pa ambi Oli: Mkate wa mafuta ya mizeituni, nyanya, na viungo vingine vinavyopatikana kama vile jibini na samakituna.
translations.hypothesis: Chakula cha jioni rahisi na maarufu, hasa wakati wa majira ya joto, ni "Pa amb Oli": mkate uliotawanyika na mafuta ya mboga, pamoja na nyanya na viungo vingine vinavyopatikana, kama vile jibini, samaki wa tunafish, na kadhalika.

translations.source: All nouns, alongside the word Sie for you, always begin with a capital letter, even in the middle of a sentence.
translations.reference: Nomino zote, ikiwemo Sie kwa wewe, daima huanza kwa herufi kubwa, hata katika katikati mwa sentensi.
translations.hypothesis: Kila neno, pamoja na neno "Sie" (ambalo linamaanisha "wewe"), lazima kuanze na herufi kubwa, hata ikiwa linatokea katikati ya sentensi.

translations.source: This is an important way to distinguish between some verbs and objects.
translations.reference: Hii ni njia muhimu ya kutofautisha kati ya baadhi ya vitenzi na vitu.
translations.hypothesis: Hii ni njia muhimu ya kutofautisha kati ya verba (vitenzi) na vitu.

translations.source: It also arguably makes reading easier, though writing is somewhat complicated by the need to find out whether a verb or adjective is used in a substantivized form.
translations.reference: Pia bila shaka inafanya kusoma rahisi, ingawa kuandika kwa kiasi fulani ni ngumu kwa haja ya kutaka kujua kama kitenzi au kivumishi kinatumika kwa umuhimu.
translations.hypothesis: Pia, inaweza kusema kwamba hii huongeza urahisi wa kusoma, ingawa kuandika kunaweza kuwa changamoto kidogo kwa sababu inahitaji kutambua iwapo aina ya neno (kiwakosi au hali) imetumika kama nomino.

translations.source: Pronunciation is relatively easy in Italian since most words are pronounced exactly how they are written
translations.reference: Matamshi ni rahisi kiasi kwa Kiitaliano kwani maneno mengi hutamkwa hasa yalivyoandikwa
translations.hypothesis: Utamkaji wa maneno katika lugha ya Kiitaliano ni rahisi kwa kawaida, kwa sababu maneno mengi hutamkwa kabisa kama yalivyoandikwa.

translations.source: The main letters to watch out for are c and g, since their pronunciation varies based on the following vowel.
translations.reference: Herufi muhimu za kuzingatia ni c na g, kwani matamshi yake hubadilika kulingana na vokali inayofuata.
translations.hypothesis: Herufi muhimu ambazo unapaswa kuzingatia ni "c" na "g," kwani matamshi yake yanatofautiana kulingana na sauti (vowel) inayofuata.

translations.source: Also, make sure to pronounce r and rr differently: caro means dear, whereas carro means chariot.
translations.reference: Pia, hakikisha kutamka r na rr tofauti: caro inamaanisha mpenzi, ilhali carro inamaanisha gari la kuvurutwa na farasi.
translations.hypothesis: Pia, hakikisha kwamba unasema sauti za "r" na "rr" tofauti: neno "caro" linamaanisha "mpendwa," wakati neno "carro" linamaanisha "gari."

translations.source: Persian has a relatively easy and mostly regular grammar.
translations.reference: Kiajemi ina sarufi rahisi kiasi, na mara nyingi ya kawaida.
translations.hypothesis: Kilaa ina sarufi ambayo ni rahisi na, kwa kawaida, ina utaratibu thabiti.

translations.source: Therefore, reading this grammar primer would help you learn much about Persian grammar and understand phrases better.
translations.reference: Kwa hivyo, kusoma chanzo hiki cha sarufi kutakusaidia wewe kujifunza mengi kuhusu sarufi ya Kiajemi na kuelewa bora zaidi.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa hivyo, kusoma kitabu hiki cha msingi cha sarufi itakusaidia kujifunza mengi kuhusu sarufi ya Kifarsi na kuelewa maneno na sentensi vizuri zaidi.

translations.source: Needless to say, if you know a Romance language, it will be easier for you to learn Portuguese.
translations.reference: Bila haja ya kusema, ikiwa unaifahamu lugha ya mahaba, itakuwa rahisi kwako kujifunza Kireno.
translations.hypothesis: Ni wazi kwamba, ikiwa unajua lugha mojawapo ya lugha za Kilatini, itakuwa rahisi kwako kujifunza Kireno.

translations.source: However, people who know a little Spanish may hastily conclude that Portuguese is close enough that it need not be studied separately.
translations.reference: Hata hivyo, watu wanaofahamu Kihispania kidogo wanaweza kuhitimisha kwa haraka kuwa Kireno kinakaribiana sana na kwamba hakihitaji kusomwa kando.
translations.hypothesis: Hata hivyo, watu ambao wana ujuzi mdogo wa lugha ya Kihispania wanaweza, kwa haraka, kufikia hitimisho kwamba Kireno ni sawa kabisa na Kihispania, na hivyo basi hakihitaji kusomwa kama lugha tofauti.

translations.source: Pre-modern observatories are usually obsolete today, and remain as museums, or sites of education.
translations.reference: Uchunguzi kabla ya kisasa kwa kawaida hautumiki leo, na hubaki kama makavazi, ama sehemu za elimu.
translations.hypothesis: Vituo vya utafiti wa anga vilivyojengwa kabla ya enzi ya kisasa kwa kawaida vimepotea umuhimu leo, na sasa hutumika kama makumbusho au vituo vya elimu.

translations.source: As light pollution in their heyday was not the kind of problem it is today, they are usually located in cities or at campuses, easier to reach than those built in modern times.
translations.reference: Kwani uchafuzi wa mwanga nyakati zao haukuwa shida kama ilivyo leo, mara nyingi wako mijini au katikavyuo vikuu, rahisi kufikia kuliko zile zimejengwa siku za kisasa.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa sababu wakati wa ujenzi wao, uchafuzi wa mwanga ulikuwa si tatizo kubwa kama ulivyo leo, mara nyingi wamejengwa katika miji au katika vyuo vikuu, ambako ni rahisi kufika kuliko maeneo ambayo yamejengwa katika nyakati za hivi karibuni.

translations.source: Most modern research telescopes are enormous facilities in remote areas with favorable atmospheric conditions.
translations.reference: Darubini nyingi za utafiti za kisasa ni vifaa kuu katika maeneo ya mbali yaliyo na hali nzuri za angahewa.
translations.hypothesis: Teleskobu nyingi za kisasa za utafiti ni vifaa vikubwa sana ambavyo zimewekwa katika maeneo mbali mbali, ambapo hali za anga ni nzuri.

translations.source: Cherry blossom viewing, known as hanami, has been a part of Japanese culture since the 8th century.
translations.reference: Utazamaji wa maua ya cheri, inayojulikana kama hanami, imekuwa sehemu ya utamaduni wa Kijapani tangu karne ya 8.
translations.hypothesis: Kuangalia maua ya cherry, ambayo huitwa "hanami," ni desturi ambayo imekuwa sehemu ya utamaduni wa Japani tangu karne ya 8.

translations.source: The concept came from China where plum blossoms were the flower of choice.
translations.reference: Dhana hiyo ilitoka Uchina ambapo maua ya plamu ndiyo yaliyokuwa maua yaliyopendelewa.
translations.hypothesis: Wazo hilo lilitokana na China, ambako maua ya prunus (aina ya mti) yalikuwa maua yanayopendelewa zaidi.

translations.source: In Japan, the first cherry blossom parties were hosted by the emperor only for himself and other members of the aristocracy around the Imperial Court.
translations.reference: Huko Japani, sherehe za kwanza za maua ya mcheri ziliandaliwa na maliki kwa ajili yake mwenyewe na washiriki wengine wa upatanishi waliozunguka Mahakama ya Imperi.
translations.hypothesis: Nchini Japani, sherehe za kwanza za maua ya cherry zilifanywa na mfalme, na zilikuwa zimepangwa kwa ajili yake mwenyewe na kwa wengine walio katika hadhi ya juu katika mahali pa utawala.

translations.source: Plants look their best when in a natural environment, so resist the temptation to remove even "just one" specimen.
translations.reference: Mimea inaonekana bora ikiwa katika mazingira ya asili, kwa hivyo epuka kishawishi cha kutoa hata kiolezo "kimoja tu".
translations.hypothesis: Mimea inaonekana vizuri zaidi wakati iko katika mazingira yake ya asili, kwa hivyo epuka hamu ya kuondoa hata "moja tu" ya mimea hiyo.

translations.source: If visiting a formally arranged garden, collecting "specimens" is also going to get you ejected, without discussion.
translations.reference: Ikiwa unatembelea bustani iliyopangwa rasmi, kukusanya “violezo” pia kutakufanya uodolewe, bila majadiliano.
translations.hypothesis: Ikiwa utatembelea bustani iliyopangwa rasmi, kukusanya "sampuli" za mimea pia kutakufanya ukimbwe huko, bila kutoa maelezo yoyote.

translations.source: Singapore is generally an extremely safe place to be and very easy to navigate, and you can buy almost anything after arriving.
translations.reference: Singapori kwa ujumla ni mahali salama zaidi kuwa na rahisi sana kuabiri, na unaweza kununua karibu chochote baada ya kuwasili.
translations.hypothesis: Singapore ni mahali salama sana na rahisi sana kusafiri, na unaweza kununua karibu kila kitu unapotua huko.

translations.source: But being placed in the "high tropics" just a few degrees north of equator you will need to deal with both heat (always) and strong sun (when the sky is clear, more rarely).
translations.reference: Lakini kwa kuwekwa katika “tropiki za juu” digrii chache tu kaskazini mwa istiwai utahitaji kukabiliana na joto jingi (kila wakati) na jua kali (wakati anga ni safi, nadra zaidi).
translations.hypothesis: Lakini, kwani eneo hilo lipo "karibu na kanda ya kitropiki," tu digrii chache kaskazini mwa mstari wa usawa, utahitaji kukabiliana na joto (ambalo linaweza kuwa kila wakati) na jua kali (linapokuwa anga limefichika, mara chache tu).

translations.source: There are also a few buses going north to Hebron, the traditional burial place of the Biblical patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and their wives.
translations.reference: Pia kuna mabasi machache yanayoelekea kaskazini mwa Hebroni, mahali pa makaburi ya jadi ya mashujaa wa Biblia Abrahamu, Isaka, Yakobo, na wake zao.
translations.hypothesis: Pia, kuna mabasi machache ambayo yanaelekea kaskazini kwenda Hebron, ambako ni eneo la jadi la mazishi ya waanzilishi muhimu wa Biblia, kama vile Abrahamu, Isaka, Yakubu, na wake zao.

translations.source: Check that the bus you are thinking of taking goes into Hebron and not just to the nearby Jewish settlement of Kiryat Arba.
translations.reference: Hakikisha kwamba basi unalofikiria kuabiri linaenda Hebron na si katika makazi ya karibu ya Kiyahudi ya Kiryat Arba tu.
translations.hypothesis: Hakikisha kwamba basi unalotaka kuingia limeelekea Hebron, na si tu kwenye makazi ya Wayahudi yaliyo karibu, yaani Kiryat Arba.

translations.source: Inland waterways can be a good theme to base a holiday around.
translations.reference: Njia za maji za barani zinaweza kuwa mandhari mzuri ya kufanyia likizo.
translations.hypothesis: Maji safi ya ndani yanaweza kuwa mada nzuri ambayo unaweza kutumia kuandaa likizo.

translations.source: For example visiting castles in the Loire Valley, the Rhine valley or taking a cruise to interesting cites on the Danube or boating along the Erie Canal.
translations.reference: Kwa mfano, kutembelea ngome katika Bonde la Loire, Bonde la Rhine au kusafiri katika maeneo ya kuvutia kwa Danube au kusafiri kwa mashua upande wa Mfereji wa Erie.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa mfano, unaweza kutembelea ngome zilizopo katika Bonde la Loire, Bonde la Rhine, au kufanya safari ya meli kwenda kwenye miji yenye kuvutia kando ya Mto Danube, au kusafiri kwa boti kwenye Mfereji wa Erie.

translations.source: They also define routes for popular hiking and cycling trails.
translations.reference: Pia wao hufafanua njia maarufu za matembezi na uendeshaji baiskeli.
translations.hypothesis: Wao pia huainisha njia za kawaida za kutembea na kutumia baiskeli.

translations.source: Christmas is one of the most important holidays of Christianity, and is celebrated as the birthday of Jesus.
translations.reference: Krismasi ni moja ya likizo muhimu zaidi ya Ukristo, na inaadhimishwa kama siku ya kuzaliwa kwa Yesu.
translations.hypothesis: Krismasi ni moja ya sikukuu muhimu zaidi katika Ukristo, na huadhimishwa kama siku ya kuzaliwa ya Yesu.

translations.source: Many of the traditions surrounding the holiday have been adopted also by non-believers in Christian countries and non-Christians around the world.
translations.reference: Nyingi za tamaduni zinazozunguka likizo zimesilikwa pia na wasioamini katika nchi za Kikristo na wasio Wakristo duniani kote.
translations.hypothesis: Mambo mengi ya mila na desturi zinazohusiana na sikukuu hiyo yamekubalika pia na watu ambao hawana imani ya Kikristo katika nchi za Kikristo, na watu wasio Wakristo kote ulimwenguni.

translations.source: There's a tradition to pass the Easter night awake at some exposed point to see the sunrise.
translations.reference: Kuna desturi ya kukesha usiku wa Pasaka katika sehemu fulani wazi ili kuona jua likichomoza.
translations.hypothesis: Kuna desturi ya kuamka usiku wa Pasaka na kukaa mahali wazi ili kuona jua linatokea.

translations.source: There are of course Christian theological explanations for this tradition, but it may well be a pre-Christian Spring and Fertility ritual.
translations.reference: Kwa kweli kuna maelezo ya thiolojia ya Kikristo ya utamaduni huu, lakini pia huenda ikawa ibada ya Majira ya kuchipua na Uzazi kabla ya Ukristo.
translations.hypothesis: Hakika kuna maelezo ya kidini ya Kikristo kuhusu mila hii, lakini inawezekana kuwa ni sherehe ya jadi ya machipuko na uzazi iliyokuwepo kabla ya Ukristo.

translations.source: More traditional churches often hold an Easter Vigil on Saturday night during the Easter weekend, with the congregations often breaking into celebration at the stroke of midnight to celebrate Christ's resurrection.
translations.reference: Makanisa zaidi ya jadi huwa na Mkesha wa Pasaka usiku wa Jumamosi wakati wa wikendi ya Pasaka, waumini wakisherehekea saa sita kamili za usiku kuadhimisha ufufuo wa Kristo.
translations.hypothesis: Kanisa nyingi za jadi huadhimisha Ibada ya Usiku wa Pasaka siku ya Jumamosi usiku, wakati wa sikukuu ya Pasaka, na mara nyingi washiriki huungana kwa furaha kuanzia saa moja usiku ili kusherehekea ufufuko wa Kristo.

translations.source: All animals that originally arrived in the islands came here either by swimming, flying or floating.
translations.reference: Wanyama wote asili waliofika katika visiwa hivi walikuja hapa pengine kwa kuogelea, kupaa au kuelea.
translations.hypothesis: Wanyama wote ambao walifika katika visiwa hivyo kwa mara ya kwanza walifika hapa kwa kuogelea, kuruka au kusafiri kwa maji.

translations.source: Due to the long distance from the continent mammals were unable to make the journey making the giant tortoise the primary grazing animal in the Galapagos.
translations.reference: Kwa sababu ya masafa marefu kutoka kwa bara, mamalia walishindwa kumalize mwendo, huku mzee kobe jitu akiwa mnyama wa kimsingi mla nyasi katika Galapagosi.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa sababu ya umbali mrefu kutoka bara, wanyama wanaopandana hawakuweza kufika huko, hivyo kwamba kobe mkubwa ilikuwa mnyama mkuu aliye kula mimea katika kisiwa cha Galapagos.

translations.source: Since the arrival of man to the Galapagos, many mammals have been introduced including goats, horses, cows, rats, cats and dogs.
translations.reference: Tangu kuwasili kwa mwanadamu katika Galapagos, mamalia wengi wamewasilishwa pamoja na mbuzi, farasi, ng'ombe, panya, paka na mbwa.
translations.hypothesis: Tangu wakati ambapo binadamu walifika kisiwa cha Galapagos, wanyama wengi wamekuwa waliwekwa humo, ikiwa ni pamoja na mbuzi, farasi, ng'ombe, panya, paka na mbwa.

translations.source: If you visit the Arctic or Antarctic areas in the winter you will experience the polar night, which means that the sun doesn't rise above the horizon.
translations.reference: Ukitembelea maeneo ya Aktiki na Antaktiki msimu wa baridi utapata tajriba ya usiku wa pola, ambayo ina maana kuwa jua halichomozi juu ya upeo wa macho.
translations.hypothesis: Ikiwa utatembelea maeneo ya Kaskazini mwa Dunia (Arctic) au Kusini mwa Dunia (Antarctic) wakati wa msimu wa baridi, utapata hali inayoitwa "usiku wa polar," ambayo ina maana kwamba jua halitokei juu ya upeo wa anga.

translations.source: This offers a good opportunity to see the Aurora borealis, as the sky will be dark more or less around the clock.
translations.reference: Hii inatoa fursa nzuri ya kuona mwanga wa Aurora, kwani anga itakuwa giza kwa kadiri fulani mchana na usiku.
translations.hypothesis: Hii ni fursa nzuri ya kuona kivuli cha anga (Aurora Borealis), kwani anga itakuwa mepesi kwa karibu saa zote.

translations.source: As the areas are sparsely populated, and light pollution therefore often not a problem, you will also be able to enjoy the stars.
translations.reference: Kwa kuwa maeneo hayo hayana idadi kubwa ya watu, na uchafuzi kidogo aghalabu huwa si tatizo, pia utaweza kufuruhia nyota.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa sababu maeneo hayo yana idadi ndogo ya watu, na hivyo mara nyingi usumbufu wa mwanga haikuwa tatizo, utaweza pia kufurahia kuangalia nyota.

translations.source: Japanese work culture is more hierarchical and formal that what Westerners may be used to.
translations.reference: Desturi ya kazi ya Kijapani ni ya kimfumo na rasmi kuliko mazoea ya Wanamagharibi.
translations.hypothesis: Utamaduni wa kazi nchini Japani ni wa kimapokeo na unafuata sheria zaidi kuliko kile ambacho watu kutoka Magharibi huweza kuwa na tabia ya kukutana nacho.

translations.source: Suits are standard business attire, and coworkers call each other by their family names or by job titles.
translations.reference: Suti ni mavazi ya kawaida ya kibiashara, na wafanyikazi huita wenzao kwa majina ya familia zao au kwa majina ya kikazi.
translations.hypothesis: Suti ni nguo rasmi za kawaida za kazi, na wafanyakazi huwajulia wenzao kwa majina yao ya familia au kwa majina ya nafasi zao za kazi.

translations.source: Workplace harmony is crucial, emphasizing group effort rather than praising individual accomplishments.
translations.reference: Ulinganifu katika mahali pa kazi ni muhimu, kusisitiza juhudi za vikundi badala ya kusifu mafanikio ya kibinafsi.
translations.hypothesis: Amani katika mahali pa kazi ni muhimu sana, na inapaswa kutilia mkazo ushirikiano wa kikundi badala ya kumpongeza mtu binafsi kwa mafanikio yake.

translations.source: Workers must often get their superiors' approval for any decisions they make, and are expected to obey their superiors' instructions without question.
translations.reference: Mara kwa mara wafanyakazi hupata kibali cha maamuzi yoyote wanayofanya kutoka kwa wasimamizi wao, na wanatarajiwa kutii maagizo ya wakuu wao bila maswali.
translations.hypothesis: Wafanyakazi mara nyingi wanahitaji kupata idhini ya wakubwa wao kwa maamuzi yoyote wanayoyafanya, na wanatarajiwa kutii maagizo ya wakubwa wao bila kusahau.
